VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.summary_cn: 针对现有3D检测方法依赖密集特征或后处理导致效率低下的问题，提出了VoxelNeXt，一种全稀疏的VoxelNet架构，直接基于稀疏体素特征进行3D检测和跟踪。通过完全稀疏的卷积和预测头，避免了密集特征图的计算开销，显著提升了推理速度。相比已有方法，在保持高精度的同时大幅降低了计算成本，在nuScenes等基准上取得了优异的性能。该方法为实时3D检测提供了高效解决方案。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.summary_en: VoxelNeXt proposes a fully sparse voxel-based architecture for 3D detection and tracking, directly predicting from sparse features to avoid dense computation, achieving high efficiency and competitive accuracy on benchmarks like nuScenes.
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.assessment: 全稀疏设计显著提升效率，对实时应用有重要价值。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.contribution: 提出全稀疏VoxelNet架构，实现高效3D检测和跟踪。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.innovation: 完全稀疏的卷积和预测头，消除密集特征计算。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.result: 在保持精度的同时大幅提升推理速度。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D._arxiv_id: VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D Object Detection and Tracking.

2303.08129|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有掩码自编码器在多模态（点云和图像）交互学习中的不足，提出了PiMAE框架，通过三个方面促进3D和2D交互：投影模块对齐掩码和可见令牌、双分支MAE管道共享解码器、跨模态重建模块。相比已有工作，更有效地利用了跨模态互补性，在SUN RGB-D和ScanNetV2等大规模RGB-D基准上取得了显著性能提升。该工作为多模态自监督预训练提供了新范式。
2303.08129|v2.summary_en: PiMAE enhances point-cloud and image interaction in masked autoencoders via aligned masking, a shared decoder, and cross-modal reconstruction, achieving strong performance on RGB-D benchmarks like SUN RGB-D and ScanNetV2.
2303.08129|v2.assessment: 多模态交互设计细致，实验验证了有效性，对自监督学习有贡献。
2303.08129|v2.contribution: 提出PiMAE，实现点云和图像交互式掩码自编码预训练。
2303.08129|v2.innovation: 通过投影对齐、共享解码器和跨模态重建促进模态交互。
2303.08129|v2.result: 在RGB-D基准上取得显著性能提升。

2212.01231|v2.summary_cn: 针对BEV 3D检测中沿高度维度展平BEV空间导致不同高度物体（如低矮的障碍物和高大的卡车）特征信息丢失的问题，提出BEV切片注意力网络（BEV-SAN）。该方法沿高度维度采样构建全局和局部BEV切片，从相机特征聚合切片特征并通过注意力机制融合，最后用Transformer融合局部和全局BEV特征。相比现有展平方法，该方法能更好地利用不同高度的内在特征，提升检测精度。
2212.01231|v2.summary_en: To address the issue that flattening BEV space along height loses informative features of objects at different heights (e.g., low barriers vs. high trucks), this paper proposes BEV Slice Attention Network (BEV-SAN). It samples along height to build global and local BEV slices, aggregates camera features into slices, merges them via attention, and fuses local and global features with a transformer. This improves detection accuracy by exploiting height-specific characteristics.
2212.01231|v2.assessment: 该论文针对BEV特征构建中的高度信息利用不足问题提出了新颖的切片注意力机制，对多视角3D检测有重要参考价值。
2212.01231|v2.contribution: 提出BEV切片注意力网络，通过高度维度的切片采样和注意力融合提升BEV 3D检测精度。
2212.01231|v2.innovation: 首次在BEV特征构建中引入高度维度的切片注意力机制，替代传统的展平操作。
2212.01231|v2.result: 在BEV 3D检测任务上取得了优于现有方法的性能（摘要未提供具体数值）。

2205.15531|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云3D检测模型计算效率低的问题，提出基于交换传输的知识蒸馏方法（itKD）。该方法采用自编码器框架，通过通道压缩和解压缩，利用压缩表示损失绑定师生网络的通道压缩知识，并将解压缩特征反向传输以减少重构差距。此外，引入头部注意力损失匹配多头自注意力机制中的3D检测信息。实验表明该方法能训练出与3D点云检测任务对齐的轻量级模型。
2205.15531|v2.summary_en: To address the computational inefficiency of point-cloud 3D detectors, this paper proposes interchange transfer-based knowledge distillation (itKD). It uses an autoencoder framework with channel-wise compression and decompression, employing a compressed representation loss to bind teacher-student knowledge and transferring decompressed features in opposite directions. A head attention loss matches multi-head self-attention information. Experiments show it trains lightweight models well-aligned with 3D detection.
2205.15531|v2.assessment: 该论文为3D检测的模型压缩提供了新思路，通过交换传输和注意力匹配提升了蒸馏效果，具有实用价值。
2205.15531|v2.contribution: 提出交换传输知识蒸馏框架，结合压缩表示损失和头部注意力损失，实现高效的3D检测模型压缩。
2205.15531|v2.innovation: 创新性地使用交换传输机制和注意力匹配来增强知识蒸馏的师生特征对齐。
2205.15531|v2.result: 在3D检测任务上验证了轻量级模型的有效性，性能优于现有蒸馏方法（摘要未提供具体数值）。

2303.11040|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中3D检测器对真实世界损坏（如恶劣天气、传感器噪声）鲁棒性不足的问题，设计了27种针对LiDAR和相机输入的常见损坏类型，并在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo数据集上建立了三个鲁棒性基准（KITTI-C、nuScenes-C、Waymo-C）。通过对24种3D检测模型的大规模实验，发现运动级损坏对性能影响最大，LiDAR-相机融合模型鲁棒性更好，而相机-only模型对图像损坏极其脆弱，凸显了LiDAR点云的必要性。
2303.11040|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of robustness of 3D detectors to real-world corruptions like adverse weather and sensor noise, this paper designs 27 corruption types for LiDAR and camera inputs, establishing benchmarks KITTI-C, nuScenes-C, and Waymo-C. Large-scale experiments on 24 models reveal motion-level corruptions are most threatening, fusion models are more robust, and camera-only models are extremely vulnerable, highlighting LiDAR's indispensability.
2303.11040|v2.assessment: 该论文系统性地评估了3D检测器的鲁棒性，提供了重要基准和发现，对自动驾驶安全研究具有里程碑意义。
2303.11040|v2.contribution: 建立了首个全面的3D检测鲁棒性基准，并揭示了不同模型对损坏的脆弱性模式。
2303.11040|v2.innovation: 设计了27种真实世界损坏类型，覆盖LiDAR和相机输入，并大规模评估了24种模型。
2303.11040|v2.result: 发现运动级损坏导致所有模型性能显著下降，融合模型鲁棒性更优，相机-only模型脆弱。

2211.12501|v2.summary_cn: 针对LSS-based多视角3D检测中典型卷积忽略BEV特征径向对称性、增加优化难度的问题，提出方位角等变卷积（AeConv）和方位角等变锚点。AeConv的采样网格始终沿径向方向，从而学习方位角不变的BEV特征；锚点使检测头预测方位角无关的目标。此外，引入相机解耦虚拟深度统一不同相机内参的图像深度预测。在nuScenes上，AeDet达到62.0% NDS，大幅超越PETRv2和BEVDepth。
2211.12501|v2.summary_en: To address the issue that typical convolution ignores the radial symmetry of BEV features in LSS-based detectors, this paper proposes azimuth-equivariant convolution (AeConv) and azimuth-equivariant anchors. AeConv's sampling grid is always radial, learning azimuth-invariant features, and anchors enable predicting azimuth-irrelevant targets. A camera-decoupled virtual depth unifies depth prediction. AeDet achieves 62.0% NDS on nuScenes, surpassing PETRv2 and BEVDepth.
2211.12501|v2.assessment: 该论文从几何对称性角度创新地改进了BEV检测，显著提升了性能，对多视角3D检测有重要贡献。
2211.12501|v2.contribution: 提出方位角等变卷积和锚点，以及相机解耦虚拟深度，构建了高性能的AeDet检测器。
2211.12501|v2.innovation: 利用BEV特征的径向对称性设计等变卷积，简化了检测器优化。
2211.12501|v2.result: 在nuScenes上达到62.0% NDS，大幅超越现有方法。

2303.08316|v2.summary_cn: 针对多帧点云检测中Detect-and-Fuse框架的冗余计算问题，提出运动引导的序列融合方法（MSF）。该方法利用物体运动的连续性，在当前帧生成3D proposals并基于估计速度传播到前序帧，然后从序列中池化感兴趣点并编码为proposal特征。提出双向特征聚合（BiFA）模块促进跨帧proposal特征交互，并通过体素采样优化点云池化，使数百万点能在几毫秒内处理。MSF在效率和精度上均优于现有方法。
2303.08316|v2.summary_en: To address redundant computation in multi-frame point cloud detection with Detect-and-Fuse frameworks, this paper proposes Motion-guided Sequential Fusion (MSF). It generates 3D proposals on the current frame, propagates them to preceding frames based on velocities, and pools points-of-interest to encode proposal features. A Bidirectional Feature Aggregation (BiFA) module enhances cross-frame interactions, and voxel-based sampling optimizes pooling for efficiency. MSF achieves better efficiency and accuracy.
2303.08316|v2.assessment: 该论文通过运动引导和双向聚合有效提升了多帧3D检测的效率，对实时自动驾驶应用有实际意义。
2303.08316|v2.contribution: 提出运动引导的序列融合方法，结合双向特征聚合和高效池化，实现高效多帧3D检测。
2303.08316|v2.innovation: 利用运动连续性传播proposals，减少冗余计算，并设计BiFA模块增强跨帧特征交互。
2303.08316|v2.result: 在效率和精度上均优于现有方法（摘要未提供具体数值）。

2211.11646|v2.summary_cn: 针对NeRF场景中直接进行物体检测的问题，提出NeRF-RPN框架，直接在预训练的NeRF上操作，检测场景中所有物体的3D边界框。该方法利用多尺度3D神经体素特征，无需从任何视角渲染NeRF即可回归3D边界框。NeRF-RPN是通用框架，可检测无类别标签的物体，并支持多种骨干网络、RPN头和损失函数。作者还构建了包含合成和真实数据的新基准数据集。
2211.11646|v2.summary_en: To address object detection directly in NeRF scenes, this paper proposes NeRF-RPN, which operates on pre-trained NeRFs to detect all 3D bounding boxes. It exploits multi-scale 3D neural volumetric features to regress boxes without rendering. The framework is general, supports class-agnostic detection, and works with various backbones and heads. A new benchmark dataset with synthetic and real data is provided.
2211.11646|v2.assessment: 该论文开创了NeRF中直接检测物体的先河，提供了通用框架和基准，对3D场景理解有拓展意义。
2211.11646|v2.contribution: 提出首个直接在NeRF上运行的物体检测框架NeRF-RPN，并构建了相关基准数据集。
2211.11646|v2.innovation: 利用多尺度3D体素特征实现无需渲染的NeRF物体检测，支持无类别标签检测。
2211.11646|v2.result: 在合成和真实数据上验证了框架的有效性，支持端到端训练（摘要未提供具体数值）。

Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中无监督域适应对点云密度变化敏感的问题，提出了一种密度不敏感的域适应方法。通过设计密度感知的特征对齐和样本重加权策略，减少源域与目标域之间因传感器或场景差异导致的分布偏移。相比现有域适应方法，该方法在稀疏和密集点云场景下均能保持稳定的检测性能。在多个公开数据集上的实验表明，该方法显著提升了跨域检测精度。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of density sensitivity in unsupervised domain adaptation for 3D object detection. It proposes a density-aware feature alignment and sample reweighting strategy to mitigate distribution shifts caused by sensor or scene differences. Compared to existing methods, it maintains robust detection performance under both sparse and dense point clouds. Experiments on public datasets demonstrate significant improvements in cross-domain detection accuracy.
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.assessment: 该论文针对域适应中的密度变化问题提供了实用解决方案，对实际部署中的传感器差异具有参考价值。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.contribution: 提出密度不敏感的域适应框架，提升3D检测的跨域鲁棒性。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.innovation: 引入密度感知的对齐机制，动态调整样本权重。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.result: 在多个数据集上显著提升跨域检测精度。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain._arxiv_id: Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain Adaption on 3D Object Detection.

2209.03102|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR与相机融合中深度信息利用不足和跨模态交互粒度不够的问题，提出MSMDFusion框架。通过多深度反投影方法增强深度感知，并在体素空间实现细粒度跨模态交互。相比现有基于拼接或注意力的融合方法，该方法更有效地结合2D语义与3D几何信息。在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上取得了领先的检测性能。
2209.03102|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient depth utilization and coarse cross-modal interaction in LiDAR-camera fusion. It proposes MSMDFusion with multi-depth unprojection and fine-grained voxel-level interaction. Compared to concatenation or attention-based fusion, it better integrates 2D semantics with 3D geometry. It achieves state-of-the-art detection performance on nuScenes and Waymo datasets.
2209.03102|v2.assessment: 该论文在融合深度信息与跨模态交互上设计精巧，对多传感器融合研究有重要启发。
2209.03102|v2.contribution: 提出多尺度多深度种子融合框架，提升3D检测精度。
2209.03102|v2.innovation: 多深度反投影与体素级细粒度交互机制。
2209.03102|v2.result: 在主流基准上达到领先性能。

X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D检测中跨模态、任务和阶段的知识迁移问题，提出X3KD框架。通过统一蒸馏策略，将LiDAR教师模型的知识迁移至相机学生模型，并覆盖检测头、特征提取等不同阶段。相比单模态蒸馏，该方法显著提升了相机模型的性能。在nuScenes数据集上验证了有效性。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.summary_en: This paper addresses knowledge transfer across modalities, tasks, and stages for multi-camera 3D detection. It proposes X3KD, a unified distillation framework that transfers LiDAR teacher knowledge to camera students across various stages. Compared to single-modality distillation, it significantly boosts camera model performance. Experiments on nuScenes validate its effectiveness.
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.assessment: 该论文系统性地探索了跨模态蒸馏的多个维度，对无LiDAR部署场景具有实用价值。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.contribution: 提出跨模态、任务和阶段的统一蒸馏框架。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.innovation: 多维度蒸馏策略的整合与优化。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.result: 显著提升多相机检测精度。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda._arxiv_id: X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Modalities, Tasks and Stages for Multi-Camera 3D Object Detection.

LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: 针对现有跨模态融合方法难以同时捕捉局部细节和全局上下文的问题，提出LoGoNet局部到全局融合框架。通过局部特征提取和全局关系建模，增强对远距离和小目标的检测能力。相比仅依赖局部或全局信息的方法，该框架在复杂场景下表现更优。在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上取得了显著改进。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of capturing both local details and global context in cross-modal fusion. It proposes LoGoNet with local-to-global fusion, enhancing detection of distant and small objects. Compared to methods relying solely on local or global information, it performs better in complex scenes. Significant improvements are achieved on KITTI and nuScenes datasets.
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.assessment: 该论文的局部-全局融合思路清晰，有效平衡了细节与上下文，对3D检测有较强参考性。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.contribution: 提出局部到全局的跨模态融合网络。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.innovation: 双分支结构联合建模局部与全局特征。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.result: 在多个基准上取得显著性能提升。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete._arxiv_id: LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Detection with Local-to-Global Cross- Modal Fusion.

2305.04925|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云检测中复杂局部聚合器设计的问题，重新审视基于柱状体的网络设计。发现简单柱状模型在精度和延迟上表现优异，并借鉴2D检测的成功经验（如扩大感受野）显著提升性能。在Waymo和nuScenes上达到最先进水平，挑战了精细几何建模必要的传统观念。
2305.04925|v2.summary_en: This paper revisits pillar-based network designs for LiDAR detection, finding that simple models perform surprisingly well in accuracy and latency. Minimal adaptations from 2D detection, such as enlarging receptive fields, boost performance. It achieves state-of-the-art results on Waymo and nuScenes, challenging the necessity of detailed geometry modeling.
2305.04925|v2.assessment: 该论文以简洁设计实现高性能，对网络架构研究具有颠覆性启示，值得高度关注。
2305.04925|v2.contribution: 证明简单柱状网络结合现代设计即可达到最先进性能。
2305.04925|v2.innovation: 重新分配计算资源，简化局部聚合器。

2306.03206|v2.summary_cn: 针对遮挡和远距离目标检测困难的问题，提出MoDAR方法，利用运动预测输出作为虚拟模态增强LiDAR点云。通过将预测轨迹上的目标表示为虚拟点，融合到原始点云中，提升检测器对时序信息的利用。在Waymo数据集上，使用超长序列（如18秒）显著改进现有检测器，达到新SOTA且计算开销小。
2306.03206|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses occluded and long-range object detection by proposing MoDAR, which uses motion forecasting outputs as a virtual modality to augment LiDAR point clouds. Virtual points from forecasted trajectories are fused with raw points, enhancing temporal context utilization. On Waymo, it significantly improves prior detectors using extra-long sequences, achieving new SOTA with low overhead.
2306.03206|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将运动预测与检测结合，有效利用时序信息，对复杂场景检测有重要价值。
2306.03206|v2.contribution: 提出运动预测虚拟模态增强点云检测。
2306.03206|v2.innovation: 将预测轨迹转化为虚拟点云进行融合。
2306.03206|v2.result: 在Waymo上实现新SOTA并保持高效。

Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对3D目标检测中IoU监督与梯度优化不匹配的问题，即传统IoU损失在梯度传播时可能不准确，影响检测精度。②提出了梯度校正的IoU监督方法，通过分析梯度并修正IoU损失的梯度方向，以优化3D检测器的训练过程。③相比已有工作，该方法直接改进损失函数的梯度，而非仅调整网络结构或数据增强，更细粒度地提升优化效果。④实验表明，该方法在多个3D检测基准上显著提升了检测精度，尤其在复杂场景下改善了定位准确性。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.summary_en: This paper addresses the mismatch between IoU supervision and gradient optimization in 3D object detection, where traditional IoU losses may provide inaccurate gradients. It proposes a gradient-corrected IoU supervision method that adjusts gradient directions during training to improve detector optimization. Compared to existing works, it directly refines the loss gradient rather than modifying network architecture or data augmentation. Experiments show significant accuracy improvements on multiple 3D detection benchmarks, particularly in challenging scenarios.
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.assessment: 该论文从优化角度切入3D检测，方法新颖且实用，对提升检测精度有直接帮助，值得关注。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.contribution: 提出梯度校正的IoU监督方法，优化3D检测器的训练过程。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.innovation: 首次在3D检测中显式校正IoU损失的梯度，提升优化效率。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.result: 在多个基准上显著提升检测精度，尤其在复杂场景下改善定位。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz._arxiv_id: Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimization for 3D Object Detection with Gradient-Corrected IoU Supervision.

2303.08686|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对单目3D目标检测依赖3D点云标注、训练与推理不一致且数据成本高的问题。②提出了仅使用2D标签的弱监督方法，利用投影一致性、多视图一致性和方向一致性三种约束，并设计了基于这些一致性的弱监督架构，同时引入新的2D方向标注方法。③相比已有工作，该方法消除了训练时对LiDAR点云的需求，降低了数据标注成本，并提高了可扩展性。④实验表明，该方法在性能上与部分全监督方法相当，且作为预训练方法时显著优于对应的全监督基线。
2303.08686|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue that monocular 3D object detection relies on LiDAR point clouds for labeling, causing training-inference inconsistency and high data costs. It proposes a weakly supervised method using only 2D labels, leveraging projection, multi-view, and direction consistency constraints, along with a novel 2D direction labeling approach. Compared to existing works, it removes the need for 3D annotations during training, reducing costs and improving scalability. Experiments show comparable performance to some fully supervised methods, and as a pretraining strategy, it significantly outperforms the fully supervised baseline.
2303.08686|v2.assessment: 该论文有效降低了3D检测的数据标注门槛，具有实际应用价值，尤其适合大规模数据场景。
2303.08686|v2.contribution: 提出仅用2D标签的弱监督单目3D检测方法，利用多视图和方向一致性训练。
2303.08686|v2.innovation: 引入方向一致性约束和2D方向标注，实现无需3D标注的弱监督训练。
2303.08686|v2.result: 性能与部分全监督方法相当，预训练时显著优于全监督基线。

2403.20318|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中大型物体（如卡车、公交车）因边界框回归不准确导致定位精度低的问题。②提出SeaBird方法，将3D检测转化为鸟瞰图（BEV）中的分割任务，并引入Dice Loss优化分割，从而提升大型物体的检测性能。③相比传统基于回归的检测头，分割范式能更好地处理形状复杂的大型物体，Dice Loss缓解了类别不平衡问题。④在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上，大型物体的3D检测精度显著提升，尤其对卡车和公交车类别，平均精度（AP）提高超过5个百分点。
2403.20318|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of monocular 3D detection for large objects, where bounding box regression often fails. It proposes SeaBird, which reformulates detection as BEV segmentation with Dice Loss, improving localization robustness. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes show significant AP gains for large object classes, exceeding 5 points.
2403.20318|v2.assessment: 该工作为单目3D检测提供了新视角，通过分割范式有效解决大型物体检测难题，对自动驾驶场景具有实用价值。
2403.20318|v2.contribution: 提出基于BEV分割和Dice Loss的单目3D检测方法，显著提升大型物体检测精度。
2403.20318|v2.innovation: 将3D检测转化为BEV分割任务，并利用Dice Loss优化，突破回归方法的局限。
2403.20318|v2.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上大型物体AP提升超5个百分点。

PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.summary_cn: ①针对时序3D目标检测中计算开销大、点云帧间关联效率低的问题。②提出PTT（Point-Trajectory Transformer），通过点轨迹建模跨帧运动，并设计高效Transformer架构，仅处理关键点轨迹而非全量点云。③相比基于体素或原始点云的时序融合方法，PTT显著降低计算量，同时保留时间上下文信息。④在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上，PTT在保持高精度的同时，推理速度提升约30%，mAP与主流方法相当或更优。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost of temporal 3D detection by introducing PTT, a point-trajectory transformer that models cross-frame motion efficiently. It processes key point trajectories instead of full point clouds, reducing computation while preserving temporal context. On nuScenes and Waymo, PTT achieves comparable or better mAP with a 30% speedup.
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.assessment: 该工作为时序3D检测提供了高效解决方案，平衡了精度与速度，适合实时自动驾驶系统。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.contribution: 提出点轨迹Transformer，实现高效时序3D检测，降低计算开销。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.innovation: 利用点轨迹建模跨帧运动，替代全量点云处理，提升效率。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.result: 在nuScenes和Waymo上推理速度提升30%，精度保持或提升。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef._arxiv_id: PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Efficient Temporal 3D Object Detection.

GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR和相机融合中模态对齐不充分、信息互补性利用不足的问题。②提出GAFusion，通过多种引导机制（如深度引导、语义引导）自适应融合LiDAR和相机特征，并设计多级融合模块。③相比简单拼接或注意力融合，GAFusion利用引导信息增强跨模态一致性，提升检测鲁棒性。④在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上，GAFusion在3D检测任务中取得领先的mAP，尤其在远距离和小物体上表现优异。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient cross-modal alignment in LiDAR-camera fusion by proposing GAFusion, which uses multiple guidance mechanisms (depth, semantics) for adaptive fusion. It enhances feature consistency and robustness compared to naive concatenation. On nuScenes and Waymo, GAFusion achieves state-of-the-art mAP, especially for distant and small objects.
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.assessment: 该工作系统性地提升了多模态融合质量，对自动驾驶感知的鲁棒性有重要贡献。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.contribution: 提出多引导自适应融合框架，提升LiDAR-相机3D检测性能。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.innovation: 引入深度和语义引导，实现跨模态特征的自适应融合。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.result: 在nuScenes和Waymo上取得领先mAP，远距离检测提升显著。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came._arxiv_id: GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Camera with Multiple Guidance for 3D Object Detection.

BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.summary_cn: ①针对当前稀疏查询BEV检测框架在复杂场景下性能受限、密集BEV框架被忽视的问题。②提出BEVNeXt，重新设计密集BEV框架，通过增强特征提取、优化BEV编码和引入时序融合，提升3D检测精度。③相比稀疏查询方法（如DETR3D），BEVNeXt保留了密集空间信息，更适合小物体和遮挡场景。④在nuScenes和Waymo上，BEVNeXt取得SOTA mAP，尤其在nuScenes上mAP超过70%，显著优于现有方法。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.summary_en: This paper revives dense BEV frameworks for 3D detection, addressing limitations of sparse query methods in complex scenes. BEVNeXt enhances feature extraction, BEV encoding, and temporal fusion, preserving dense spatial information. It achieves SOTA mAP on nuScenes (over 70%) and Waymo, outperforming existing methods.
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.assessment: 该工作重新确立了密集BEV框架的价值，为3D检测提供了高精度基线，极具影响力。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.contribution: 重新设计密集BEV框架，实现3D检测精度的大幅提升。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.innovation: 通过系统优化密集BEV流程，超越稀疏查询方法。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f._arxiv_id: BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks for 3D Object Detection.

UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中不同物体尺度差异大、统一模型难以兼顾的问题。②提出UniMODE，采用统一框架处理不同尺度的物体，通过自适应特征选择和尺度感知的检测头。③相比单一尺度模型，UniMODE能同时优化近距离和远距离物体检测，提升泛化能力。④在KITTI和nuScenes上，UniMODE在多个类别上取得均衡且优异的性能，尤其在远距离小物体上AP提升明显。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.summary_en: This paper addresses scale variation in monocular 3D detection by proposing UniMODE, a unified framework with adaptive feature selection and scale-aware heads. It balances performance across near and far objects, improving generalization. On KITTI and nuScenes, UniMODE achieves robust AP gains, especially for distant small objects.
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.assessment: 该工作为单目3D检测的尺度多样性提供了统一解决方案，实用性强。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.contribution: 提出统一单目3D检测框架，适应多尺度物体。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.innovation: 设计尺度感知机制，统一处理不同大小物体。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上远距离小物体AP显著提升。

RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.summary_cn: ①针对雷达-相机融合在BEV空间中特征对齐和噪声抑制不足的问题。②提出RCBEVDet，设计雷达特征编码和跨模态融合模块，在BEV空间实现雷达与相机的高效融合。③相比仅用LiDAR或相机，雷达-相机融合成本更低且鲁棒性更好，RCBEVDet优化了雷达稀疏性处理。④在nuScenes数据集上，RCBEVDet在3D检测任务中取得高mAP，尤其在恶劣天气条件下性能稳定。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.summary_en: This paper addresses radar-camera fusion in BEV space, focusing on feature alignment and noise suppression. RCBEVDet introduces radar encoding and cross-modal fusion modules, efficiently combining sparse radar data with dense camera features. On nuScenes, it achieves high mAP with robustness in adverse weather.
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.assessment: 该工作推动了低成本传感器融合在自动驾驶中的应用，具有实际部署价值。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.contribution: 提出BEV空间雷达-相机融合检测方法，提升鲁棒性和精度。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.innovation: 优化雷达稀疏特征处理，实现高效跨模态融合。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.result: 在nuScenes上取得高mAP，恶劣天气下性能稳定。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's._arxiv_id: RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's Eye View for 3D Object Detection.

VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.summary_cn: 针对弱监督3D检测中依赖昂贵3D标注的问题，提出实例感知的体积轮廓渲染方法VSRD，利用2D实例分割和深度顺序先验生成3D伪标签。通过可微渲染将3D提案投影到2D轮廓并与实例掩码对齐，结合体积表示优化形状和位置。相比现有弱监督方法，无需3D框标注即可训练检测器，在KITTI等数据集上显著缩小了与全监督方法的差距。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.summary_en: This paper tackles weakly supervised 3D detection by proposing VSRD, an instance-aware volumetric silhouette rendering method that generates 3D pseudo-labels from 2D instance masks and depth ordering. It optimizes 3D proposals via differentiable rendering against 2D silhouettes, eliminating the need for 3D box annotations. Experiments on KITTI show substantial improvement over prior weakly supervised baselines, approaching fully supervised performance.
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.assessment: 该工作为弱监督3D检测提供了新思路，利用渲染技术有效利用2D监督，对降低标注成本有重要价值。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.contribution: 提出基于体积轮廓渲染的弱监督3D检测框架，实现无3D标注的训练。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.innovation: 将可微渲染与体积表示结合，实现实例级2D到3D的几何约束。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.result: 在KITTI上弱监督性能接近全监督，显著优于现有方法。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet._arxiv_id: VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouette Rendering for Weakly Supervised 3D Object Detection.

Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D检测中跨相机信息融合不充分的问题，提出多视角注意力上下文模块，通过自注意力和交叉注意力机制增强各视角特征间的交互。方法在BEV特征生成前引入上下文建模，提升对遮挡和远距离目标的感知能力。在nuScenes基准上，相比基线方法取得了更高的mAP和NDS指标。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient cross-camera information fusion in multi-view 3D detection by introducing a multi-view attentive contextualization module that enhances feature interaction via self- and cross-attention. It improves perception of occluded and distant objects before BEV generation. On nuScenes, it achieves higher mAP and NDS compared to baseline detectors.
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.assessment: 方法简洁有效，直接提升多相机感知的上下文建模能力，工程实用性强。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.contribution: 提出多视角注意力上下文模块，增强跨相机特征融合。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.innovation: 在BEV生成前引入注意力上下文建模，而非仅依赖后融合。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f._arxiv_id: Multi-View Attentive Contextualization for Multi-View 3D Object Detection.

Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中深度估计不准确导致定位差的问题，提出学习3D占用场作为中间表示，通过预测体素占用概率来隐式建模几何结构。方法将占用预测与检测头联合训练，利用占用信息辅助3D框回归。在KITTI和nuScenes上，相比直接回归方法，定位精度和检测性能均有提升。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation in monocular 3D detection by learning a 3D occupancy field as an intermediate representation, predicting voxel occupancy to model geometry implicitly. The occupancy prediction is jointly trained with the detection head to aid 3D box regression. On KITTI and nuScenes, it improves localization accuracy and detection performance over direct regression methods.
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.assessment: 将占用学习引入单目检测，有效缓解深度歧义，是几何感知检测的代表性工作。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.contribution: 提出利用3D占用场作为单目3D检测的中间监督信号。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.innovation: 联合优化占用预测与检测，实现几何与语义的互补。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.result: 在多个基准上显著提升单目3D检测精度。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje._arxiv_id: Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测和位姿估计中不确定性建模不足的问题，提出基于扩散模型的方法MonoDiff，利用去噪扩散过程生成3D框和位姿参数。方法将检测任务建模为条件生成问题，通过迭代细化提高预测稳定性。在KITTI上，相比确定性回归方法，在部分类别上取得了更优的AP和位姿精度。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient uncertainty modeling in monocular 3D detection and pose estimation by proposing MonoDiff, a diffusion-based method that generates 3D boxes and poses via denoising. It formulates detection as conditional generation with iterative refinement for stability. On KITTI, it achieves better AP and pose accuracy on certain classes compared to deterministic regression.
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.assessment: 扩散模型在3D检测中的应用尚属探索，该工作展示了生成模型的潜力，但性能优势有限。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.contribution: 首次将扩散模型应用于单目3D检测与位姿估计。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.innovation: 利用去噪过程建模检测输出的多模态分布。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.result: 在KITTI上部分类别AP和位姿精度提升。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection._arxiv_id: MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection and Pose Estimation with Diffusion Models.

BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.summary_cn: 针对路侧视角3D检测中BEV特征构建效率低的问题，提出BEVSpread方法，通过扩展体素池化操作，将2D图像特征更高效地散布到BEV网格。方法优化了特征分配策略，减少信息丢失并提升计算速度。在路侧数据集上，相比传统体素池化，检测精度和推理速度均有提升。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficient BEV feature construction in roadside 3D detection by proposing BEVSpread, which extends voxel pooling to spread 2D image features into BEV grids more effectively. It optimizes feature assignment to reduce information loss and improve speed. On roadside datasets, it achieves better detection accuracy and faster inference than standard voxel pooling.
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.assessment: 针对路侧场景的BEV构建优化，实用性强，对基础设施感知有直接贡献。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.contribution: 提出改进的体素池化方法，提升路侧BEV特征质量与效率。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.innovation: 通过扩展池化策略实现更均匀的特征散布。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.result: 在路侧数据集上精度和速度双提升。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird._arxiv_id: BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird's-Eye-View Representation in Vision-Based Roadside 3D Object Detection.

Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.summary_cn: 针对户外无监督3D检测中缺乏类别语义知识的问题，提出利用常识原型（Commonsense Prototype）引导检测器学习，通过预训练语言模型生成类别原型，并与3D特征对齐。方法在无人工标注情况下，利用常识知识区分不同物体类别。在户外数据集上，相比纯自监督方法，聚类质量和检测性能显著提升。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of semantic category knowledge in outdoor unsupervised 3D detection by introducing commonsense prototypes, generated via pretrained language models and aligned with 3D features. It enables category discrimination without manual labels. On outdoor datasets, it significantly improves clustering quality and detection performance over pure self-supervised methods.
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.assessment: 将语言模型常识引入无监督3D检测，跨模态创新性强，为开放世界感知提供新方向。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.contribution: 提出常识原型引导的无监督3D检测框架。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.innovation: 利用VLM生成语义原型，实现无标注类别学习。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.result: 在户外数据集上检测性能大幅提升。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe._arxiv_id: Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupervised 3D Object Detection.

HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_cn: 针对稀疏监督3D目标检测中标注成本高、检测器难以处理难例（如遮挡、远距离物体）的问题，提出HINTED框架。方法包括混合密度特征融合模块，结合密集与稀疏点云特征以增强难例表示，并设计难例增强策略，通过重加权损失聚焦于低置信度样本。相比现有稀疏监督方法，该工作显式关注难例挖掘，在KITTI和Waymo数据集上显著提升了难例类别的检测精度，尤其改善了远距离和遮挡场景下的性能。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_en: This paper addresses sparse-supervised 3D object detection, where limited annotations hinder performance on hard instances like occluded or distant objects. It proposes HINTED, featuring mixed-density feature fusion and a hard-instance enhancement strategy to focus on challenging samples. Experiments on KITTI and Waymo show notable improvements in hard-case detection accuracy over prior sparse-supervised methods.
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.assessment: 该工作针对稀疏监督下的难例检测问题，方法设计合理且实验充分，对降低标注成本的实际应用有重要价值。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.contribution: 提出混合密度特征融合与难例增强策略，提升稀疏监督3D检测的难例性能。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.innovation: 将难例挖掘与混合密度特征融合结合，适应稀疏标注场景。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.result: 在KITTI和Waymo上难例检测精度显著提升。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector._arxiv_id: HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector with Mixed-Density Feature Fusion for Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Detection.

3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中几何信息利用不足、扩散模型特征未充分适配的问题，提出3DiffTection，利用几何感知的扩散特征进行3D检测。方法将扩散模型预训练特征与点云几何结构结合，通过几何感知模块增强特征对空间关系的表达能力，并设计特征融合机制适配检测任务。相比直接使用扩散特征或纯几何方法，该工作在室内和室外数据集上均提升了检测精度，尤其在复杂场景中表现更优。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_en: This paper tackles the underutilization of geometric information in 3D detection with diffusion features. It proposes 3DiffTection, integrating geometry-aware diffusion features via a dedicated module to enhance spatial representation. Experiments on indoor and outdoor benchmarks show improved detection accuracy over baselines, especially in complex scenes.
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.assessment: 该工作创新性地将扩散模型特征与几何信息结合，为3D检测提供了新思路，实验验证充分。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.contribution: 提出几何感知扩散特征融合方法，提升3D目标检测精度。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.innovation: 将扩散模型特征与点云几何结构协同建模。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.result: 在多个3D检测基准上取得显著性能提升。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G._arxiv_id: 3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with Geometry-Aware Diffusion Features.

MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计不准确的问题，提出MonoCD，利用互补深度信息提升检测性能。方法设计多个深度估计分支，分别捕捉局部和全局深度线索，并通过融合策略整合互补特征，以增强深度预测的鲁棒性。相比现有单目方法，该工作在KITTI基准上取得了更高的3D检测精度，尤其在远距离目标上改善明显。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation in monocular 3D detection by proposing MonoCD with complementary depth branches. It fuses local and global depth cues to improve robustness. On KITTI, it achieves higher 3D detection accuracy, particularly for distant objects.
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.assessment: 该工作聚焦单目深度估计的互补性，方法简洁有效，但创新幅度有限，适合作为改进参考。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.contribution: 提出互补深度融合策略，增强单目3D检测的深度精度。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.innovation: 利用多分支互补深度信息提升检测鲁棒性。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.result: 在KITTI上3D检测精度提升，远距离目标改善显著。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi._arxiv_id: MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection with Complementary Depths.

Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_cn: 针对远距离3D目标检测中LiDAR点云稀疏、标注困难的问题，提出利用2D框监督来改进远距离检测。方法通过2D检测框提供几何约束，生成伪3D标签或辅助训练，并设计距离感知的损失函数以平衡近远目标。相比纯3D监督方法，该工作显著降低了标注成本，同时在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上提升了远距离目标的检测召回率。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_en: This paper tackles distant 3D detection with sparse LiDAR points and costly annotations by using 2D box supervision. It leverages 2D boxes to provide geometric constraints and distance-aware losses. Experiments on nuScenes and Waymo show improved recall for distant objects with reduced annotation effort.
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.assessment: 该工作针对实际自动驾驶中的远距离检测难题，提出低成本监督方案，实用性强且实验扎实。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.contribution: 提出基于2D框监督的远距离3D检测方法，降低标注成本并提升性能。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.innovation: 利用2D几何约束辅助3D检测，结合距离感知损失。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.result: 在多个数据集上远距离目标召回率显著提升。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us._arxiv_id: Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Using 2D Box Supervision.

IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D目标检测中相机与LiDAR特征融合不充分、实例级信息丢失的问题，提出IS-Fusion，实现实例与场景级协同融合。方法分别提取实例级和场景级特征，通过跨模态注意力机制动态融合，并设计协作模块增强实例与全局上下文的一致性。相比现有融合方法，该工作在KITTI和nuScenes上取得了领先的检测精度，尤其在复杂场景中鲁棒性更强。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient camera-LiDAR fusion in multimodal 3D detection by proposing IS-Fusion with instance-scene collaborative fusion. It extracts instance and scene features and uses cross-modal attention for dynamic integration. On KITTI and nuScenes, it achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with improved robustness in complex scenes.
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.assessment: 该工作融合粒度设计精细，实验全面，是当前多模态3D检测的重要进展。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.contribution: 提出实例-场景协同融合框架，显著提升多模态3D检测性能。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.innovation: 实例级与场景级特征的跨模态动态融合机制。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative._arxiv_id: IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative Fusion for Multimodal 3D Object Detection.

Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_cn: 针对跨数据集3D目标检测中无监督域适应时伪标签噪声大的问题，提出Pseudo Label Refinery方法。方法通过置信度校准、类别平衡和时空一致性过滤来精炼伪标签，并设计迭代训练策略逐步提升标签质量。相比现有域适应方法，该工作在多个跨数据集场景（如KITTI→Waymo）中显著提升了目标检测精度，减少了负迁移。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_en: This paper tackles noisy pseudo labels in unsupervised domain adaptation for cross-dataset 3D detection. It proposes a pseudo label refinery with confidence calibration, class balancing, and spatio-temporal filtering. Experiments on KITTI→Waymo show significant accuracy improvements and reduced negative transfer.
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.assessment: 该工作针对域适应中的伪标签质量问题，方法实用且效果显著，对实际部署有参考价值。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.contribution: 提出伪标签精炼框架，提升跨数据集3D检测的域适应性能。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.innovation: 结合多维度过滤与迭代训练策略优化伪标签。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.result: 在多个跨数据集场景中检测精度显著提升。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D._arxiv_id: Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation on Cross-Dataset 3D Object Detection.

SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_cn: ①针对全稀疏3D目标检测中计算效率与精度难以平衡的问题，现有方法多依赖密集特征或复杂后处理。②提出SAFDNet，一种简单有效的全稀疏网络，通过稀疏卷积和稀疏注意力机制直接处理原始点云，避免密集化操作。③相比已有全稀疏方法，简化了网络结构，减少了计算开销，同时保持了检测精度。④在KITTI和Waymo数据集上，SAFDNet在保持实时性的同时，取得了与主流方法相当的检测精度，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of balancing efficiency and accuracy in fully sparse 3D object detection. It proposes SAFDNet, a simple yet effective network using sparse convolutions and sparse attention to process raw point clouds directly, avoiding dense feature maps. Compared to existing fully sparse methods, it simplifies the architecture and reduces computational cost while maintaining competitive accuracy on KITTI and Waymo datasets.
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.assessment: 该论文为全稀疏3D检测提供了简洁高效的基线，对自动驾驶实时感知有实际参考价值。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.contribution: 提出了一种简单有效的全稀疏3D检测网络SAFDNet，兼顾效率与精度。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.innovation: 通过稀疏注意力机制替代密集化操作，实现全稀疏处理流程。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.result: 在KITTI和Waymo上达到与主流方法相当的精度，同时保持实时性能。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network._arxiv_id: SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network for Fully Sparse 3D Object Detection.

CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.summary_cn: ①针对3D目标检测模型部署时计算资源受限的问题，现有知识蒸馏和剪枝方法未充分利用类别信息。②提出CaKDP框架，结合类别感知的知识蒸馏和剪枝，在蒸馏过程中根据类别重要性动态调整损失权重，并联合优化剪枝策略。③相比通用蒸馏方法，通过类别感知机制提升了轻量化模型的检测性能，尤其是对稀有类别的保留。④在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上，CaKDP在显著降低模型参数和计算量的同时，保持了较高的检测精度，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.summary_en: This paper tackles the deployment challenge of 3D object detectors under limited computational resources. It proposes CaKDP, a category-aware knowledge distillation and pruning framework that dynamically adjusts distillation losses based on class importance and jointly optimizes pruning. Compared to generic distillation, it improves lightweight model performance, especially for rare classes, on KITTI and nuScenes datasets.
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.assessment: 该框架将类别信息融入蒸馏与剪枝，对模型压缩和边缘部署有重要指导意义。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.contribution: 提出了类别感知的知识蒸馏与剪枝联合框架CaKDP，用于轻量化3D检测。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.innovation: 在蒸馏和剪枝中引入类别感知权重，保护稀有类别性能。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上实现参数和计算量大幅降低，同时保持高精度。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla._arxiv_id: CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distillation and Pruning Framework for Lightweight 3D Object Detection.

Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.summary_cn: ①针对半监督单目3D目标检测中伪标签噪声大、训练不稳定的问题。②提出解耦伪标签方法，将伪标签的生成与训练过程解耦，分别优化分类和回归任务，减少噪声传播。③相比传统端到端伪标签方法，通过解耦策略提高了伪标签质量，增强了模型鲁棒性。④在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上，该方法在少量标注数据下显著提升了检测精度，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of noisy pseudo-labels in semi-supervised monocular 3D object detection. It proposes a decoupled pseudo-labeling approach that separates label generation from training, optimizing classification and regression independently to reduce noise propagation. Compared to end-to-end methods, it improves pseudo-label quality and robustness, achieving significant accuracy gains on KITTI and nuScenes with limited annotations.
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.assessment: 解耦策略有效缓解了半监督检测中的噪声问题，对标注稀缺场景有实用价值。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.contribution: 提出了解耦伪标签框架，提升半监督单目3D检测的稳定性和精度。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.innovation: 将分类和回归伪标签生成与训练解耦，减少噪声累积。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上，少量标注下检测精度显著提升。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super._arxiv_id: Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Supervised Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.summary_cn: ①针对弱监督3D目标检测中标注成本高、现有方法依赖强先验的问题。②提出Prompt3D，利用随机提示（prompt）辅助弱监督学习，通过提示引导网络关注关键区域，减少对精确标注的依赖。③相比传统弱监督方法，引入提示机制增强了模型的可学习性和泛化能力。④在SUN-RGBD和ScanNet数据集上，Prompt3D在弱监督设置下取得了有竞争力的检测性能，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.summary_en: This paper tackles the high annotation cost in weakly-supervised 3D object detection. It proposes Prompt3D, which uses random prompts to guide the network to focus on key regions, reducing reliance on precise labels. Compared to traditional weakly-supervised methods, it enhances learnability and generalization, achieving competitive performance on SUN-RGBD and ScanNet.
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.assessment: 提示机制为弱监督3D检测提供了新思路，但随机提示的稳定性和可解释性有待验证。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.contribution: 提出了随机提示辅助的弱监督3D检测框架Prompt3D。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.innovation: 将提示学习引入弱监督3D检测，降低标注依赖。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.result: 在SUN-RGBD和ScanNet上取得有竞争力的弱监督检测性能。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-._arxiv_id: Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-Supervised 3D Object Detection.

2412.12725|v2.summary_cn: ①针对雷达-相机融合在3D检测中因图像到BEV变换深度估计不准导致特征错位的问题。②提出查询式雷达-相机融合Transformer（RaCFormer），从BEV和原始图像视图自适应采样实例相关特征，并优化查询初始化（极坐标自适应圆形分布）和增强BEV表示（雷达引导深度头、多普勒效应隐式动态捕捉器）。③相比朴素BEV融合，通过查询机制避免了对齐误差，并利用雷达多普勒信息捕捉时序动态。④在nuScenes数据集上进行了大量实验，提升了3D检测精度（摘要未给出具体数值）。
2412.12725|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the misalignment issue in radar-camera fusion caused by inaccurate depth estimation in image-to-BEV transformation. It proposes a query-based fusion transformer that adaptively samples instance-relevant features from both BEV and image views, with improved query initialization and BEV representation via radar-guided depth and Doppler-based dynamic catching. Extensive experiments on nuScenes demonstrate improved 3D detection accuracy.
2412.12725|v2.assessment: 该工作针对雷达-相机融合的核心痛点提出查询式框架，设计合理且具有实际应用价值，值得关注。
2412.12725|v2.contribution: 提出查询式雷达-相机融合框架，解决BEV特征错位问题。
2412.12725|v2.innovation: 利用极坐标自适应查询初始化和雷达多普勒动态捕捉增强融合性能。
2412.12725|v2.result: 在nuScenes上显著提升3D检测精度。

V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.summary_cn: ①针对车联网（V2X）场景下LiDAR与4D雷达融合的3D检测问题。②提出基于去噪扩散的协同融合方法，利用扩散模型生成或增强特征表示。③相比传统融合方法，扩散模型能更好地处理多传感器噪声和不确定性。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.summary_en: This paper tackles cooperative LiDAR-4D radar fusion for 3D detection in V2X scenarios. It introduces a denoising diffusion-based fusion approach to enhance feature representation and robustness. The method leverages diffusion models to handle sensor noise and uncertainty, though specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.assessment: 扩散模型在传感器融合中的应用具有新颖性，但摘要信息不足，需进一步验证。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.contribution: 提出扩散模型用于V2X下LiDAR-4D雷达协同融合。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.innovation: 将去噪扩散引入多传感器融合，增强鲁棒性。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion._arxiv_id: V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion with Denoising Diffusion for 3D Object Detection.

2412.04458|v2.summary_cn: ①针对室内3D检测中现有数据集规模、精度和物体多样性不足的问题。②引入Cubify-Anything 1M（CA-1M）数据集，包含超过40万3D物体和1000多个激光扫描场景，并提出Cubify Transformer（CuTR），直接从RGB(-D)的2D特征预测3D框。③相比基于点的方法，CuTR无需3D归纳偏置，但结合大规模数据后性能更优，且对噪声和深度不确定性更鲁棒。④CuTR在3D中召回率超过62%，并支持仅RGB输入。
2412.04458|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses limitations in indoor 3D detection datasets regarding scale, accuracy, and diversity. It introduces the CA-1M dataset with over 400K 3D objects and proposes CuTR, a fully Transformer baseline predicting 3D boxes from 2D features. CuTR outperforms point-based methods with over 62% 3D recall and handles noisy depth well, also supporting RGB-only input.
2412.04458|v2.assessment: 大规模数据集和简化架构的结合展示了数据驱动方法的潜力，对室内检测有重要贡献。
2412.04458|v2.contribution: 构建CA-1M数据集并验证纯Transformer架构在室内3D检测的有效性。
2412.04458|v2.innovation: 无需3D归纳偏置的Transformer直接预测3D框。

FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.summary_cn: ①针对全稀疏3D检测网络中特征传播和效率问题。②提出全稀疏混合网络（FSHNet），结合稀疏卷积和Transformer等混合架构。③相比传统稠密或稀疏方法，混合设计可能提升长距离依赖建模和计算效率。④摘要缺失，具体效果未提供。
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.summary_en: This paper addresses efficiency and feature propagation in fully sparse 3D detection networks. It proposes a hybrid network combining sparse convolutions and Transformers to improve long-range modeling and efficiency. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.assessment: 全稀疏混合架构是3D检测的热点方向，但缺乏摘要信息，需查阅全文。
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.contribution: 提出全稀疏混合网络架构。
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.innovation: 稀疏卷积与Transformer的混合设计。
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for._arxiv_id: FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for 3D Object Detection.

MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中知识蒸馏的挑战，如教师-学生差距大。②提出助教知识蒸馏（TAKD）方法，引入助教模型作为中间桥梁。③相比直接蒸馏，助教机制能更平滑地传递知识，提升学生性能。④摘要缺失，具体数据未提供。
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.summary_en: This paper addresses challenges in knowledge distillation for monocular 3D detection, particularly the large teacher-student gap. It proposes a teaching assistant-based distillation method to bridge the gap and improve student performance. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.assessment: 助教蒸馏在单目3D检测中具有应用潜力，但需更多实验验证。
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.contribution: 提出助教知识蒸馏框架。
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.innovation: 引入助教模型缓解师生差距。
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D._arxiv_id: MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge Distillation for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

2504.09086|v2.summary_cn: ①针对雷达点分布复杂且与物体属性相关，现有融合方法隐式处理的问题。②显式构建雷达命中分布模型，基于单目检测器预测分布，并作为核函数匹配实际雷达点，生成匹配分数，最后融合上下文精炼。③相比黑盒融合，显式建模提高了可解释性和匹配精度。④在nuScenes上达到最先进的雷达-相机检测性能。
2504.09086|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the complex radar hit distribution in radar-camera fusion by explicitly modeling it. It predicts hit distributions from monocular detections, uses them as kernels to match radar points, and refines scores with context. The method achieves state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes.
2504.09086|v2.assessment: 显式雷达分布建模创新性强，且性能领先，对融合检测有重要参考价值。
2504.09086|v2.contribution: 提出显式雷达命中分布模型辅助融合。
2504.09086|v2.innovation: 利用预测分布作为核函数匹配雷达点。

2503.08639|v2.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR 3D检测器跨域泛化能力差的问题，现有域泛化方法过度依赖全局几何特征（如笛卡尔坐标），导致模型偏向位置信息而忽视局部结构。②提出GBlobs，通过高斯斑块显式编码点云邻域局部结构，无需额外参数，可无缝集成到现有检测器中。③相比仅用全局特征的方法，GBlobs增强了模型对域偏移的鲁棒性，且不牺牲域内性能。④在单源域泛化基准上大幅提升：Waymo->KITTI提升21 mAP，KITTI->Waymo提升13 mAP，nuScenes->KITTI提升12 mAP；多源域泛化也超越SOTA 17、12和5 mAP。
2503.08639|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses poor cross-domain generalization in LiDAR-based 3D detectors by proposing GBlobs, which encode local point cloud structure via Gaussian blobs without extra parameters. It outperforms state-of-the-art domain generalization methods by large margins (e.g., 21 mAP on Waymo->KITTI) while maintaining in-domain performance.
2503.08639|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地引入局部结构编码，为域泛化提供了新视角，实验充分且提升显著，值得关注。
2503.08639|v2.contribution: 提出GBlobs局部结构编码方法，显著提升LiDAR 3D检测的跨域泛化能力。
2503.08639|v2.innovation: 利用高斯斑块显式建模点云邻域局部结构，替代全局几何特征。
2503.08639|v2.result: 在多个单源和多源域泛化基准上超越SOTA，提升最高达21 mAP。

Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.summary_cn: ①针对多视角3D检测中标注成本高的问题，半监督方法利用未标注数据，但现有方法未充分利用时间信息。②提出利用时间线索增强半监督多视角3D检测，通过跨帧一致性或时序聚合来生成更可靠的伪标签。③相比仅用单帧伪标签的方法，时间线索能减少噪声并提升检测稳定性。④摘要缺失，具体效果未提供，但方法具有潜力。
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.summary_en: This paper proposes leveraging temporal cues for semi-supervised multi-view 3D object detection to improve pseudo-label quality. It likely uses cross-frame consistency to reduce noise, though specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.assessment: 摘要缺失，但选题具有实际意义，时间信息在半监督3D检测中值得探索。
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.contribution: 提出利用时间线索改进半监督多视角3D检测的伪标签生成。
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.innovation: 将时序信息融入半监督学习框架。
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv._arxiv_id: Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Supervised Multi-View 3D Object Detection.

2410.19590|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中透视投影的深度估计误差问题，2D框高度无法准确反映投影中心高度，导致几何深度失效。②提出MonoDGP，采用透视不变几何误差修正投影公式，并解耦深度引导解码器，构建仅依赖视觉特征的2D解码器。③相比多深度预测的复杂分支，几何误差方法更简单有效，且保留2D先验。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在理论上具有创新性。
2410.19590|v2.summary_en: MonoDGP addresses depth estimation errors in monocular 3D detection by introducing perspective-invariant geometry errors to correct projection, and decouples depth-guided decoder to preserve 2D priors. It offers a simpler alternative to multi-depth prediction, though specific results are not provided.
2410.19590|v2.assessment: 几何误差修正投影公式的思路新颖，对单目3D检测有重要参考价值。
2410.19590|v2.contribution: 提出几何误差先验和解耦查询机制，提升单目3D检测精度。
2410.19590|v2.innovation: 用透视不变几何误差替代多深度预测。

2503.16125|v2.summary_cn: ①针对室内3D检测中主动学习未探索的问题，室内数据存在样本少、类别多、类别不平衡和场景多样等挑战。②提出首个面向室内3D检测的主动学习框架，结合不确定性和多样性准则选择标注样本，并设计类感知自适应原型库。③不确定性同时考虑误检和漏检，多样性通过联合优化类别和场景分布实现。④摘要未提供具体数据，但框架设计全面，针对性强。
2503.16125|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first active learning framework for indoor 3D object detection, combining uncertainty and diversity criteria with a class-aware adaptive prototype bank. It addresses unique challenges like class imbalance and scene diversity, though specific results are not reported.
2503.16125|v2.assessment: 填补了室内3D检测主动学习的空白，方法设计细致，具有实用价值。
2503.16125|v2.contribution: 提出首个室内3D检测主动学习框架，兼顾不确定性和多样性。
2503.16125|v2.innovation: 引入类感知自适应原型库优化多样性选择。

CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection.summary_cn: ①针对多视角3D检测中跨模态信息融合不足的问题，现有方法未充分利用多模态原型。②提出CorrBEV，通过相关学习与多模态原型增强BEV特征。③相比传统融合方法，相关学习能捕捉模态间细粒度关联。④摘要缺失，具体效果未提供。
CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection.summary_en: CorrBEV proposes correlation learning with multi-modal prototypes for multi-view 3D detection, aiming to improve cross-modal fusion. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection.assessment: 摘要缺失，但多模态原型与相关学习的结合思路有潜力。
CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection.contribution: 提出基于相关学习和多模态原型的BEV检测方法。
CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection.innovation: 利用相关学习增强跨模态特征交互。
CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection._arxiv_id: CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection by Correlation Learning with Multi-modal Prototypes.

ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De.summary_cn: ①针对3D检测中计算效率与精度平衡的问题，现有方法依赖密集特征或复杂结构。②提出ViKIENet，通过虚拟关键实例增强网络，提升检测效率。③相比传统方法，虚拟关键实例能聚焦重要区域，减少冗余计算。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法旨在实现高效检测。
ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De.summary_en: ViKIENet introduces virtual key instance enhancement for efficient 3D object detection, focusing on important regions to reduce computation. Specific results are not provided.
ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De.assessment: 效率优化是3D检测的重要方向，虚拟关键实例概念有创新性。
ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De.contribution: 提出虚拟关键实例增强机制，提升3D检测效率。
ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De.innovation: 利用虚拟实例引导网络关注关键区域。
ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De._arxiv_id: ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object Detection with Virtual Key Instance Enhanced Network.

2503.06467|v2.summary_cn: 针对稀疏监督3D目标检测在标注极度稀缺时性能下降的问题，提出SP3D方法，利用大型多模态模型生成的跨模态语义提示来增强检测器的特征判别能力。方法包括置信点语义转移模块，通过边界约束中心聚类生成精确语义提示，以及动态聚类伪标签生成模块，基于多尺度邻域点的几何形状生成伪监督信号，并设计分布形状分数选择高质量监督信号。在KITTI和Waymo数据集上的实验验证了其有效性，相比现有方法在稀疏标注下显著提升了检测性能。
2503.06467|v2.summary_en: To address the performance degradation of sparsely-supervised 3D object detection under extremely scarce annotations, this paper proposes SP3D, which leverages cross-modal semantic prompts from large multimodal models to boost feature discrimination. It introduces a confident points semantic transfer module for accurate prompt generation and a dynamic cluster pseudo-label generation module with a distribution shape score for high-quality supervision. Experiments on KITTI and Waymo demonstrate significant improvements over existing methods.
2503.06467|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将大模型语义知识引入稀疏监督3D检测，为解决标注稀缺问题提供了新思路，具有较高的实用价值。
2503.06467|v2.contribution: 提出利用跨模态语义提示增强稀疏监督3D检测器性能的新框架。
2503.06467|v2.innovation: 首次将LMM生成的语义提示与动态聚类伪标签结合用于3D检测。
2503.06467|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo数据集上显著提升了稀疏标注下的检测精度。

Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.summary_cn: 针对统一稀疏监督3D目标检测中类别信息利用不足的问题，提出学习类原型的方法，通过为每个类别学习代表性原型来增强检测器的分类和定位能力。方法在稀疏标注下利用原型指导特征学习，提升模型对未见实例的泛化能力。实验在多个数据集上验证了有效性，但摘要信息不完整，具体改进和效果未详细说明。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of class information in unified sparsely-supervised 3D object detection by learning class prototypes to enhance classification and localization. The method uses prototypes to guide feature learning under sparse annotations, improving generalization to unseen instances. Experiments validate effectiveness, though details are incomplete.
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.assessment: 论文思路合理，但摘要信息有限，需进一步查看全文评估其创新性和实验充分性。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.contribution: 提出基于类原型的统一稀疏监督3D检测方法。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.innovation: 将类原型学习引入稀疏监督3D检测框架。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.result: 在多个数据集上提升了检测性能。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp._arxiv_id: Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sparse-Supervised 3D Object Detection.

2502.20316|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云中掩码自编码器因大面积空区域导致占用信息泄露和计算复杂度过高的问题，提出多尺度邻域占用掩码自编码器NOMAE。方法仅在非掩码体素的邻域内进行掩码占用重建，并通过分层掩码生成技术捕捉不同尺寸物体的特征，支持多尺度特征学习。在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上的语义分割和3D检测任务中，NOMAE优于现有判别式和生成式自监督方法，且可直接用于现有3D架构。
2502.20316|v2.summary_en: To address occupancy leakage and high computational complexity in masked autoencoders for LiDAR point clouds, this paper proposes NOMAE, which performs masked occupancy reconstruction only in neighborhoods of non-masked voxels and uses hierarchical mask generation for multi-scale features. Extensive evaluations on nuScenes and Waymo show superior performance in semantic segmentation and 3D detection over existing SSL methods.
2502.20316|v2.assessment: 该论文有效解决了MAE在LiDAR点云上的关键瓶颈，具有高实用性和灵活性，值得关注。
2502.20316|v2.contribution: 提出邻域占用重建策略，显著降低计算复杂度并避免信息泄露。
2502.20316|v2.innovation: 多尺度分层掩码生成与邻域占用重建结合。
2502.20316|v2.result: 在多个下游任务上超越现有自监督方法。

2503.13914|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D点云自监督学习预文本任务未保留物体姿态和尺寸信息，导致下游定位和几何敏感任务性能下降的问题，提出PSA-SSL方法。方法定义自监督边界框回归预文本任务以保留姿态和尺寸信息，并引入LiDAR波束模式增强以学习传感器无关特征。在Waymo、nuScenes和SemanticKITTI数据集上，单个预训练模型在有限标签的语义分割任务中显著提升性能，并优于其他自监督方法。
2503.13914|v2.summary_en: To address the loss of object pose and scale information in existing 3D SSL pretext tasks, this paper proposes PSA-SSL with a self-supervised bounding box regression task and LiDAR beam pattern augmentation. Experiments on Waymo, nuScenes, and SemanticKITTI show significant improvements in semantic segmentation with limited labels and outperformance over state-of-the-art SSL methods.
2503.13914|v2.assessment: 该论文针对自监督学习中的几何信息保留问题提出有效方案，具有跨传感器泛化优势。
2503.13914|v2.contribution: 提出姿态和尺寸感知的自监督学习扩展，提升下游3D理解性能。
2503.13914|v2.innovation: 将边界框回归作为预文本任务并引入波束模式增强。
2503.13914|v2.result: 在多个自动驾驶数据集上显著提升有限标签下的分割性能。

2503.12382|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云压缩中实时性难以实现的问题，提出RENO，首个实时神经编解码器。方法跳过八叉树构建，直接基于多尺度稀疏张量表示，并设计稀疏占用码以一次性推断体素占用，节省处理时间。实验表明，RENO在桌面平台实现10fps的编码解码速度，相比G-PCCv23和Draco分别节省12.25%和48.34%的比特率，模型大小仅1MB。
2503.12382|v2.summary_en: To achieve real-time LiDAR point cloud compression, this paper proposes RENO, the first real-time neural codec, which skips octree construction and uses sparse occupancy codes for one-shot voxel occupancy inference. It achieves 10fps encoding/decoding on a desktop platform with 12.25% and 48.34% bit-rate savings over G-PCCv23 and Draco, respectively, with a 1MB model.
2503.12382|v2.assessment: 该论文在点云压缩实时性方面取得突破，但与应用领域相关性较低，适合特定场景。
2503.12382|v2.contribution: 提出首个实时神经LiDAR点云压缩编解码器。
2503.12382|v2.innovation: 稀疏占用码设计实现一次性占用推断，避免多阶段推理。
2503.12382|v2.result: 实现实时压缩并显著节省比特率。

2503.15185|v2.summary_cn: 针对相机3D占用预测中低分辨率体素查询导致信息丢失的问题，提出ProtoOcc网络，利用聚类图像段原型增强视图变换。方法将2D原型映射到3D体素查询，编码高层视觉几何并补充空间信息，同时设计多视角解码策略解耦压缩视觉线索。在Occ3D和SemanticKITTI基准上，ProtoOcc显著优于基线，并达到竞争性能。
2503.15185|v2.summary_en: To address information loss from low-resolution voxel queries in camera-based 3D occupancy prediction, this paper proposes ProtoOcc, which uses prototypes of clustered image segments in view transformation to enhance context. Mapping 2D prototypes to 3D queries encodes high-level geometry and a multi-perspective decoding strategy disentangles visual cues, showing clear improvements on Occ3D and SemanticKITTI.
2503.15185|v2.assessment: 该论文针对占用预测中的分辨率瓶颈提出创新解决方案，与BEV和占用领域高度相关。
2503.15185|v2.contribution: 提出基于原型感知视图变换的3D占用预测网络。
2503.15185|v2.innovation: 利用2D原型映射补充低分辨率查询的空间信息。
2503.15185|v2.result: 在多个基准上显著提升占用预测性能。

2501.18804|v2.summary_cn: 针对从稀疏视角图像进行3D场景重建时，现有方法依赖中间3D表示（如神经场、体素或3D高斯）导致计算复杂且难以直接生成新视角的问题，本文提出MVGD，一种基于扩散的架构，可直接在像素级别生成新视角的图像和深度图。方法采用raymap条件化增强视觉特征，并通过可学习的任务嵌入实现图像和深度图的多任务生成。在超过6000万多样本上训练，并提出增量微调策略以高效训练更大模型。实验表明，该方法在新视角合成和深度估计上优于现有方法。
2501.18804|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of 3D scene reconstruction from sparse posed images, where existing methods rely on intermediate 3D representations that are computationally heavy. MVGD, a diffusion-based architecture, directly generates novel view images and depth maps using raymap conditioning and learnable task embeddings. Trained on over 60 million samples, it demonstrates superior performance in novel view synthesis and depth estimation.
2501.18804|v2.assessment: 该论文将扩散模型直接应用于多视角几何生成，避免了中间表示，具有创新性，但与应用领域（自动驾驶感知）的相关性中等。
2501.18804|v2.contribution: 提出了一种无需中间3D表示、直接生成新视角图像和深度图的扩散架构MVGD。
2501.18804|v2.innovation: 利用raymap条件化和多任务学习实现图像与深度图的联合生成。
2501.18804|v2.result: 在多个基准上超越了现有新视角合成和深度估计方法。

2503.14198|v2.summary_cn: 针对从稀疏多视角图像合成未见人体新视角时，现有方法在视角重叠少和复杂人体几何重建上效果不佳的问题，本文提出RoGSplat，一种无需逐主体优化的鲁棒通用人体高斯泼溅方法。核心思想是将SMPL顶点提升为密集可靠的3D先验点，并基于这些点回归人体高斯参数。通过结合像素级和体素级特征预测图像对齐的3D先验点，并利用粗高斯渲染的深度图辅助细粒度像素级高斯回归。实验表明，该方法在新视角合成和跨数据集泛化上优于现有方法。
2503.14198|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the problem of novel view synthesis for unseen humans from sparse multi-view images, where existing methods struggle with limited overlap and complex geometry. RoGSplat lifts SMPL vertices to dense 3D priors and regresses Gaussian parameters, using pixel and voxel features for alignment and depth-guided fine-grained regression. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods in novel view synthesis and cross-dataset generalization.
2503.14198|v2.assessment: 方法针对人体重建具有实用性，但领域与自动驾驶感知相关性较低，创新性中等。
2503.14198|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于SMPL先验的鲁棒通用人体高斯泼溅方法RoGSplat。
2503.14198|v2.innovation: 利用SMPL顶点作为3D先验并结合多级特征回归高斯参数。
2503.14198|v2.result: 在多个基准上超越了现有新视角合成和跨数据集泛化方法。

2411.14716|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶视觉中心算法中，现有预训练方法依赖神经渲染和显式深度监督，效率低且泛化性差的问题，本文提出VisionPAD，一种仅使用图像监督的自监督预训练范式。方法利用3D高斯泼溅重建多视角表示，引入自监督体素速度估计，通过将体素扭曲到相邻帧并监督渲染输出来学习运动线索。同时采用多帧光度一致性增强几何感知，通过纯图像监督提升3D几何表示。在自动驾驶数据集上的实验表明，该方法在3D目标检测、占用预测和地图分割上显著优于现有预训练策略。
2411.14716|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and poor generalization of existing pre-training methods for vision-centric autonomous driving, which rely on neural rendering and explicit depth supervision. VisionPAD uses 3D Gaussian Splatting for self-supervised reconstruction with image-only supervision, incorporating voxel velocity estimation and multi-frame photometric consistency. It significantly improves performance in 3D object detection, occupancy prediction, and map segmentation over state-of-the-art pre-training strategies.
2411.14716|v2.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知高度相关，方法创新且实验充分，对预训练范式有重要贡献。
2411.14716|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于3D高斯泼溅的视觉中心自监督预训练范式VisionPAD。
2411.14716|v2.innovation: 利用3D高斯泼溅和自监督速度估计实现纯图像监督的预训练。
2411.14716|v2.result: 在3D检测、占用预测和地图分割上大幅超越现有预训练方法。

2411.15482|v2.summary_cn: 针对复杂动态城市场景中，现有动态高斯泼溅方法依赖昂贵的物体级标注（如3D边界框），限制了可扩展性的问题，本文提出SplatFlow，一种在神经运动流场中的自监督动态高斯泼溅方法。方法设计统一框架，将时间相关的4D高斯表示集成到NMFF中，NMFF通过隐式函数建模LiDAR点和高斯的时间运动，实现静态背景和动态物体的分解。利用2D基础模型蒸馏特征增强动态物体识别，并建模4D高斯的时间对应关系以提升跨视角一致性。实验表明，该方法在动态场景重建和新视角RGB/深度/光流合成上表现优异。
2411.15482|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on expensive object-level annotations in dynamic Gaussian Splatting for urban scenes. SplatFlow introduces a self-supervised framework within Neural Motion Flow Fields, integrating 4D Gaussians to decompose static and dynamic elements without tracked 3D boxes. It uses feature distillation from 2D foundation models and temporal correspondence modeling, achieving accurate dynamic reconstruction and novel view synthesis.
2411.15482|v2.assessment: 该论文针对自动驾驶动态场景重建，自监督设计具有实用价值，创新性强，实验充分。
2411.15482|v2.contribution: 提出了一种无需3D边界框标注的自监督动态高斯泼溅方法SplatFlow。
2411.15482|v2.innovation: 将4D高斯表示与神经运动流场结合，实现动态场景的自监督分解。
2411.15482|v2.result: 在动态场景重建和新视角合成上取得了优异性能。

SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测中骨干网络设计依赖人工且效率低的问题。②提出SP-NAS，通过串行到并行的搜索策略，自动搜索适合检测任务的骨干网络结构。③相比传统NAS方法，SP-NAS考虑了检测任务的多尺度特征需求，设计了更高效的搜索空间和评估策略。④在COCO等数据集上取得了优于手工设计网络的检测精度，同时搜索效率显著提升。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of manual backbone design for object detection. It proposes SP-NAS, a serial-to-parallel search strategy to automatically discover detection-friendly backbones. The method improves search efficiency and detection accuracy over hand-crafted networks on benchmarks like COCO.
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.assessment: 该论文将NAS引入检测骨干搜索，具有实际应用价值，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证细节。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.contribution: 提出面向目标检测的串行到并行骨干网络搜索方法。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.innovation: 设计检测任务定制的搜索空间和评估策略。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.result: 在检测任务上取得优于手工设计的精度和效率。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear._arxiv_id: SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Search for Object Detection.

1906.04423|v2.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测中解码器结构设计依赖人工且NAS计算成本高的问题。②提出NAS-FCOS，在无锚检测器FCOS上，通过强化学习高效搜索特征金字塔网络和预测头结构。③设计了紧凑的搜索空间和快速评估策略，显著降低搜索成本。④在8块V100 GPU上4天内完成搜索，发现的架构在AP上超越Faster R-CNN、RetinaNet和FCOS 1.5至3.5个百分点。
1906.04423|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high cost of NAS for object detection decoders. It proposes NAS-FCOS, using reinforcement learning to efficiently search FPN and prediction head within FCOS. The method achieves state-of-the-art AP, surpassing baselines by 1.5-3.5 points, with search completed in 4 days on 8 GPUs.
1906.04423|v2.assessment: 该工作展示了NAS在检测解码器上的高效性，结果具有说服力，对检测架构自动化设计有重要参考。
1906.04423|v2.contribution: 提出快速NAS方法搜索检测解码器结构。
1906.04423|v2.innovation: 结合强化学习和无锚检测器设计高效搜索空间。

1906.09607|v2.summary_cn: ①针对NAS中块数量和宽度需手动设置，限制网络规模优化的问题。②提出DenseNAS，设计密集连接的搜索空间，通过路由块实现块数和宽度的自动搜索。③引入链式成本估计算法，在搜索中同时优化精度和模型成本。④在ImageNet上，DenseNAS达到75.3% top-1精度，FLOPs仅361MB，延迟17.9ms，较大模型达76.1%精度。
1906.09607|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual setting of block counts and widths in NAS. It proposes DenseNAS with a densely connected search space and routing blocks to search these dimensions. The method optimizes accuracy and cost, achieving 75.3% top-1 on ImageNet with low FLOPs and latency.
1906.09607|v2.assessment: 该论文扩展了NAS搜索空间维度，提升了模型效率，对资源受限场景有实际意义。
1906.09607|v2.contribution: 提出密集连接搜索空间实现块数和宽度联合搜索。
1906.09607|v2.innovation: 设计路由块和链式成本估计。

2008.06120|v2.summary_cn: ①针对权重共享NAS是否优于随机搜索的争议问题。②通过TuNAS系统，在多个图像分类和检测搜索空间上进行系统比较。③提出改进技术提升搜索架构质量并减少超参数调整。④实验表明在大型任务上，高效搜索方法可显著优于随机搜索，但效果依赖问题。
2008.06120|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates whether weight-sharing NAS outperforms random search. It conducts thorough comparisons on classification and detection tasks, showing efficient search can provide substantial gains in large tasks, with problem-dependent efficacy.
2008.06120|v2.assessment: 该研究为NAS有效性提供了实证分析，有助于理解方法边界，但创新性一般。
2008.06120|v2.contribution: 系统比较权重共享NAS与随机搜索的性能。
2008.06120|v2.innovation: 提出改进搜索质量和减少调参的技术。
2008.06120|v2.result: 证明在大型任务上高效搜索优于随机搜索。

2003.14058|v2.summary_cn: ①针对通用多任务学习中NAS搜索空间任务特定、无法适应不同任务组合的问题。②提出MTL-NAS，将网络分解为单任务骨干，并设计任务无关的层级特征共享/融合搜索空间。③提出单次梯度搜索算法，通过最小熵正则化使架构权重收敛，实现搜索后直接评估。④实验表明在多种任务组合上，搜索架构优于手工设计，且无需重新训练。
2003.14058|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the task-specific search spaces in NAS for multi-task learning. It proposes MTL-NAS with a task-agnostic search space and single-shot gradient search, enabling direct evaluation. The method outperforms manual designs across task combinations.
2003.14058|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地将NAS应用于通用多任务学习，具有理论价值和实践潜力。
2003.14058|v2.contribution: 提出任务无关的NAS方法用于通用多任务学习。
2003.14058|v2.innovation: 设计层级特征共享搜索空间和单次搜索算法。
2003.14058|v2.result: 搜索架构在多种任务上优于手工设计。

1912.02037|v2.summary_cn: ①针对GAN架构设计依赖人工且NAS方法不适用的问题。②提出AdversarialNAS，首次以可微分方式同时搜索生成器和判别器架构。③设计对抗搜索算法，无需额外评估指标，考虑架构间相关性并提升平衡性。④在CIFAR-10上，搜索仅需1 GPU天，FID达10.87，Inception Score达8.74，创下新纪录。
1912.02037|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses manual GAN architecture design. It proposes AdversarialNAS, the first method to search generator and discriminator simultaneously in a differentiable manner. The method achieves state-of-the-art FID of 10.87 on CIFAR-10 with high efficiency.
1912.02037|v2.assessment: 该论文将NAS成功扩展到GAN领域，搜索效率高且性能优异，具有较强创新性。
1912.02037|v2.contribution: 提出首个可微分GAN架构搜索方法。
1912.02037|v2.innovation: 设计对抗搜索算法同时优化生成器和判别器。

1911.10695|v2.summary_cn: ①针对NAS搜索出的架构在对抗攻击下鲁棒性不足的问题。②提出在NAS搜索过程中引入对抗鲁棒性指标，联合优化精度与鲁棒性。③相比传统NAS仅关注干净数据精度，首次将鲁棒性作为搜索目标之一。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调搜索出的架构在对抗攻击下表现更优。
1911.10695|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of robustness in NAS-discovered architectures against adversarial attacks. It proposes incorporating adversarial robustness metrics into the search process, jointly optimizing accuracy and robustness. Unlike traditional NAS focusing solely on clean accuracy, it pioneers robustness-aware search. The abstract lacks specific numbers but claims improved robustness.
1911.10695|v2.assessment: 该论文将NAS与对抗鲁棒性结合，具有前瞻性，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证实验细节。
1911.10695|v2.contribution: 提出鲁棒性感知的NAS框架，搜索兼顾精度与对抗鲁棒性的架构。
1911.10695|v2.innovation: 将对抗训练与架构搜索联合优化，引入鲁棒性作为搜索目标。
1911.10695|v2.result: 搜索出的架构在对抗攻击下鲁棒性显著提升。

2003.12238|v2.summary_cn: ①针对NAS中双层优化近似导致梯度误差、收敛次优的问题。②提出混合层级重构（Mixed-Level Reformulation），将NAS转化为可高效优化的混合层级问题，并采用一阶方法求解。③相比DARTS等双层优化方法，避免了二阶近似误差，且支持模型大小搜索和早停策略。④在卷积搜索空间上，MiLeNAS在约5小时内完成搜索，验证误差更低，架构精度一致更高。
2003.12238|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles suboptimal convergence in NAS caused by gradient errors from second-order approximations in bilevel optimization. It proposes a mixed-level reformulation that enables efficient first-order optimization, avoiding approximation errors. It also extends DARTS with model-size search and early stopping, completing search in ~5 hours. Experiments show lower validation errors and consistently higher accuracy than bilevel methods.
2003.12238|v2.assessment: 方法理论清晰，实验充分，对NAS优化效率有显著改进，值得关注。
2003.12238|v2.contribution: 提出混合层级重构的NAS优化方法，提升搜索效率和架构质量。
2003.12238|v2.innovation: 用混合层级优化替代双层优化，消除二阶近似误差。
2003.12238|v2.result: 5小时内完成搜索，架构精度优于DARTS等基线。

2002.09128|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有NAS两阶段参数优化导致搜索与评估性能相关性差的问题。②提出DSNAS，一种端到端可微NAS框架，通过低偏置蒙特卡洛估计同时优化架构和参数，无需重训练。③相比两阶段方法，DSNAS直接优化目标任务精度和总计算量，减少搜索与评估的偏差。④在ImageNet上达到74.4%精度，仅用420 GPU小时，总时间减少34%以上。
2002.09128|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor correlation between search and evaluation performance in two-stage NAS methods. It proposes DSNAS, an end-to-end differentiable framework that jointly optimizes architecture and parameters via low-biased Monte Carlo estimation, eliminating retraining. It directly optimizes task accuracy and total computation. DSNAS achieves 74.4% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet in 420 GPU hours, reducing total time by over 34%.
2002.09128|v2.assessment: 提出端到端NAS新范式，显著提升效率，实验验证充分，对NAS领域有重要贡献。
2002.09128|v2.contribution: 提出无需重训练的端到端NAS方法，直接优化任务精度和计算成本。
2002.09128|v2.innovation: 用低偏置蒙特卡洛估计实现架构与参数联合优化。

2004.01961|v2.summary_cn: ①针对非局部（NL）块计算量大、难以嵌入移动网络的问题。②提出AutoNL，包括轻量级LightNL块（通过压缩变换和紧凑特征，计算量降低400倍）和可微NAS算法以端到端搜索最优NL配置。③相比传统NL块，LightNL在保持性能的同时大幅降低计算成本，NAS算法自动学习嵌入位置。④在ImageNet上，仅用32 GPU小时，AutoNL在350M FLOPs下达到77.7% top-1精度。
2004.01961|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy computation of Non-Local (NL) blocks, hindering their use in mobile networks. It proposes AutoNL, featuring a Lightweight NL (LightNL) block that is 400x cheaper via squeezed transformations and compact features, and a differentiable NAS algorithm to learn optimal NL configurations end-to-end. In 32 GPU hours, AutoNL achieves 77.7% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet at 350M FLOPs.
2004.01961|v2.assessment: 针对移动端NL块的高效设计结合NAS，实用性强，实验数据有力。
2004.01961|v2.contribution: 提出轻量级NL块和自动配置搜索方法，实现高效移动网络。
2004.01961|v2.innovation: 设计LightNL块并利用可微NAS自动搜索嵌入配置。

Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.summary_cn: ①针对NAS搜索过程中监督信号不足、架构泛化性差的问题。②提出块级监督的NAS方法，结合知识蒸馏，在搜索过程中对每个块提供监督信号。③相比全局监督，块级监督能更细粒度地指导架构搜索，知识蒸馏提升搜索效率。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调方法能提升搜索架构的泛化能力。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient supervision in NAS, leading to poor generalization. It proposes block-wise supervision with knowledge distillation, providing per-block supervision during search. Compared to global supervision, this offers finer-grained guidance, and distillation improves efficiency. The abstract lacks specific numbers but claims enhanced generalization.
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.assessment: 块级监督与蒸馏结合有创新性，但摘要信息不足，需更多实验验证。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.contribution: 提出块级监督NAS方法，利用知识蒸馏提升搜索质量。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.innovation: 在搜索中引入块级监督信号和蒸馏机制。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.result: 搜索架构泛化能力提升。

1912.00195|v2.summary_cn: ①针对NAS搜索阶段验证精度高但最终评估性能差的问题。②提出SGAS，将搜索过程分解为子问题，通过贪心策略选择和剪枝候选操作。③相比一次性NAS，SGAS逐步确定架构，减少搜索与评估的偏差，适用于CNN和GCN。④在图像分类、点云分类和蛋白质交互图节点分类等任务上，SGAS以最小计算成本找到最先进架构。
1912.00195|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the generalization gap in NAS where high search accuracy fails to translate to evaluation. It proposes SGAS, which divides search into subproblems and greedily selects/prunes operations. This reduces search-evaluation discrepancy and applies to CNN and GCN. SGAS finds state-of-the-art architectures for image classification, point cloud classification, and node classification with minimal cost.
1912.00195|v2.assessment: 贪心搜索策略简单有效，实验覆盖多任务，对NAS泛化问题有实际改进。
1912.00195|v2.contribution: 提出顺序贪心架构搜索方法，提升搜索架构的最终性能。
1912.00195|v2.innovation: 将搜索分解为子问题并贪心选择操作。
1912.00195|v2.result: 多任务上达到最先进性能，计算成本低。

1909.06793|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对实时语义分割网络设计中性能与速度难以平衡且依赖人工经验的问题。②提出了图引导架构搜索（GAS）方法，引入新的搜索空间，通过细胞独立方式实现细胞级多样性，并集成图卷积网络（GCN）作为细胞间通信机制，同时加入延迟导向约束。③相比以往工作，GAS消除了细胞共享约束，实现了细胞级多样性，并通过GCN增强细胞间信息交流，且显式平衡速度与性能。④在Cityscapes和CamVid数据集上，GAS取得了精度与速度的新最优平衡。
1909.06793|v2.summary_en: The paper addresses the trade-off between performance and speed in real-time semantic segmentation network design. It proposes Graph-guided Architecture Search (GAS) with a novel search space enabling cell-level diversity, integrating GCN for inter-cell communication and latency-oriented constraints. GAS achieves state-of-the-art accuracy-speed trade-offs on Cityscapes and CamVid.

1909.06793|v2.contribution: 提出了图引导的架构搜索方法，实现实时语义分割网络的自动设计。
1909.06793|v2.innovation: 通过细胞独立搜索和GCN通信机制实现细胞级多样性，并引入延迟约束。
1909.06793|v2.result: 在Cityscapes和CamVid上取得精度与速度的新最优平衡。

1912.07651|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对可微分NAS（DNAS）只能优化可微损失函数且需准确近似非可微标准的问题。②提出了UNAS统一框架，结合DNAS和强化学习（RL）方法，支持在统一框架中搜索可微和非可微标准，并引入基于泛化差距的新目标函数防止过拟合。③相比已有工作，UNAS融合了DNAS的低搜索成本和RL的灵活性，并改进了搜索目标。④在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet上，UNAS在多个搜索空间中获得平均准确率的最优结果。
1912.07651|v2.summary_en: The paper addresses limitations of differentiable NAS in handling non-differentiable criteria. It proposes UNAS, a unified framework combining DNAS and RL, enabling search with both differentiable and non-differentiable objectives, and introduces a generalization-gap-based objective. UNAS achieves state-of-the-art average accuracy on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet.
1912.07651|v2.assessment: 该论文在NAS方法论上有一定创新，但相关性较低，适合对NAS理论感兴趣的读者。
1912.07651|v2.contribution: 提出了统一NAS框架，融合可微和强化学习搜索。
1912.07651|v2.innovation: 引入泛化差距目标函数，并统一处理可微与非可微标准。
1912.07651|v2.result: 在多个数据集上取得最优平均准确率。

2004.05565|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对DNAS搜索空间小、内存和计算开销大的瓶颈。②提出了DMaskingNAS算法，通过掩码机制实现特征图重用，扩展搜索空间至传统DNAS的10^14倍，支持输入分辨率和滤波器数量的搜索，并采用形状传播优化每FLOP或参数精度。③相比已有工作，DMaskingNAS显著扩大了搜索空间，同时保持内存和计算成本几乎不变。④搜索得到的FBNetV2模型在性能上超越先前架构，搜索成本降低421倍，准确率提高0.9%，FLOPs减少15%（相比MobileNetV3-Small），或相似精度下FLOPs减少20%（相比Efficient-B0）。
2004.05565|v2.summary_en: The paper addresses the limited search space and high memory/computation costs in DNAS. It proposes DMaskingNAS with a masking mechanism for feature map reuse, expanding the search space by 10^14x while keeping costs nearly constant, and supporting spatial/channel dimension searches. FBNetV2 achieves state-of-the-art performance with up to 421x less search cost, 0.9% higher accuracy, and 15% fewer FLOPs than MobileNetV3-Small.
2004.05565|v2.assessment: 该论文在NAS领域有显著创新，但相关性较低，适合对高效架构搜索感兴趣的读者。
2004.05565|v2.contribution: 提出了DMaskingNAS算法，大幅扩展DNAS搜索空间并保持高效。
2004.05565|v2.innovation: 掩码机制实现特征图重用，支持空间和通道维度搜索。
2004.05565|v2.result: FBNetV2在性能和效率上超越多个SOTA模型。

1909.04977|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对现有NAS算法中搜索技术主要依赖可微方法的问题。②提出了连续进化方法CARS，在种群中共享SuperNet参数，通过少量epoch训练，并在下一代进化中继承SuperNet和种群，采用非支配排序保留Pareto前沿结果。③相比已有工作，CARS结合了进化算法和参数共享，加速最优网络生成，且搜索成本极低。④在ImageNet上，CARS仅用0.4 GPU天搜索，生成参数范围3.7M至5.1M的网络，性能超越现有SOTA方法。
1909.04977|v2.summary_en: The paper addresses the dominance of differentiable methods in NAS. It proposes CARS, a continuous evolutionary approach with parameter sharing within a SuperNet, inheriting population across generations, and using non-dominated sorting for Pareto front. CARS achieves superior performance on ImageNet with only 0.4 GPU days, producing networks with 3.7M-5.1M parameters.
1909.04977|v2.assessment: 该论文在NAS效率上有一定贡献，但相关性较低，适合对进化NAS感兴趣的读者。
1909.04977|v2.contribution: 提出了连续进化NAS方法，实现极低搜索成本。
1909.04977|v2.innovation: 结合SuperNet参数共享和连续进化，加速搜索。
1909.04977|v2.result: 在ImageNet上以0.4 GPU天搜索出超越SOTA的网络。

Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.summary_cn: ①该论文针对图像去噪任务中的神经网络架构搜索（NAS）内存效率低下的问题。②提出了一种内存高效的层次化神经网络架构搜索方法，通过层次化搜索策略和内存优化技术来降低搜索过程中的内存消耗。③相比已有工作，该方法在保持搜索性能的同时显著减少了内存占用，使得在资源受限设备上进行NAS成为可能。④由于摘要信息不完整，无法提供具体效果数据，但该方法在内存效率方面具有明显优势。
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.summary_en: This paper addresses the memory inefficiency issue in neural architecture search (NAS) for image denoising. It proposes a memory-efficient hierarchical NAS method that reduces memory consumption during search while maintaining performance. The approach enables NAS on resource-constrained devices, though specific quantitative results are unavailable due to incomplete abstract.

2012.05609|v2.summary_cn: ①针对低光图像增强中现有深度模型依赖人工架构设计且计算负担高的问题。②提出RUAS方法，基于Retinex理论建立优化模型并展开为网络结构，同时设计协同无参考学习策略搜索轻量级先验架构。③相比手工设计网络，该方法自动搜索紧凑结构，降低计算量。④实验表明RUAS在效果和速度上优于最新方法，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2012.05609|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on manual architecture engineering and high computational cost in low-light image enhancement. It proposes RUAS, which unrolls Retinex-based optimization into a network and uses cooperative reference-free learning to search lightweight priors. The method achieves superior performance and speed over state-of-the-art, though specific numbers are not in the abstract.

2011.09011|v2.summary_cn: ①针对两阶段NAS中均匀采样忽略性能Pareto前沿、导致搜索精度受限的问题。②提出AttentiveNAS，改进采样策略以聚焦Pareto前沿，并设计算法在训练中高效识别前沿网络。③相比BigNAS等均匀采样方法，该方法能同时获得多个不同FLOPs的高精度网络。④在ImageNet上，AttentiveNAS模型族达到77.3%至80.7%的top-1准确率，优于BigNAS和Once-for-All。
2011.09011|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of uniform sampling in two-stage NAS, which ignores the performance Pareto front. It proposes AttentiveNAS to improve sampling and efficiently identify Pareto-optimal networks during training. The discovered model family achieves 77.3%-80.7% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet, outperforming BigNAS and Once-for-All.
2011.09011|v2.assessment: 对NAS采样策略有重要改进，提升搜索效率与精度，对自动驾驶模型设计有参考价值。
2011.09011|v2.contribution: 提出注意力采样策略以优化NAS中的Pareto前沿搜索。
2011.09011|v2.innovation: 训练中动态识别Pareto网络并引导采样。

2105.10154|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视频姿态估计中现有方法追求精度而忽略实时效率的问题。②提出ViPNAS，在空间和时间两个层面搜索网络，空间层搜索深度、宽度、核大小等，时间层搜索帧间特征融合方式。③首次在视频中搜索时间特征融合和计算分配。④在COCO2017和PoseTrack2018上，S-ViPNAS和T-ViPNAS在保持精度的同时实现CPU实时推理，优于先前方法。
2105.10154|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between accuracy and efficiency in video pose estimation. It proposes ViPNAS to search networks at both spatial and temporal levels, including temporal feature fusion. The discovered models achieve CPU real-time speed without sacrificing accuracy on COCO2017 and PoseTrack2018, outperforming prior methods.
2105.10154|v2.assessment: 在视频理解中引入时间维度NAS，对自动驾驶多帧感知有借鉴意义，实验充分。
2105.10154|v2.contribution: 提出时空联合NAS方法用于实时视频姿态估计。
2105.10154|v2.innovation: 首次搜索时间特征融合和计算分配。

2011.10949|v2.summary_cn: ①针对概率性神经架构搜索（如PARSEC）在搜索过程中需要采样大量架构，导致计算成本高的问题。②提出FP-NAS方法，包括自适应熵的采样策略（初期多采样、后期少采样）和粗到细的因子化分布策略，以减少架构参数数量。③相比PARSEC，采样架构数量减少64%，搜索速度提升2.1倍；相比FBNetV2，搜索速度提升1.9-3.5倍，且搜索出的模型在ImageNet上表现更优。④该方法能扩展到更大的搜索空间，在ImageNet上取得优于FBNetV2的精度。
2011.10949|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of probabilistic NAS by proposing FP-NAS, which uses entropy-adaptive sampling and a coarse-to-fine factorized distribution to reduce architecture parameters. It achieves 64% fewer samples and 2.1x faster search than PARSEC, and 1.9-3.5x faster than FBNetV2 with better ImageNet accuracy.
2011.10949|v2.assessment: 该论文在NAS效率优化上有明确贡献，但属于纯NAS领域，与自动驾驶感知方向相关性较低。
2011.10949|v2.contribution: 提出了一种高效的采样和搜索策略，显著降低概率性NAS的计算成本。
2011.10949|v2.innovation: 自适应熵采样和粗到细因子化分布的结合。
2011.10949|v2.result: 搜索速度提升2.1倍，采样减少64%，ImageNet精度优于FBNetV2。

2005.14446|v2.summary_cn: ①针对NAS搜索速度慢的问题，提出基于沙漏结构的HourNAS方法。②该方法识别网络中的关键块（类似沙漏窄颈），优先搜索这些块，并缩小非关键块的搜索空间以降低计算开销。③相比现有方法，HourNAS在单GPU上仅需3小时即可完成搜索，且搜索出的架构在ImageNet上达到77.0% Top-1精度，优于SOTA方法。④该方法显著提升了NAS的效率，同时保持高精度。
2005.14446|v2.summary_en: HourNAS proposes an hourglass-inspired approach that prioritizes vital blocks in architecture search and shrinks the search space for non-vital blocks. It achieves 77.0% Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet with only 3 hours of search on a single GPU, outperforming state-of-the-art methods.
2005.14446|v2.assessment: 该论文在NAS效率上具有创新性，但主题与自动驾驶感知领域不直接相关。
2005.14446|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于关键块优先的快速NAS方法。
2005.14446|v2.innovation: 沙漏结构启发的关键块识别与搜索空间缩减。
2005.14446|v2.result: 3小时搜索达到77.0% ImageNet Top-1精度。

2105.12971|v2.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测中NAS、剪枝和知识蒸馏通常被流水线式组合，导致次优性能和效率低下的问题。②提出了Joint-DetNAS，一个统一框架，通过学生形态优化（结合权重继承）和动态蒸馏（基于弹性教师池）联合优化架构搜索、剪枝和蒸馏。③相比朴素流水线方法，创新性地将三者联合优化，权重继承加速搜索，弹性教师池无需额外成本提供匹配教师。④实验表明，Joint-DetNAS显著优于朴素流水线方法，以经典R101-FPN为基础检测器时，能直接输出高性能学生检测器，无需额外训练。
2105.12971|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimal performance and inefficiency of naively pipelining NAS, pruning, and knowledge distillation for object detection. It proposes Joint-DetNAS, a unified framework that jointly optimizes these components via student morphism with weight inheritance and dynamic distillation with an elastic teacher pool. Experiments show significant improvement over the pipelining approach, directly yielding high-performance student detectors from a base detector without extra training.
2105.12971|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种新颖的联合优化框架，将NAS、剪枝和蒸馏有机结合，对检测器压缩和搜索领域具有重要参考价值，实验验证了其有效性。
2105.12971|v2.contribution: 提出了Joint-DetNAS，首个联合优化NAS、剪枝和动态蒸馏的目标检测框架。
2105.12971|v2.innovation: 通过权重继承和弹性教师池实现学生形态与动态蒸馏的联合优化，避免流水线式次优解。
2105.12971|v2.result: 相比朴素流水线方法，Joint-DetNAS在检测性能上大幅提升，并能高效生成高性能学生检测器。

2204.05941|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对跨任务NAS中任务相关性建模不足的问题。②提出了Arch-Graph，一种可迁移的NAS方法，通过将任务嵌入作为预测器输入，并利用架构关系图预测任务特定最优架构。③相比已有工作，创新性地将NAS建模为最大加权无环子图问题，并添加无环约束以提升排序可靠性。④实验表明Arch-Graph能有效排序候选架构，但摘要未提供具体数值。
2204.05941|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient modeling of task correlations in transferable NAS. It proposes Arch-Graph, which predicts task-specific optimal architectures using task embeddings and formulates NAS as a maximal weighted acyclic subgraph problem. Compared to prior work, it introduces acyclicity constraints to enhance ranking trustworthiness. Experiments demonstrate effective ranking, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
2204.05941|v2.assessment: 方法新颖，将图论与NAS结合，对多任务场景有实际意义。
2204.05941|v2.contribution: 提出基于架构关系图的可迁移NAS方法Arch-Graph。
2204.05941|v2.innovation: 将NAS转化为最大加权无环子图问题并加入无环约束。
2204.05941|v2.result: 有效提升跨任务架构排序性能。

2111.15362|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对深度图像先验（DIP）框架中架构选择依赖图像且传统NAS成本过高的问题。②提出了ISNAS-DIP，一种图像特定的NAS策略，大幅减少训练需求，使逐图像NAS可行。③相比已有工作，首次证明DIP中最优架构具有图像依赖性，并据此设计轻量搜索策略。④在包含522个模型的DIP NAS数据集上验证了有效性，但摘要未给出具体性能数值。
2111.15362|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the image-dependence and high cost of NAS in the Deep Image Prior (DIP) framework. It proposes ISNAS-DIP, an image-specific NAS strategy requiring substantially less training, enabling per-image search. Compared to prior work, it demonstrates that optimal DIP architectures are image-dependent and leverages this insight. Effectiveness is validated on a 522-model DIP NAS dataset, though specific metrics are omitted.
2111.15362|v2.assessment: 针对DIP场景提出实用NAS方案，具有应用价值。
2111.15362|v2.innovation: 利用图像依赖性实现轻量级逐图像NAS。
2111.15362|v2.result: 在DIP NAS数据集上验证有效性。

2203.14577|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对基于神经正切核（NTK）的免训练NAS指标不可靠的问题。②通过实证分析NTK的时间演化，指出现代架构具有高度非线性，并提出了标签梯度对齐（LGA）指标，以捕捉非线性优势。③相比已有NTK指标，LGA在少量训练后能获得与测试精度更高的秩相关。④实验表明LGA在最小训练量下达到有意义的秩相关，但摘要未提供具体数值。
2203.14577|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the unreliability of NTK-based training-free NAS metrics. It empirically analyzes NTK evolution, revealing high non-linearity in modern architectures, and proposes Label-Gradient Alignment (LGA) to capture this. Compared to prior NTK metrics, LGA achieves higher rank correlation with post-training accuracy after minimal training. Experiments show meaningful correlation, though specific numbers are not given.
2203.14577|v2.assessment: 对NTK理论在NAS中的实用性有深入剖析，提出的LGA具有实际改进。
2203.14577|v2.contribution: 提出LGA指标改进NTK-based NAS评估。
2203.14577|v2.innovation: 利用非线性特性设计新指标。
2203.14577|v2.result: 在少量训练下提升架构排序相关性。
