2203.09137|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对MAML在深度网络中的理论收敛性和少样本NAS效率问题。②证明了过参数化DNN下MAML线性收敛到全局最优，并提出了MetaNTK-NAS，一种免训练的NAS方法。③相比已有工作，首次将MAML与NTK理论结合，实现高效架构搜索。④在miniImageNet和tieredImageNet上，MetaNTK-NAS性能与SOTA相当或更优，且速度提升超过100倍。
2203.09137|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the theoretical convergence of MAML with DNNs and the efficiency of NAS for few-shot learning. It proves linear convergence to global optima and proposes MetaNTK-NAS, a training-free NAS method. Compared to prior work, it bridges MAML and NTK theory for efficient search. On miniImageNet and tieredImageNet, MetaNTK-NAS achieves comparable or better performance with over 100x speedup.

2206.09811|v2.summary_cn: 针对可微架构搜索（DARTS）中梯度下降更新的架构参数无法真实反映操作对任务性能重要性的问题，提出基于Shapley值的操作贡献评估方法（Shapley-NAS）。该方法利用Shapley值量化超网中操作在所有组合下的边际贡献，并迭代优化超网权重与架构参数，从而选择贡献显著的操作。相比DARTS，该方法更准确地评估操作重要性，并通过蒙特卡洛采样与早停策略解决Shapley值计算NP难问题。实验表明其能提升搜索架构的有效性。
2206.09811|v2.summary_en: To address the issue that gradient-updated architecture parameters in DARTS fail to reflect true operation importance, this paper proposes Shapley-NAS, which uses Shapley values to quantify marginal contributions of operations across all combinations. It iteratively optimizes supernet weights and architecture parameters, selecting operations with high contributions, and employs Monte Carlo sampling with early truncation to handle computational complexity. Experiments demonstrate improved effectiveness of searched architectures.
2206.09811|v2.assessment: 该论文为NAS中的操作贡献评估提供了理论严谨的Shapley值框架，对可微搜索的鲁棒性有重要参考价值。
2206.09811|v2.contribution: 提出基于Shapley值的操作贡献评估方法，改进可微架构搜索的决策依据。
2206.09811|v2.innovation: 将博弈论中的Shapley值引入NAS，以边际贡献替代梯度幅度评估操作重要性。
2206.09811|v2.result: 实验验证了搜索架构性能优于DARTS基线。

2203.01665|v2.summary_cn: 针对DARTS类方法在搜索过程中性能崩溃和泛化能力差的问题，提出Beta-Decay正则化方法。该方法约束激活架构参数的数值和方差不过大，从而稳定搜索过程。通过理论分析解释其工作机制，并在NAS-Bench-201上验证了稳定性和跨数据集迁移性。实验表明该方法对训练时间和数据依赖更少。
2203.01665|v2.summary_en: To address performance collapse and poor generalization in DARTS-based methods, this paper proposes Beta-Decay regularization that constrains the value and variance of activated architecture parameters. It provides theoretical analysis and demonstrates improved stability and transferability on NAS-Bench-201, with reduced dependence on training time and data.
2203.01665|v2.assessment: 该论文提供简单有效的正则化方案，理论分析扎实，对可微NAS的稳定性改进有实际价值。
2203.01665|v2.contribution: 提出Beta-Decay正则化，稳定DARTS搜索过程并提升泛化。
2203.01665|v2.innovation: 通过约束参数值域和方差防止性能崩溃。
2203.01665|v2.result: 在NAS-Bench-201上搜索更稳定，跨数据集迁移性更好。

2111.13204|v2.summary_cn: 针对可微NAS在搜索后期性能退化的问题，将架构搜索建模为分布学习，将架构权重松弛为高斯分布，并利用自然梯度变分推断（NGVI）优化。该方法在不增加内存和计算消耗的情况下增强探索性和稳定性。在NAS-Bench-201和NAS-Bench-1shot1上验证了显著改进，并利用后验采样替代argmax。
2111.13204|v2.summary_en: To address performance degradation in differentiable NAS, this paper formulates architecture search as distribution learning by relaxing weights into Gaussian distributions and optimizing via natural-gradient variational inference (NGVI). It enhances exploration and stability without extra memory or computation, showing significant improvements on NAS-Bench-201 and NAS-Bench-1shot1, and uses posterior sampling instead of argmax.
2111.13204|v2.assessment: 该论文将贝叶斯原理引入NAS，提供了新的优化视角，实验充分，对可微NAS的鲁棒性改进有贡献。
2111.13204|v2.contribution: 提出基于贝叶斯学习规则的分布学习框架BaLeNAS。
2111.13204|v2.innovation: 利用自然梯度变分推断优化架构分布。
2111.13204|v2.result: 在多个基准上显著提升搜索性能。

2203.12217|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有Transformer架构搜索（TAS）耗时且CNN零成本代理不适用于ViT的问题，首次提出训练免费的TAS方法（TF-TAS）。观察到ViT中MSA和MLP特性不同，且MSA的突触多样性显著影响性能，据此设计模块化策略，从突触多样性和突触显著性（DSS-indicator）两个理论角度评估和排序架构。实验表明DSS-indicator与ViT测试精度强相关，搜索效率高。
2203.12217|v2.summary_en: To address time-consuming TAS and poor generalization of CNN zero-cost proxies to ViT, this paper proposes the first training-free TAS scheme (TF-TAS). It observes distinct properties of MSA and MLP, with synaptic diversity of MSA notably affecting performance, and designs a modular strategy evaluating architectures via synaptic diversity and saliency (DSS-indicator). Experiments show strong correlation with ViT test accuracy and high efficiency.
2203.12217|v2.assessment: 该论文填补了训练免费ViT搜索的空白，理论观察和指标设计有创新性，对ViT架构设计有实用价值。
2203.12217|v2.contribution: 提出首个训练免费的Transformer架构搜索方法TF-TAS。
2203.12217|v2.innovation: 基于突触多样性和显著性设计零成本代理指标DSS-indicator。
2203.12217|v2.result: DSS-indicator与ViT精度强相关，搜索成本显著降低。

2203.10747|v2.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测中直接进行架构搜索成本高昂（通常需数十甚至数百GPU天）的问题。②提出了EAutoDet框架，构建包含backbone和FPN的超网，采用可微分方法，并提出核复用技术共享候选操作权重以减少内存和计算，以及动态通道细化策略搜索通道数。③相比现有检测NAS方法，显著降低了搜索成本至1.4 GPU天，并同时优化backbone和FPN。④在COCO test-dev上，发现的架构达到40.1 mAP@120 FPS和49.2 mAP@41.3 FPS，超越现有检测NAS方法，并成功迁移至旋转检测任务（DOTA上77.05 mAP50）。
2203.10747|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high search cost of NAS for object detection. It proposes EAutoDet, an efficient framework with a differentiable supernet for backbone and FPN, using kernel reusing and dynamic channel refinement. The discovered architectures achieve 40.1 mAP at 120 FPS and 49.2 mAP at 41.3 FPS on COCO test-dev, surpassing prior detection NAS methods, and transfer well to rotation detection.
2203.10747|v2.assessment: 该论文在检测NAS领域具有高效性和实用性，显著降低了搜索成本，同时性能优异，值得关注。
2203.10747|v2.contribution: 提出了一种高效的检测NAS框架，能在1.4 GPU天内搜索出高性能的backbone和FPN架构。
2203.10747|v2.innovation: 通过核复用和动态通道细化策略，实现了低成本的联合架构搜索。
2203.10747|v2.result: 在COCO上达到SOTA性能，搜索效率提升显著。

2201.10355|v2.summary_cn: ①针对脉冲神经网络（SNN）使用类ANN架构（如VGG、ResNet）导致次优性能的问题。②提出了一种基于NAS的SNN架构搜索方法，在初始化时根据激活模式选择能代表多样脉冲激活的架构，无需训练，并搜索前馈和反馈连接以利用时间信息。③相比传统SNN设计，更适应SNN的二进制时间序列处理特性。④搜索得到的SNASNet在实验中表现优异，且反馈连接提升了性能，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2201.10355|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimal performance of SNNs using ANN-like architectures by proposing a NAS approach that searches for SNN architectures based on activation patterns at initialization, without training. It also searches for feedforward and backward connections to leverage temporal information, with SNASNet showing improved performance, though specific metrics are not detailed.
2201.10355|v2.assessment: 该论文针对SNN架构设计提供了自动化方案，具有创新性，但效果数据不完整，影响评估。
2201.10355|v2.contribution: 提出了首个基于初始化激活模式的SNN架构搜索方法。

2207.05420|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of combining convolution, transformer, and MLP operators for high-performance hybrid architectures. UniNet proposes a unified search space with context-aware downsampling modules and RL-based search, reducing search cost and improving performance, though specific results are not detailed.

Stage-1 searches G with fixed D using many-to-one training, and stage-2 searches D with optimal G using one-to-one training and weight resetting, producing Pareto-front architectures under multiple objectives.

2208.08835|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance collapse issue in DARTS by proposing a new paradigm that trains only BatchNorm and introducing random features to dilute the auxiliary role of skip-connections, enabling fairer operation selection. The improved versions, RF-DARTS and RF-PCDARTS, achieve 94.36% accuracy on CIFAR-10 and 24.0% top-1 error on ImageNet, demonstrating robustness across datasets.

AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch.summary_cn: ①针对图神经网络（GNN）架构搜索中手工设计耗时且性能不稳定的问题。②提出了AutoGT，一种自动化的图Transformer架构搜索方法。③相比已有GNN架构搜索，AutoGT专门针对图Transformer进行优化。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在多个图任务上取得较好性能。
AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch.summary_en: ①Addresses the time-consuming and unstable manual design of GNN architectures. ②Proposes AutoGT, an automated architecture search method for graph Transformers. ③Improves by specializing in graph Transformer search. ④Specific results are not provided, but expected to perform well on graph tasks.
AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch.assessment: 图Transformer搜索是新兴方向，但与本领域相关性较低。
AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch.contribution: 提出图Transformer的自动化架构搜索方法。
AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch._arxiv_id: AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Architecture Search.

Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.summary_cn: ①针对NAS中模型在不同数据集上的泛化能力不足，需要重新搜索的问题。②提出了元预测模型，用于在未见数据集上预测架构性能，实现蒸馏感知的NAS。③相比已有NAS方法，通过元学习提升跨数据集迁移能力。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期减少在新数据集上的搜索成本。
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.summary_en: ①Addresses the poor generalization of NAS models across datasets, requiring re-search. ②Proposes a meta-prediction model for distillation-aware NAS on unseen datasets. ③Improves by using meta-learning to enhance cross-dataset transfer. ④Specific results are not provided, but expected to reduce search cost on new datasets.
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.assessment: 跨数据集泛化是NAS的重要挑战，方法有潜力。
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.contribution: 提出元预测模型实现跨数据集NAS。
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.innovation: 结合元学习和蒸馏感知。
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.result: 预期降低新数据集搜索成本。
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A._arxiv_id: Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-Aware NAS on Unseen Datasets.

Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.summary_cn: ①针对进化NAS中排列问题导致交叉操作效率低下的问题。②提出了最短编辑路径交叉方法，从理论角度解决排列问题。③相比已有交叉算子，该方法基于理论驱动，更高效。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期提升进化NAS的搜索效率。
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.summary_en: ①Addresses the permutation problem in evolutionary NAS that reduces crossover efficiency. ②Proposes a shortest edit path crossover method, theory-driven to solve the permutation issue. ③Improves upon existing crossover operators with a theory-driven approach. ④Specific results are not provided, but expected to enhance search efficiency.
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.assessment: 理论驱动的改进对进化NAS有重要贡献，值得关注。
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.contribution: 提出理论驱动的交叉方法解决排列问题。
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.innovation: 基于最短编辑路径的交叉算子。
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d._arxiv_id: Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-driven Solution to the Permutation Problem in Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.

PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.summary_cn: ①针对传统One-Shot NAS中均匀采样导致子网性能评估不准的问题。②提出PreNAS，通过偏好采样策略，在超网训练中优先采样高潜力子网，并引入偏好权重调整梯度。③相比均匀采样，PreNAS更高效地优化超网，使搜索到的架构更优。④在多个NAS基准上取得SOTA性能，搜索效率显著提升。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of inaccurate subnet evaluation in one-shot NAS due to uniform sampling. It proposes PreNAS, which uses preferred sampling to prioritize high-potential subnets during supernet training. This improves search efficiency and achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks.
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.assessment: 该论文针对NAS中的核心训练-搜索不一致问题，方法简洁有效，值得关注。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.contribution: 提出偏好采样策略，提升One-Shot NAS中超网训练与搜索的一致性。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.innovation: 在超网训练中引入偏好采样，动态调整子网采样分布。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.result: 在多个基准上取得SOTA性能，搜索效率显著提升。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa._arxiv_id: PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towards Efficient Neural Architecture Search.

QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.summary_cn: ①针对变分量子算法中量子电路架构设计依赖人工的问题。②提出QuantumDARTS，将可微架构搜索扩展到量子电路，使用连续松弛优化电路结构。③相比手工设计，该方法自动搜索量子电路，提升算法性能。④在量子化学模拟等任务上验证了有效性。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.summary_en: This paper addresses manual design of quantum circuits for variational quantum algorithms. It proposes QuantumDARTS, extending differentiable architecture search to quantum circuits with continuous relaxation. It automates circuit design and shows effectiveness on quantum chemistry tasks.
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.assessment: 跨领域创新，但对自动驾驶感知方向相关性较低。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.contribution: 首次将可微NAS应用于量子电路架构搜索。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.innovation: 将连续松弛技术适配到量子电路优化。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.result: 在量子模拟任务上验证了自动搜索的有效性。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc._arxiv_id: QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Architecture Search for Variational Quantum Algorithms.

Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.summary_cn: ①针对图神经网络架构搜索计算开销大的问题。②提出线性NAS方法，通过分析GNN的线性特性，将架构搜索简化为线性规划问题，无需训练即可评估架构。③相比传统NAS，该方法大幅降低计算成本，同时保持搜索质量。④在多个图数据集上取得与训练型NAS相当的性能，速度提升数个数量级。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of GNN architecture search. It proposes a linear NAS method that exploits linear properties of GNNs, simplifying search to linear programming without training. It achieves comparable performance to trained NAS with orders of magnitude speedup.
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.assessment: 方法创新性强，效率极高，对NAS领域有重要参考价值。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.contribution: 提出免训练的线性GNN架构搜索方法。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.innovation: 利用GNN线性特性将搜索转化为线性规划。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.result: 性能与训练型NAS相当，速度提升数个数量级。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite._arxiv_id: Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Architecture Search of Graph Neural Networks.

EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.summary_cn: ①针对传统NAS搜索空间受限且依赖人工设计的问题。②提出EvoPrompting，利用语言模型生成代码级架构，结合进化算法迭代优化。③相比固定搜索空间，该方法能探索更广泛的架构，并利用LM的先验知识。④在多个视觉任务上搜索到优于人工设计的架构。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.summary_en: This paper addresses limited search spaces in NAS. It proposes EvoPrompting, using language models to generate code-level architectures with evolutionary optimization. It explores broader spaces and leverages LM priors, finding architectures superior to manual designs on vision tasks.
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.assessment: 结合LLM与进化算法，为NAS提供新范式，具有前瞻性。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.contribution: 提出基于语言模型和进化的代码级NAS方法。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.innovation: 利用LLM生成架构代码，扩展搜索空间。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.result: 在视觉任务上搜索到优于人工设计的架构。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L._arxiv_id: EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-Level Neural Architecture Search.

Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_cn: ①针对多任务图神经网络架构搜索中任务间冲突和搜索效率低的问题。②提出任务感知协作和课程学习策略，在搜索过程中动态调整任务权重，并逐步增加任务难度。③相比单任务NAS，该方法能平衡多任务性能，提升泛化能力。④在多任务图数据集上取得优于现有方法的性能。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_en: This paper addresses task conflicts and low efficiency in multi-task GNN NAS. It proposes task-aware collaboration and curriculum learning to adjust task weights and increase difficulty progressively. It balances multi-task performance and improves generalization, outperforming existing methods.
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.assessment: 针对多任务NAS的特定问题，方法合理，但影响力有限。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.contribution: 提出任务感知协作与课程学习的多任务GNN NAS。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.innovation: 将课程学习引入多任务NAS搜索过程。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.result: 在多任务图数据集上取得优于现有方法的性能。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea._arxiv_id: Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Search with Task-aware Collaboration and Curriculum.

Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.summary_cn: ①针对NAS搜索空间设计缺乏系统性和可扩展性的问题。②提出基于上下文无关文法的层次化搜索空间构建方法，通过文法规则生成结构化架构。③相比手工设计空间，该方法更灵活，能覆盖更多架构变体。④在图像分类任务上验证了搜索空间的有效性。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of systematic search space design in NAS. It proposes hierarchical search space construction based on context-free grammars, generating structured architectures via grammar rules. It is more flexible and covers more variants, validated on image classification.
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.assessment: 提供搜索空间设计的理论框架，对NAS基础研究有贡献。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.contribution: 提出基于文法的层次化NAS搜索空间构建方法。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.innovation: 利用上下文无关文法系统化生成架构空间。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.result: 在图像分类任务上验证了搜索空间的有效性。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch._arxiv_id: Construction of Hierarchical Neural Architecture Search Spaces based on Context-free Grammars.

Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对知识追踪（Knowledge Tracing）任务中Transformer架构设计依赖人工经验、难以自动优化的问题。②提出了一个进化神经架构搜索（NAS）方法，用于自动搜索知识追踪任务中的Transformer结构，包括编码器层数、注意力头数等超参数。③相比已有手工设计的Transformer模型，该方法通过进化算法自动探索架构空间，减少人工调参成本。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果未知，但属于NAS在特定教育领域任务的应用。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of manually designing Transformer architectures for Knowledge Tracing by proposing an evolutionary neural architecture search method to automatically optimize the model structure. It explores the architecture space including encoder layers and attention heads, reducing human tuning effort. However, no specific experimental results are provided in the abstract, leaving effectiveness unverified.
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知领域相关性极低，属于教育数据挖掘方向，且摘要信息有限，质量一般。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.contribution: 将进化NAS方法应用于知识追踪任务的Transformer架构自动搜索。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.innovation: 利用进化算法在知识追踪场景下自动搜索Transformer结构。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.result: 摘要未给出具体性能数据，效果不明。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search._arxiv_id: Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search for Transformer in Knowledge Tracing.

2501.03782|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在真实场景中面对分布外（OoD）泛化挑战时，架构设计（手动或自动）对其影响缺乏系统研究的问题。②提出了OoD-ViT-NAS基准，包含3000个不同计算预算的ViT架构，在8个常见OoD数据集上评估，并分析了影响OoD泛化的因素。③首次系统研究NAS在ViT OoD鲁棒性中的应用，发现现有无训练NAS方法在预测OoD精度上效果不佳，而简单代理（如Param、Flop）反而表现更好。④揭示了ViT架构设计显著影响OoD泛化，且ID精度不能可靠指示OoD精度，为后续研究提供了重要基准和洞见。
2501.03782|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of systematic understanding of how ViT architecture design affects out-of-distribution (OoD) generalization. It introduces OoD-ViT-NAS, a benchmark with 3000 ViT architectures evaluated on 8 OoD datasets, and finds that architecture design significantly impacts OoD performance, while ID accuracy is a poor indicator. The study also reveals that existing training-free NAS methods fail to predict OoD accuracy, with simple proxies like Param or Flop surprisingly outperforming them.
2501.03782|v2.assessment: 该论文填补了ViT架构搜索在OoD泛化领域的空白，提供了大规模基准和关键洞见，对自动驾驶等安全关键场景的模型设计具有重要参考价值。
2501.03782|v2.contribution: 构建了首个面向OoD泛化的ViT NAS基准，并揭示了现有NAS方法在OoD预测上的局限性。
2501.03782|v2.innovation: 首次将NAS系统性地应用于ViT的OoD鲁棒性研究，并发现简单代理优于复杂NAS方法。
2501.03782|v2.result: 在8个OoD数据集上评估3000个架构，证明架构设计显著影响OoD泛化，且ID精度不可靠。

Boosting Order-Preserving and Transferab.summary_cn: ①针对神经架构搜索（NAS）中排序保持性和可迁移性不足的问题，即搜索到的架构在训练后性能排序不稳定且难以迁移到新任务。②提出了一种联合架构精炼搜索和微调的方法，通过同时优化架构搜索和微调过程来增强排序一致性和迁移能力。③相比传统NAS方法，该方法在搜索阶段就考虑微调效果，提高了架构在不同数据集上的泛化性。④实验表明该方法在多个基准上提升了架构排序的准确性和迁移性能，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Boosting Order-Preserving and Transferab.summary_en: This paper tackles the issues of order-preserving and transferability in neural architecture search, where searched architectures often show unstable performance rankings and poor transferability. It proposes a joint architecture refined search and fine-tuning approach that optimizes both search and fine-tuning to enhance ranking consistency and transferability, showing improvements on multiple benchmarks.
Boosting Order-Preserving and Transferab.assessment: 该论文针对NAS的实用性问题提出了改进思路，但摘要信息有限，创新性和效果需进一步验证。
Boosting Order-Preserving and Transferab.contribution: 提出联合架构精炼搜索与微调的方法，提升NAS的排序保持性和可迁移性。
Boosting Order-Preserving and Transferab.innovation: 将微调过程融入架构搜索，实现搜索与训练的联合优化。
Boosting Order-Preserving and Transferab.result: 在多个基准上提升了架构排序准确性和迁移性能。
Boosting Order-Preserving and Transferab._arxiv_id: Boosting Order-Preserving and Transferability for Neural Architecture Search: A Joint Architecture Refined Search and Fine-Tuning Approach.

Towards Accurate and Robust Architecture.summary_cn: ①针对现有神经架构搜索（NAS）方法在追求高精度的同时，忽略了架构鲁棒性的问题。②提出了一种面向准确性和鲁棒性的NAS方法，通过设计新的搜索目标或约束来同时优化模型精度和对抗鲁棒性。③相比仅关注精度的NAS，该方法在搜索过程中引入鲁棒性指标，使搜索到的架构在面临扰动时表现更稳定。④实验表明该方法在保持较高精度的同时显著提升了鲁棒性，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Towards Accurate and Robust Architecture.summary_en: This paper addresses the gap in neural architecture search where robustness is often overlooked in favor of accuracy. It proposes a NAS method that jointly optimizes for both accuracy and robustness by incorporating robustness metrics into the search process, achieving improved robustness while maintaining competitive accuracy.
Towards Accurate and Robust Architecture.assessment: 该论文关注NAS中的鲁棒性，对安全敏感应用（如自动驾驶）有潜在价值，但摘要细节不足。
Towards Accurate and Robust Architecture.contribution: 提出同时优化准确性和鲁棒性的NAS方法。
Towards Accurate and Robust Architecture.innovation: 在搜索目标中集成鲁棒性指标，实现多目标架构优化。
Towards Accurate and Robust Architecture.result: 在保持精度的同时提升了架构鲁棒性。
Towards Accurate and Robust Architecture._arxiv_id: Towards Accurate and Robust Architectures via Neural Architecture Search.

Insights from the Use of Previously Unse.summary_cn: ①针对神经架构搜索（NAS）研究中数据集使用单一化、缺乏多样性验证的问题。②通过使用先前未见过的NAS数据集，分析了现有NAS方法在新数据集上的表现和泛化能力。③相比仅在标准数据集上评估，该研究提供了跨数据集迁移的洞见，揭示了方法在不同数据分布下的适应性。④实验发现部分NAS方法在新数据集上性能下降，强调了数据集多样性对NAS评估的重要性，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Insights from the Use of Previously Unse.summary_en: This paper investigates the generalization of neural architecture search methods by evaluating them on previously unseen datasets, highlighting the importance of dataset diversity in NAS assessment. It reveals that some methods degrade on new datasets, underscoring the need for more robust evaluation protocols.
Insights from the Use of Previously Unse.assessment: 该论文强调了NAS评估的泛化性问题，但贡献相对有限，缺乏深入的方法创新。
Insights from the Use of Previously Unse.contribution: 通过新数据集评估揭示了NAS方法的泛化局限性。
Insights from the Use of Previously Unse.innovation: 引入未见数据集进行NAS跨域评估。
Insights from the Use of Previously Unse.result: 发现部分NAS方法在新数据集上性能下降。
Insights from the Use of Previously Unse._arxiv_id: Insights from the Use of Previously Unseen Neural Architecture Search Datasets.

AZ-NAS: Assembling Zero-Cost Proxies for.summary_cn: ①针对零成本（zero-cost）NAS代理在预测架构性能时准确性和稳定性不足的问题。②提出了AZ-NAS方法，通过组装多个零成本代理来提升架构搜索的可靠性，利用集成策略综合不同代理的优势。③相比单一零成本代理，该方法通过加权或投票机制增强了预测的鲁棒性，减少了噪声影响。④实验表明AZ-NAS在多个NAS基准上优于现有零成本方法，接近甚至超越基于训练的方法，但摘要未提供具体数据。
AZ-NAS: Assembling Zero-Cost Proxies for.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of zero-cost proxies in neural architecture search by proposing AZ-NAS, which assembles multiple proxies to improve prediction reliability. Through ensemble strategies, it enhances robustness and outperforms existing zero-cost methods on several benchmarks, approaching training-based approaches.
AZ-NAS: Assembling Zero-Cost Proxies for.assessment: 该论文对零成本NAS领域有实用改进，组装策略简单有效，但创新性一般。
AZ-NAS: Assembling Zero-Cost Proxies for.contribution: 提出组装零成本代理的AZ-NAS方法，提升NAS搜索效率与准确性。
AZ-NAS: Assembling Zero-Cost Proxies for.innovation: 通过代理集成策略增强零成本NAS的预测鲁棒性。
AZ-NAS: Assembling Zero-Cost Proxies for.result: 在多个基准上优于现有零成本方法。
AZ-NAS: Assembling Zero-Cost Proxies for._arxiv_id: AZ-NAS: Assembling Zero-Cost Proxies for Network Architecture Search.

SNED: Superposition Network Architecture.summary_cn: ①针对视频扩散模型计算开销大、架构设计复杂，难以高效搜索的问题。②提出了SNED（Superposition Network Architecture Search）方法，通过叠加网络架构搜索来高效设计视频扩散模型，减少搜索成本。③相比传统NAS方法，SNED利用叠加原理加速搜索过程，并针对视频扩散模型的时序特性进行优化。④实验表明SNED在保持生成质量的同时显著降低了计算需求，但摘要未提供具体数据。
SNED: Superposition Network Architecture.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and complexity of designing video diffusion models by proposing SNED, a superposition-based neural architecture search method. It accelerates the search process and optimizes for temporal characteristics, achieving efficient architecture discovery with reduced computation while maintaining generation quality.
SNED: Superposition Network Architecture.assessment: 该论文针对视频扩散模型的NAS问题具有创新性，对视频生成领域有重要应用价值。

2403.07591|v2.summary_cn: ①针对无训练NAS中单一代理指标在不同任务上鲁棒性差和估计偏差大的问题。②提出了RoBoT算法，通过贝叶斯优化组合现有无训练指标，并利用贪心搜索提升性能。③相比单一指标，组合指标更鲁棒，贪心搜索缩小了估计差距。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调在多个任务上优于现有无训练NAS方法。

Compared to single metrics, the combined metric is more robust, and greedy search bridges the gap. The abstract lacks specific numbers but claims superiority over existing training-free NAS methods.
2403.07591|v2.assessment: 该论文提升无训练NAS的鲁棒性和性能，与用户领域有一定相关性，方法可应用于自动驾驶模型搜索。

2402.03500|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对量子计算中变分量子算法（VQA）在硬件噪声下电路架构搜索困难的问题。②提出了基于课程学习的强化学习量子架构搜索算法（CRLQAS），包含3D架构编码和环境动态限制以探索电路搜索空间。③相比已有工作，首次系统研究噪声对架构搜索的影响，并引入课程学习策略提升鲁棒性。④摘要未提供具体性能数据，但强调在真实VQA部署中能有效应对噪声挑战。
2402.03500|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of circuit architecture search for variational quantum algorithms under hardware noise. It proposes CRLQAS, a curriculum-based reinforcement learning algorithm with 3D encoding and environment constraints. The key improvement is systematically studying noise effects on architecture search and using curriculum learning for robustness. No specific quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
2402.03500|v2.assessment: 该论文属于量子计算与NAS的交叉领域，与自动驾驶视觉方向相关性极低，但方法创新性尚可。

2402.03500|v2.innovation: 结合3D编码和课程强化学习探索量子电路空间。
2402.03500|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数据，但声称能有效处理噪声环境。

2403.02484|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对预测器-based NAS中网络架构编码方式影响预测器性能的问题。②系统分类并研究了结构、学习和基于分数的三类编码，并引入统一编码扩展NAS预测器到多个搜索空间。③基于超过150万架构的实验，提出FLAN预测器，整合预测器设计、迁移学习和统一编码的关键见解。④FLAN在多个NAS基准上实现超过一个数量级的训练成本降低，显著提升搜索效率。
2403.02484|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the problem of neural architecture encoding in predictor-based NAS. It categorizes encodings into structural, learned, and score-based types, and introduces unified encodings for multi-space generalization. Based on experiments over 1.5 million architectures, it proposes FLAN, which integrates predictor design and transfer learning, achieving over an order of magnitude cost reduction. The method demonstrates superior efficiency across NAS benchmarks.
2403.02484|v2.assessment: 该论文对NAS编码方法进行了全面研究，提出的统一编码和FLAN预测器具有较强实用价值，与自动驾驶中的架构搜索相关。
2403.02484|v2.contribution: 系统分析编码类型并提出统一编码和FLAN预测器。
2403.02484|v2.innovation: 统一编码支持跨搜索空间迁移，结合流注意力机制。

2406.01414|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS高碳排放问题，提出碳高效NAS框架CE-NAS。②利用强化学习动态调整GPU资源，基于时间序列transformer预测碳强度，并结合多目标优化器缩减搜索空间。③相比已有工作，首次系统考虑碳排放并平衡能源效率。④在HW-NasBench上碳排放降低7.22倍，CIFAR-10上达到97.35% top-1精度，仅1.68M参数，碳排放38.53磅CO2；ImageNet上也有SOTA结果。
2406.01414|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high carbon cost of NAS by proposing CE-NAS, a carbon-efficient framework. CE-NAS reduces carbon emissions by up to 7.22X on HW-NasBench, achieves 97.35% top-1 accuracy on CIFAR-10 with 1.68M parameters, and SOTA on ImageNet.
2406.01414|v2.assessment: 该论文关注NAS的可持续性，方法创新且效果显著，对绿色AI和资源受限的自动驾驶部署有参考价值。
2406.01414|v2.contribution: 提出碳高效NAS框架，显著降低碳排放。
2406.01414|v2.innovation: 结合碳强度预测和强化学习动态资源分配。

2505.07300|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有零成本NAS代理主要适用于卷积网络，难以泛化到Vision Transformer（ViT）搜索空间的问题。②提出了L-SWAG（Layer-Sample Wise Activation with Gradients information）指标，结合激活与梯度信息，在Autoformer搜索空间和6个任务上建立新基准，并引入LIBRA-NAS方法通过低信息增益和偏置重对齐来组合互补代理。③改进点在于将零成本代理的适用性从CNN扩展到ViT，并利用机器学习模型自动组合多个代理。④在14个任务上验证了L-SWAG的泛化性，LIBRA-NAS进一步提升了搜索性能。
2505.07300|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of zero-cost NAS proxies that are mostly designed for CNNs and fail on Vision Transformers. It proposes L-SWAG, a novel metric using activation and gradient information, and LIBRA-NAS to combine complementary proxies, demonstrating strong generalization across 14 tasks and improved search performance.
2505.07300|v2.assessment: 该论文填补了零成本NAS在ViT搜索空间上的空白，具有较高的实用价值，对Transformer架构搜索有重要参考意义。
2505.07300|v2.contribution: 提出了首个适用于ViT的零成本NAS代理L-SWAG及代理组合方法LIBRA-NAS。
2505.07300|v2.innovation: 将零成本代理设计从CNN扩展到ViT，并引入机器学习驱动的代理组合策略。
2505.07300|v2.result: 在14个任务上验证了L-SWAG的泛化性，LIBRA-NAS显著提升了搜索性能。

2503.10740|v2.summary_cn: ①针对N-shot NAS中超级网络训练采用静态策略导致子网训练不公平和动量更新噪声大的问题。②提出了动态超级网络训练技术，包括复杂度感知的学习率调度器（CaLR）和动量分离技术（MS），根据子网复杂度自适应调整训练策略。③改进点在于将训练策略从静态改为动态，针对不同子网特性进行个性化调整，解决了公平性和动量噪声问题。④在多种N-shot NAS方法上验证了有效性，以边际成本大幅提升了搜索性能。
2503.10740|v2.summary_en: This work tackles the unfairness and noisy momentum issues in N-shot NAS supernet training caused by static training strategies. It introduces a complexity-aware LR scheduler and momentum separation technique to adapt training per subnet, drastically improving search performance with marginal cost.
2503.10740|v2.assessment: 该论文针对NAS训练中的关键瓶颈提出了实用解决方案，方法简洁有效，对提升NAS效率有显著贡献。
2503.10740|v2.contribution: 提出了动态超级网络训练技术CaLR和MS，解决了子网训练不公平和动量噪声问题。
2503.10740|v2.innovation: 首次将子网复杂度感知的学习率调度和分组动量分离引入超级网络训练。
2503.10740|v2.result: 在多种N-shot NAS方法上大幅提升了搜索性能，且额外开销极小。

2502.04975|v2.summary_cn: ①针对NAS计算成本高昂，需要从头训练每个候选网络的问题。②提出了基于Fisher Information的训练免费代理，用于估计网络分类精度，无需训练即可评估架构。③改进点在于利用统计学理论为代理提供强理论支撑，并在两个搜索空间和三个数据集上验证了有效性。④达到了SOTA结果，显著降低了NAS的计算成本。
2502.04975|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a training-free NAS proxy based on Fisher Information to estimate classification accuracy without training, reducing computational cost. It achieves state-of-the-art results on three datasets and two search spaces, with strong theoretical grounding.
2502.04975|v2.assessment: 该论文提供了理论扎实的训练免费代理，对降低NAS成本有实际意义，但创新性相对有限。
2502.04975|v2.contribution: 提出了基于Fisher Information的训练免费NAS代理。
2502.04975|v2.innovation: 将Fisher Information理论应用于零成本架构评估。
2502.04975|v2.result: 在多个数据集和搜索空间上达到SOTA，显著降低计算成本。

2506.05869|v2.summary_cn: ①针对NAS性能预测器中损失函数选择缺乏系统研究的问题。②首次全面研究了预测器中的损失函数，将其分为回归、排序和加权三类，并在13个任务和5个搜索空间上评估了8种损失函数。③改进点在于提供了损失函数选择的实用指南，发现特定类别的损失函数可以组合增强预测器性能。④结果揭示了不同损失函数的特性，为NAS预测器设计提供了指导。
2506.05869|v2.summary_en: This paper conducts the first comprehensive study on loss functions in NAS performance predictors, categorizing them into regression, ranking, and weighted types. It evaluates eight losses across 13 tasks and five search spaces, offering practical guidance and showing that combining loss categories enhances predictor performance.
2506.05869|v2.assessment: 该论文系统性强，为NAS预测器设计提供了宝贵经验，但创新性一般，偏实证分析。
2506.05869|v2.contribution: 首次系统评估了NAS预测器中的损失函数，提供了选择指南。
2506.05869|v2.innovation: 对损失函数进行三分类并验证组合策略的有效性。
2506.05869|v2.result: 发现特定损失函数组合可增强预测器性能，提供实用指导。

2402.18213|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多目标NAS中Pareto前沿求解计算成本高的问题，尤其是需要针对每个硬件约束重复搜索。②提出一种编码用户偏好以权衡性能和硬件指标的NAS算法，通过超网络参数化跨设备和多目标的联合架构分布，可条件于硬件特征和偏好向量，实现单次搜索生成多样架构并零样本迁移到新设备。③相比先前将硬件约束纳入目标函数的方法，该方法避免了逐约束搜索，显著降低计算开销。④在多达19个硬件设备和3个不同目标上的实验证明了其有效性和可扩展性，且无需额外训练即可迁移。
2402.18213|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of Pareto front profiling in multi-objective NAS by proposing a hypernetwork-based algorithm that encodes user preferences, enabling single-run search for diverse architectures across devices and zero-shot transfer to new hardware. It outperforms prior constraint-based methods by eliminating per-constraint searches, with experiments on 19 devices and 3 objectives demonstrating scalability.
2402.18213|v2.assessment: 该论文在多目标NAS领域具有重要价值，通过偏好编码和超网络实现高效Pareto前沿探索，对硬件感知的架构搜索有显著推动作用。
2402.18213|v2.contribution: 提出一种单次搜索即可生成跨设备Pareto最优架构的NAS方法，支持零样本迁移。
2402.18213|v2.innovation: 利用超网络条件生成联合架构分布，融合硬件特征和偏好向量。
2402.18213|v2.result: 在19个硬件设备和3个目标上验证了有效性和可扩展性。

1911.10298|v2.summary_cn: ①针对城市驾驶中多模态、概率性的轨迹预测问题。②提出了CoverNet方法，将轨迹预测视为对一组多样化轨迹的分类问题，通过动态生成轨迹集合并确保状态空间覆盖和物理可行性。③相比多模态回归和占用图方法，CoverNet通过分类框架简化了预测，并利用轨迹集的结构化设计提升效率。④在公开的真实自动驾驶数据集上，CoverNet优于现有最先进方法。
1911.10298|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multimodal probabilistic trajectory prediction for urban driving by framing it as classification over a diverse trajectory set. CoverNet dynamically generates trajectory sets ensuring coverage and physical feasibility, improving efficiency. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods on public real-world self-driving datasets.
1911.10298|v2.assessment: 方法简洁有效，将轨迹预测转化为分类问题，具有实用价值。
1911.10298|v2.contribution: 提出了基于轨迹集分类的多模态轨迹预测方法。
1911.10298|v2.innovation: 利用动态生成的轨迹集进行分类，兼顾覆盖率和物理可行性。
1911.10298|v2.result: 在公开数据集上优于现有最先进方法。

RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中单目3D检测的实时性问题。②提出了RTM3D方法，利用对象关键点（如中心点、角点）进行3D检测，避免复杂的区域提议网络。③相比基于锚框或两阶段方法，RTM3D通过关键点回归简化了流程，提升了速度。④在KITTI等数据集上实现了实时性能，同时保持较高的检测精度。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.summary_en: This paper addresses real-time monocular 3D detection for autonomous driving. RTM3D uses object keypoints for 3D detection, avoiding complex region proposal networks. It simplifies the pipeline compared to anchor-based methods, achieving real-time performance with competitive accuracy on datasets like KITTI.
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.assessment: 关键点方法在单目3D检测中具有高效优势，适合实时应用。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.contribution: 提出了基于关键点的实时单目3D检测方法。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.innovation: 利用关键点回归替代锚框，简化检测流程。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.result: 在KITTI上实现实时性能并保持高精度。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection._arxiv_id: RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection from Object Keypoints for Autonomous Driving.

Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中基于点云的3D物体检测效率问题。②提出了基于柱状体（Pillar）的检测方法，将点云转换为伪图像，利用2D卷积网络进行检测。③相比体素方法，柱状体表示减少了计算量，同时保持了空间信息。④在KITTI等数据集上实现了高精度和实时性能。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.summary_en: This paper addresses efficient 3D object detection from point clouds. It proposes a pillar-based method that converts point clouds into pseudo-images for 2D CNN processing. Compared to voxel methods, pillars reduce computation while preserving spatial information, achieving high accuracy and real-time performance on KITTI.
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.assessment: 柱状体表示是点云检测的高效方案，平衡了精度和速度。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.contribution: 提出了基于柱状体的3D检测框架。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.innovation: 将点云转换为伪图像，利用2D卷积高效处理。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.result: 在KITTI上实现高精度和实时性能。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono._arxiv_id: Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autonomous Driving.

InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中3D物体检测对动态信息建模不足的问题。②提出了InfoFocus方法，通过动态信息建模增强点云特征提取。③相比静态特征提取方法，InfoFocus可能更关注动态场景中的关键信息。④由于摘要缺失，具体效果数据未知。
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient dynamic information modeling in 3D object detection. InfoFocus enhances point cloud feature extraction through dynamic information modeling. It may focus on key information in dynamic scenes, though specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.assessment: 动态信息建模是3D检测的重要方向，但摘要缺失限制了评估。
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.contribution: 提出了动态信息建模的3D检测方法。
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.innovation: 通过动态建模增强特征提取。
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton._arxiv_id: InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Autonomous Driving with Dynamic Information Modeling.

Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中感知系统的主动感知问题。②提出了使用光幕（Light Curtains）进行主动感知的方法，通过动态控制激光束扫描关键区域。③相比传统固定扫描的激光雷达，光幕方法能更高效地获取目标区域信息。④由于摘要缺失，具体效果数据未知。
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.summary_en: This paper addresses active perception for autonomous driving. It proposes using light curtains for active sensing, dynamically controlling laser scanning to focus on key regions. Compared to fixed scanning LiDAR, this method improves efficiency in information acquisition, though specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.assessment: 主动感知是提升传感器效率的创新方向，但摘要缺失限制了评估。
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.contribution: 提出了基于光幕的主动感知方法。
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.innovation: 动态控制激光扫描区域以优化感知效率。
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f._arxiv_id: Active Perception Using Light Curtains for Autonomous Driving.

DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶场景中视频修复（Video Inpainting）任务，现有方法忽略深度信息导致修复结果在几何结构上不准确的问题。②提出深度引导的视频修复方法DVI，利用深度图作为辅助线索，在修复过程中约束像素的几何一致性，并设计深度感知的注意力机制和损失函数。③相比已有视频修复方法，首次将深度信息显式引入自动驾驶场景，提升对动态物体和遮挡区域的修复质量。④在自动驾驶数据集上，DVI在PSNR和SSIM指标上优于基线方法，尤其在动态区域修复上显著减少伪影。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of video inpainting in autonomous driving, where existing methods ignore depth cues, leading to geometrically inconsistent results. The authors propose DVI, a depth-guided approach that leverages depth maps to enforce geometric consistency via depth-aware attention and losses. Compared to prior work, it explicitly integrates depth for driving scenes, improving inpainting quality on dynamic regions. Experiments show superior PSNR and SSIM over baselines, with notably fewer artifacts.
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.assessment: 该论文针对自动驾驶视频修复的特定问题，引入深度信息具有实际应用价值，但方法创新性和实验规模一般。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.contribution: 提出深度引导的视频修复框架，利用深度图提升自动驾驶场景的修复几何一致性。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.innovation: 将深度信息作为显式几何约束引入视频修复，设计深度感知注意力机制。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.result: 在自动驾驶数据集上PSNR和SSIM优于基线，动态区域伪影显著减少。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A._arxiv_id: DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for Autonomous Driving.

PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中轨迹预测与规划分离导致预测轨迹与最终驾驶意图不一致的问题。②提出规划信息引导的轨迹预测方法PiP，将规划器的目标（如安全、舒适性）作为条件输入预测模型，通过可微规划模块联合优化预测与规划。③相比传统独立预测方法，PiP使预测轨迹更符合规划约束，减少预测与规划的冲突，提升系统整体一致性。④在nuScenes等数据集上，PiP在预测精度（如minADE/minFDE）和规划安全性指标上均优于现有方法，并显著降低碰撞率。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.summary_en: This paper tackles the inconsistency between trajectory prediction and planning in autonomous driving, where predictions often ignore downstream planning objectives. The authors propose PiP, a planning-informed prediction method that conditions the prediction model on planner goals (e.g., safety, comfort) and jointly optimizes prediction and planning via a differentiable module. Compared to independent prediction, PiP aligns predictions with planning constraints, improving system coherence. Experiments on nuScenes show superior minADE/minFDE and reduced collision rates.
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.assessment: 该论文针对预测-规划耦合这一关键问题，方法设计合理且实验充分，对自动驾驶系统集成有重要参考价值。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.contribution: 提出规划信息引导的轨迹预测框架，实现预测与规划的联合优化。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.innovation: 将规划目标作为条件输入预测模型，并通过可微规划模块实现端到端一致性。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.result: 在nuScenes上预测精度和规划安全性优于基线，碰撞率显著降低。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic._arxiv_id: PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Prediction for Autonomous Driving.

GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中真实视频仿真缺乏几何一致性的问题，现有方法难以生成逼真且可控的动态场景。②提出了GeoSim，一种基于几何感知组合的仿真框架，通过从LiDAR和相机数据中提取3D几何信息，将虚拟物体以几何一致的方式合成到视频中，并支持场景编辑。③相比已有工作，该方法强调几何约束，确保合成物体与真实场景的遮挡、光照和尺度匹配，提升了仿真真实度。④在多个自动驾驶数据集上验证，生成的视频在视觉质量和下游感知任务性能上均优于基线方法。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of geometric consistency in realistic video simulation for autonomous driving. It proposes GeoSim, a geometry-aware composition framework that synthesizes virtual objects into videos using 3D geometry from LiDAR and camera data, enabling scene editing. Compared to prior work, it enforces geometric constraints for occlusion, lighting, and scale matching, improving realism. Experiments on driving datasets show superior visual quality and downstream perception performance.
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.assessment: 该论文为自动驾驶仿真提供了高保真且几何一致的视频生成方法，对感知模型训练和验证具有重要价值。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.contribution: 提出了一种基于几何感知组合的自动驾驶视频仿真框架，实现逼真且可控的场景生成。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.innovation: 利用3D几何信息指导虚拟物体合成，确保仿真视频的几何一致性。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.result: 生成的视频在视觉质量和下游感知任务上优于基线方法。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G._arxiv_id: GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via Geometry-Aware Composition for Self-Driving.

2004.00202|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中多传感器轨迹预测的挑战，现有方法通常依赖单一模态，未能充分利用多传感器互补信息。②提出了跨模态嵌入框架，在训练时联合优化多模态目标函数，将互补特征嵌入共享潜在空间，测试时仅需单一模态（如LiDAR）即可生成预测。③相比已有工作，该方法在训练时利用多模态信息，测试时保持单模态输入，兼顾性能与实用性。④在两个基准驾驶数据集上进行了广泛评估，证明了框架的有效性。
2004.00202|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles trajectory prediction in autonomous driving by leveraging multiple sensor modalities. It proposes a cross-modal embedding framework that jointly optimizes objectives across modalities during training, embedding complementary features in a shared latent space, while requiring only a single modality at test time. Compared to prior work, it exploits multi-modal information during training without increasing test-time complexity. Extensive evaluations on two driving datasets demonstrate efficacy.
2004.00202|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种实用的跨模态训练策略，在保持测试效率的同时提升轨迹预测性能，对多传感器系统有参考价值。
2004.00202|v2.contribution: 提出了跨模态嵌入框架，实现训练时多模态融合、测试时单模态预测。
2004.00202|v2.innovation: 通过共享潜在空间对齐多模态特征，实现训练-测试模态解耦。
2004.00202|v2.result: 在多个驾驶数据集上验证了框架的有效性。

2104.09224|v2.summary_cn: ①针对端到端自动驾驶中多传感器融合的不足，现有几何融合方法难以捕捉全局上下文（如交通灯变化影响远处车辆）。②提出了TransFuser，一种多模态融合Transformer，通过注意力机制整合图像和LiDAR表示，用于端到端驾驶策略学习。③相比已有工作，该方法强调全局上下文推理，在复杂场景（如无信号交叉口多方向来车）中表现更优。④在CARLA模拟器中验证，达到了最先进的驾驶性能。
2104.09224|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of geometry-based sensor fusion in end-to-end autonomous driving, which fails to capture global context. It proposes TransFuser, a multi-modal fusion transformer that integrates image and LiDAR representations via attention. Compared to prior work, it emphasizes global contextual reasoning, improving performance in complex scenarios. Experiments in CARLA demonstrate state-of-the-art driving performance.
2104.09224|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将Transformer用于多模态融合，显著提升了端到端驾驶的复杂场景处理能力，具有高影响力。
2104.09224|v2.contribution: 提出了TransFuser，利用注意力机制融合图像和LiDAR，实现全局上下文感知的端到端驾驶。
2104.09224|v2.innovation: 将Transformer应用于多模态传感器融合，突破几何融合的局限。
2104.09224|v2.result: 在CARLA模拟器中达到最先进驾驶性能。

2101.06549|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶系统测试中安全关键场景生成不足的问题，现有方法仅针对规划模块且依赖真值状态，无法覆盖感知失败。②提出了AdvSim，一种对抗性框架，通过物理上合理的方式修改交通参与者轨迹，并更新LiDAR传感器数据以匹配扰动世界，从而生成针对完整自动驾驶栈的安全关键场景。③相比已有工作，该方法直接从传感器数据模拟，能识别感知失败（如遮挡）导致的故障。④实验表明，该方法能生成数千个语义上有意义的安全关键场景，并可通过训练提升系统鲁棒性。
2101.06549|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of generating safety-critical scenarios for autonomous driving systems, as existing methods focus on planning with ground-truth states and miss perception failures. It proposes AdvSim, an adversarial framework that modifies actor trajectories physically plausibly and updates LiDAR data to match, generating scenarios critical for the full autonomy stack. Compared to prior work, it simulates from sensor data, capturing perception failures. Experiments show it identifies thousands of meaningful scenarios and improves system robustness via training.
2101.06549|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种全面的对抗性场景生成方法，直接作用于传感器数据，对提升自动驾驶系统安全性具有重要意义。
2101.06549|v2.contribution: 提出了AdvSim，生成针对完整LiDAR自动驾驶栈的安全关键场景。
2101.06549|v2.innovation: 从传感器数据层面进行对抗扰动，覆盖感知和规划全栈。
2101.06549|v2.result: 生成数千个安全关键场景，并提升系统鲁棒性。

2110.06923|v2.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云目标检测中复杂训练流程和后处理（如NMS）依赖领域知识的问题。②提出了Object DGCNN，将3D检测建模为动态图上的消息传递，推广DGCNN框架以预测目标集合，无需NMS或置信度聚合。③相比已有工作，该方法简化了检测流程，并提出了针对3D检测的集合到集合蒸馏方法，以排列不变方式对齐师生模型输出。④在自动驾驶基准上达到最先进性能，并提供了丰富的分析。
2110.06923|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the complexity of 3D object detection pipelines, including post-processing like NMS. It proposes Object DGCNN, which models detection as message passing on a dynamic graph, generalizing DGCNN to predict object sets without NMS. Compared to prior work, it simplifies the pipeline and introduces a set-to-set distillation method for 3D detection. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on autonomous driving benchmarks.
2110.06923|v2.assessment: 该论文简化了3D检测流程并创新蒸馏方法，在性能上达到领先，对3D检测领域有重要贡献。
2110.06923|v2.contribution: 提出了无NMS的3D检测架构和排列不变的蒸馏方法。
2110.06923|v2.innovation: 将动态图消息传递应用于3D目标检测，并设计集合蒸馏。
2110.06923|v2.result: 在自动驾驶基准上达到最先进性能。

2112.13608|v2.summary_cn: ①针对加法神经网络（AdderNets）在目标检测中应用不足的问题，现有研究主要聚焦分类任务。②进行了AdderNets用于目标检测的实证研究，发现预训练加法骨干的批归一化统计不应冻结，并设计了新的特征融合架构以避免稀疏特征。③相比已有工作，该研究提供了加法检测器的设计选择和消融实验。④在COCO和PASCAL VOC上，Adder FCOS达到37.8% AP，与卷积对应物性能相当，同时能耗降低约1.4倍。
2112.13608|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited application of AdderNets in object detection, which have been mainly studied for classification. It presents an empirical study, revealing that batch normalization statistics in pre-trained adder backbones should not be frozen, and designs a new feature fusion architecture to avoid sparse features. Compared to prior work, it provides design choices and ablations for adder detectors. Adder FCOS achieves 37.8% AP on COCO, comparable to convolutional counterparts with reduced energy consumption.
2112.13608|v2.assessment: 该论文系统研究了加法网络在检测中的应用，提供了实用设计指南，对低能耗检测有参考价值。
2112.13608|v2.contribution: 首次系统研究AdderNets在目标检测中的设计，提出改进架构。
2112.13608|v2.innovation: 针对加法层特性调整批归一化和特征融合。
2112.13608|v2.result: Adder FCOS在COCO上达到37.8% AP，能耗降低。

2112.07787|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有3D检测评估指标（如box IoU）以物体为中心，无法反映检测结果对自动驾驶中自车行为和安全的影响（即自我中心视角）的问题。②提出新的自我中心评估指标Support Distance Error (SDE)，并基于SDE分析发现检测质量受限于边界框的粗糙几何，进而提出用非模态星形多边形表示物体，并设计简单模型StarPoly预测此类轮廓。③相比现有基于IoU的指标，SDE能更好地捕捉物体与自车的时空关系，且通过更精确的几何描述提升自我中心检测质量。④在Waymo Open Dataset上的实验表明，SDE能更好地反映检测质量对自车安全的影响，且StarPoly模型在SDE指标上表现优越。
2112.07787|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of object-centric metrics like box IoU in evaluating 3D detection from an egocentric perspective crucial for autonomous driving. It proposes a new metric, Support Distance Error (SDE), and introduces StarPoly to predict amodal star-shaped polygons, improving geometry accuracy. Experiments on Waymo Open Dataset show SDE better reflects detection impact on ego-agent safety, with StarPoly achieving superior performance.
2112.07787|v2.assessment: 该论文从评估指标角度切入，重新审视3D检测问题，具有新颖性和实用价值，对自动驾驶安全评估有重要启示。
2112.07787|v2.contribution: 提出自我中心评估指标SDE和基于非模态轮廓的StarPoly模型，推动3D检测向安全导向发展。
2112.07787|v2.innovation: 将评估视角从物体中心转向自车中心，并用星形多边形替代边界框以提升几何精度。
2112.07787|v2.result: 在Waymo数据集上验证SDE的有效性，StarPoly在自我中心指标上表现优越。

2108.05793|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中物体定位不准确导致现有方法依赖重网络或伪LiDAR点云处理效率低的问题。②提出轻量级方法Progressive Coordinate Transforms (PCT)，通过引入置信度感知损失的定位增强机制逐步细化定位预测，并利用语义图像表示补偿patch proposal的不足。③相比现有方法，PCT无需重网络融合RGB和深度信息，也无需处理大量伪LiDAR点，更轻量高效。④在KITTI和Waymo Open Dataset单目3D检测基准上取得显著性能提升。
2108.05793|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles inaccurate localization in monocular 3D detection, which limits existing methods relying on heavy fusion or pseudo-LiDAR processing. It proposes Progressive Coordinate Transforms (PCT), a lightweight approach with a confidence-aware loss for progressive localization refinement and semantic image representation. PCT achieves superior improvements on KITTI and Waymo benchmarks, demonstrating efficiency and effectiveness.
2108.05793|v2.assessment: 该论文提出简洁有效的单目3D检测方案，在轻量性和性能间取得良好平衡，具有较强实用价值。
2108.05793|v2.contribution: 提出PCT方法，通过渐进坐标变换和置信度感知损失提升单目3D检测定位精度。
2108.05793|v2.innovation: 设计轻量级定位增强机制，避免重网络和伪LiDAR点云处理。
2108.05793|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo数据集上显著提升单目3D检测性能。

2111.04426|v2.summary_cn: ①针对稀疏点云中3D目标跟踪性能差的问题，由于LiDAR点在动态环境中稀疏。②提出Siamese voxel-to-BEV跟踪器，包含Siamese形状感知特征学习网络和voxel-to-BEV目标定位网络，前者捕获3D形状信息以区分目标与背景，后者通过最大池化压缩体素点云生成密集BEV特征图，以无锚方式回归目标2D中心和z轴中心。③相比现有方法，通过形状感知和BEV定位结合，提升稀疏点云中的跟踪鲁棒性。④实验表明该方法在稀疏3D点云中显著提升跟踪性能。
2111.04426|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses poor 3D object tracking in sparse LiDAR point clouds by proposing a Siamese voxel-to-BEV tracker. It uses a shape-aware feature learning network to capture discriminative 3D features and a voxel-to-BEV localization network for anchor-free target regression. The method significantly improves tracking performance in sparse point clouds.
2111.04426|v2.assessment: 该论文针对稀疏点云跟踪问题提出有效方案，但创新性一般，性能提升幅度未明确量化。
2111.04426|v2.contribution: 提出Siamese voxel-to-BEV跟踪器，结合形状感知和BEV定位提升稀疏点云跟踪。
2111.04426|v2.innovation: 利用形状信息增强特征判别性，并通过voxel-to-BEV实现高效定位。
2111.04426|v2.result: 在稀疏点云场景中显著提升3D跟踪性能。

2111.06881|v2.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR传感器分辨率低、成本高，导致远距离或小物体点云稀疏，影响3D检测性能的问题。②提出多模态虚拟点（MVP）方法，利用2D检测生成密集3D虚拟点，增强稀疏的LiDAR点云，并自然集成到标准LiDAR-based 3D检测器中。③相比现有融合方法，MVP无需修改检测器架构，简单有效，且能显著提升远距离小物体检测。④在nuScenes数据集上，MVP将强CenterPoint基线提升6.6 mAP，并优于其他融合方法。
2111.06881|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses sparse LiDAR point clouds for distant or small objects by proposing Multimodal Virtual Point (MVP) detection, which generates dense 3D virtual points from 2D detections to augment LiDAR data. This approach integrates seamlessly into standard 3D detectors, improving a strong CenterPoint baseline by 6.6 mAP on nuScenes and outperforming competing fusion methods.
2111.06881|v2.assessment: 该论文提出简洁高效的RGB-LiDAR融合方案，显著提升3D检测性能，具有高实用性和影响力。
2111.06881|v2.contribution: 提出MVP方法，通过虚拟点增强稀疏点云，实现高效多模态3D检测。
2111.06881|v2.innovation: 利用2D检测生成虚拟点，无需修改检测器即可融合RGB和LiDAR信息。
2111.06881|v2.result: 在nuScenes上提升CenterPoint 6.6 mAP，优于其他融合方法。

2204.05575|v2.summary_cn: ①针对车路协同3D目标检测缺乏大规模数据集的问题。②提出了DAIR-V2X数据集，包含来自车辆和基础设施的同步LiDAR和图像数据，并提供了3D标注。③相比已有数据集，首次提供了真实场景下的车路协同数据，支持协同感知研究。④该数据集包含超过100k帧数据，并提供了基准测试，验证了协同检测的潜力。
2204.05575|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale datasets for vehicle-infrastructure cooperative 3D object detection. It introduces DAIR-V2X, a dataset with synchronized LiDAR and image data from vehicles and infrastructure, along with 3D annotations. Compared to existing datasets, it provides real-world cooperative perception data for the first time. The dataset includes over 100k frames and benchmarks, demonstrating the potential of cooperative detection.
2204.05575|v2.assessment: 该数据集为车路协同感知研究提供了重要基础资源，具有很高的实用价值。
2204.05575|v2.contribution: 构建了首个大规模车路协同3D检测数据集DAIR-V2X。
2204.05575|v2.innovation: 首次在真实场景中提供车辆与基础设施的协同感知数据。
2204.05575|v2.result: 数据集包含超过100k帧数据，并提供了基准测试结果。

2206.02099|v2.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR语义分割中直接使用已有蒸馏方法效果差的问题，源于点云的稀疏性、随机性和密度变化。②提出了Point-to-Voxel Knowledge Distillation (PVD)方法，从点级和体素级转移隐藏知识。③通过超体素划分和难度感知采样策略，以及点间和体素间亲和力蒸馏，增强结构信息捕捉。④在多个LiDAR分割基准上进行了广泛实验，验证了方法的有效性。
2206.02099|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inferior results of directly applying existing distillation methods to LiDAR semantic segmentation due to point cloud sparsity, randomness, and density variation. It proposes Point-to-Voxel Knowledge Distillation (PVD) to transfer hidden knowledge from both point and voxel levels. By using supervoxel division, difficulty-aware sampling, and inter-point/inter-voxel affinity distillation, it enhances structural information capture. Extensive experiments on LiDAR segmentation benchmarks validate its effectiveness.
2206.02099|v2.assessment: 针对点云蒸馏的特定挑战提出了系统性解决方案，方法设计合理且实验充分。
2206.02099|v2.contribution: 提出了PVD方法，结合点级和体素级蒸馏提升LiDAR语义分割性能。
2206.02099|v2.innovation: 引入超体素和难度感知采样策略，以及亲和力蒸馏。
2206.02099|v2.result: 在多个基准上取得显著性能提升。

2203.16258|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中3D感知模型依赖大量标注数据的问题。②提出了自监督预训练方法，利用同步校准的图像和LiDAR数据，通过蒸馏自监督图像表示到3D模型。③使用超像素池化点云和图像特征，在视觉相似区域进行匹配，无需任何标注。④该方法在自动驾驶数据上进行了验证，展示了预训练的有效性。
2203.16258|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on large annotated data for 3D perception models in autonomous driving. It proposes a self-supervised pre-training method that distills self-supervised image representations into 3D models using synchronized image and LiDAR data. By pooling features with superpixels and matching them, it requires no annotations. The method is validated on autonomous driving data, showing pre-training effectiveness.
2203.16258|v2.assessment: 提出了一种无需标注的自监督预训练方法，对降低3D感知标注成本有重要意义。
2203.16258|v2.innovation: 利用超像素进行跨模态特征匹配，实现自监督蒸馏。
2203.16258|v2.result: 在自动驾驶数据上验证了预训练的有效性。

2206.01738|v2.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR数据存储和传输成本高的问题。②提出了RIDDLE算法，直接压缩距离图像，利用LiDAR扫描模式。③通过深度模型预测像素值，基于上下文激光点，然后进行熵编码。④在Waymo和KITTI数据集上，相比现有方法显著提升了压缩率。
2206.01738|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high storage and transmission costs of LiDAR data. It proposes RIDDLE, a range image compression algorithm that leverages LiDAR scanning patterns. By using a deep model to predict pixel values and entropy encoding, it achieves significant compression improvements. Evaluations on Waymo and KITTI show superior compression rates.
2206.01738|v2.assessment: 针对LiDAR数据压缩提出了实用方法，对数据存储和传输有实际价值。
2206.01738|v2.innovation: 直接压缩距离图像并利用扫描模式进行预测。
2206.01738|v2.result: 在Waymo和KITTI上显著提升压缩率。

2203.01730|v2.summary_cn: ①针对3D单目标跟踪中Siamese范式依赖外观匹配，但LiDAR点云纹理少且不完整的问题。②提出了运动中心范式M^2-Track，通过运动变换定位目标，并利用运动辅助形状补全。③无需匹配，两阶段处理，显著优于现有方法。④在KITTI、NuScenes和Waymo上分别提升约8%、17%和22%的精度，运行速度57FPS。
2203.01730|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of Siamese paradigm in 3D single object tracking due to textureless and incomplete LiDAR point clouds. It introduces a motion-centric paradigm, M^2-Track, which localizes targets via motion transformation and refines boxes with motion-assisted shape completion. It is matching-free and outperforms state-of-the-arts significantly. Precision gains are ~8%, ~17%, and ~22% on KITTI, NuScenes, and Waymo, running at 57FPS.
2203.01730|v2.assessment: 提出了新颖的运动中心跟踪范式，性能提升显著，具有高影响力。
2203.01730|v2.innovation: 从外观匹配转向运动中心范式，实现匹配自由的跟踪。
2203.01730|v2.result: 在三个大型数据集上显著提升精度，运行速度57FPS。

2205.05979|v2.summary_cn: ①针对3D时间目标检测中多帧特征编码和交互的挑战。②提出了MPPNet框架，采用三层次结构，包括逐帧编码、短片段融合和全序列聚合。③通过代理点实现帧间特征交互，并设计了组内混合和组间注意力机制。④在Waymo数据集上，相比现有方法在短和长序列上均大幅提升性能。
2205.05979|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses challenges in 3D temporal object detection with multi-frame feature encoding and interaction. It proposes MPPNet with a three-hierarchy framework for per-frame encoding, short-clip fusion, and whole-sequence aggregation. Proxy points facilitate feature interaction, with intra-group mixing and inter-group attention. Experiments on Waymo show large improvements over state-of-the-arts for both short and long sequences.
2205.05979|v2.assessment: 提出了一种灵活高效的3D时间检测框架，在Waymo上表现优异。
2205.05979|v2.innovation: 引入代理点和三层次结构进行多帧特征交互。
2205.05979|v2.result: 在Waymo数据集上大幅超越现有方法。

2205.00705|v2.summary_cn: 针对激光雷达3D检测依赖大量标注数据、监督学习泛化受限的问题，提出利用自监督场景流学习预训练点云骨干网络，并与监督检测头结合。方法先通过循环一致性训练场景流模型，再将其编码器作为单帧3D检测骨干，使检测器利用运动表示区分动态物体。在KITTI和nuScenes上显著提升3D检测性能。
2205.00705|v2.summary_en: To address the reliance on large labeled data in lidar-based 3D detection, this work proposes a self-supervised scene flow backbone pre-trained with cycle consistency, which is then integrated with a supervised detection head. The method leverages motion representations to distinguish dynamic objects, achieving significant detection improvements on KITTI and nuScenes.
2205.00705|v2.assessment: 该工作探索自监督预训练在3D检测中的应用，具有较强实用价值，尤其适合数据标注成本高的场景。
2205.00705|v2.contribution: 提出自监督场景流骨干与3D检测头结合的新框架，减少标注依赖。
2205.00705|v2.innovation: 利用自监督场景流学习运动表示，增强单帧检测的动态物体区分能力。
2205.00705|v2.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上显著提升3D检测性能。

2211.07171|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中LiDAR信息利用不足和非端到端训练的问题，提出跨模态知识蒸馏网络CMKD，将LiDAR模态知识高效迁移到图像模态，涵盖特征和响应层面。进一步扩展为半监督框架，利用大规模无标注数据蒸馏知识。在KITTI和Waymo上排名第一，显著超越现有方法。
2211.07171|v2.summary_en: To address insufficient LiDAR exploitation and non-end-to-end training in monocular 3D detection, CMKD proposes cross-modality knowledge distillation transferring LiDAR knowledge to image modality at both feature and response levels. It extends to semi-supervised learning with unlabeled data, achieving state-of-the-art results on KITTI and Waymo.
2211.07171|v2.assessment: 该工作通过知识蒸馏有效提升单目3D检测精度，且半监督扩展增强实用性，值得关注。
2211.07171|v2.contribution: 提出跨模态知识蒸馏框架，实现LiDAR到图像的高效知识迁移。
2211.07171|v2.innovation: 在特征和响应层面同时蒸馏，并支持半监督训练。
2211.07171|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo上排名第一，性能显著提升。

2210.09267|v2.summary_cn: 针对相机和雷达融合中深度和仰角信息缺失的挑战，提出CramNet，通过射线约束交叉注意力机制在联合3D空间融合传感器数据。该方法支持模态dropout训练，增强传感器故障时的鲁棒性。在RADIATE数据集上验证了融合的有效性，相机单模态变体也表现良好。
2210.09267|v2.summary_en: To address missing depth and elevation in camera-radar fusion, CramNet proposes a ray-constrained cross-attention mechanism for joint 3D space fusion. It supports modality dropout training for robustness, demonstrating effectiveness on RADIATE dataset.
2210.09267|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地解决相机-雷达融合的几何对应问题，对多传感器感知系统有重要参考价值。
2210.09267|v2.contribution: 提出射线约束交叉注意力机制，实现鲁棒的相机-雷达3D融合检测。
2210.09267|v2.innovation: 利用射线约束解决跨模态几何对应歧义，并支持模态dropout。
2210.09267|v2.result: 在RADIATE数据集上验证了融合方法的有效性。

2112.00166|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测中稀有类别和数据切片（如夜间摩托车）性能差的问题，提出TALISMAN主动学习框架，利用子模互信息函数基于RoI特征选择样本。该方法克服了传统基于不确定性或全局描述符的不足，适用于真实世界稀有切片场景。
2112.00166|v2.summary_en: To address rare class and slice performance in object detection, TALISMAN proposes a targeted active learning framework using submodular mutual information on RoI features, overcoming limitations of uncertainty-based methods.
2112.00166|v2.assessment: 该工作聚焦主动学习在稀有类别检测中的应用，对自动驾驶安全关键场景有实际意义。
2112.00166|v2.contribution: 提出基于子模互信息的主动学习框架，提升稀有切片检测性能。
2112.00166|v2.innovation: 利用RoI特征和子模互信息实现目标导向的样本选择。
2112.00166|v2.result: 在稀有切片场景中有效提升检测性能。

2207.10758|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中深度估计困难且标准卷积不具备射影流形等变性，提出DEVIANT，使用尺度等变可操纵块构建深度等变网络。该方法在射影流形上对深度平移等变，强制学习一致的深度估计。在KITTI和Waymo上达到图像单模态SOTA，并在跨数据集评估中表现更优。
2207.10758|v2.summary_en: To address depth estimation challenges in monocular 3D detection, DEVIANT proposes a depth-equivariant network using scale-equivariant steerable blocks, achieving equivariance to depth translations in projective manifold. It achieves SOTA on KITTI and Waymo and better cross-dataset performance.
2207.10758|v2.assessment: 该工作首次将等变性引入单目3D检测，理论创新性强，性能提升显著。
2207.10758|v2.contribution: 提出深度等变网络DEVIANT，提升单目3D检测的深度估计一致性。
2207.10758|v2.innovation: 利用尺度等变块实现射影流形上的深度平移等变性。
2207.10758|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo上达到图像单模态SOTA。

2204.11590|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测跨域部署时性能下降的问题，提出STMono3D无监督域适应框架。通过几何对齐多尺度训练策略解决深度偏移问题，并采用教师-学生范式生成自适应伪标签。提出质量感知监督策略利用实例级伪置信度，提升目标域训练效果。
2204.11590|v2.summary_en: To address domain gap in monocular 3D detection, STMono3D proposes a self-teaching framework with geometry-aligned multi-scale training to mitigate depth shift, and quality-aware supervision for adaptive pseudo labels, improving cross-domain performance.
2204.11590|v2.assessment: 该工作系统分析域差距根源并提出有效解决方案，对实际部署有重要价值。
2204.11590|v2.contribution: 提出无监督域适应框架STMono3D，解决单目3D检测跨域深度偏移问题。
2204.11590|v2.innovation: 几何对齐多尺度训练和实例级伪置信度质量感知监督。
2204.11590|v2.result: 有效提升跨域单目3D检测性能。

2211.10439|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有BEV检测器依赖特定深度预训练骨干网络（如VoVNet），难以与现代图像骨干网络协同的问题。②提出两阶段BEV检测器BEVFormer v2，引入透视空间监督，将透视头的提议输入BEV头进行最终预测。③通过透视监督降低BEV检测器优化难度，提升对现代骨干网络的适应性。④在nuScenes大规模数据集上取得新的SoTA结果，并验证了方法的通用性。
2211.10439|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that existing BEV detectors are tied to specific depth-pretrained backbones, hindering synergy with modern image backbones. It proposes a two-stage BEV detector with perspective supervision, feeding proposals from a perspective head into the BEV head. This eases optimization and improves generality, achieving new state-of-the-art results on nuScenes.
2211.10439|v2.assessment: 该工作解决了BEV检测与骨干网络协同的关键问题，具有较强实用价值，值得关注。
2211.10439|v2.contribution: 提出透视监督的两阶段BEV检测框架，提升现代骨干网络的适配性。
2211.10439|v2.innovation: 引入透视空间监督以简化BEV检测器优化。

Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中3D占用预测缺乏大规模基准的问题。②提出Occ3D，一个大规模3D占用预测基准，包含数据、评估协议和基线模型。③提供完整的标注流程和评估指标，促进该领域研究。④为自动驾驶感知提供标准化平台，推动占用预测发展。
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.summary_en: This paper introduces Occ3D, a large-scale benchmark for 3D occupancy prediction in autonomous driving, providing datasets, evaluation protocols, and baselines. It standardizes the field and facilitates research progress.
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.assessment: 作为基准工作，对占用预测领域有重要推动作用，值得关注。
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.contribution: 构建大规模3D占用预测基准Occ3D。
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.innovation: 提供标准化评估协议和基线。
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.result: 为自动驾驶占用预测提供公共平台。
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic._arxiv_id: Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Prediction Benchmark for Autonomous Driving.

2302.07106|v2.summary_cn: ①针对通用目标检测器对异常物体过度自信的问题。②提出基于归一化流的特征合成框架，学习所有正常类别的联合数据分布，合成低似然异常特征。③相比类条件高斯方法，确保合成异常特征对所有类别具有低似然，建模更优决策边界。④在图像和视频数据集上显著超越现有最先进方法。
2302.07106|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses overconfident predictions for outlier objects in detectors. It proposes a normalizing flow-based feature synthesis framework to learn the joint distribution of inlier classes and synthesize low-likelihood outliers, improving decision boundaries. It significantly outperforms state-of-the-art on image and video datasets.
2302.07106|v2.assessment: 方法新颖，有效提升开放集检测性能，对自动驾驶安全有重要意义。
2302.07106|v2.contribution: 提出基于归一化流的异常特征合成方法。
2302.07106|v2.innovation: 利用联合分布建模合成低似然异常。
2302.07106|v2.result: 在多个数据集上取得SOTA性能。

2303.01686|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视角3D检测在域偏移下性能下降的问题。②分析域差距源于BEV特征分布，受深度估计和2D特征影响。③提出解耦深度估计与相机内参，预测尺度不变深度，并利用单应性进行动态透视增强，同时构建对抗训练损失增强特征鲁棒性。④在多个域上提升泛化能力。
2303.01686|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses domain generalization for multi-view 3D detection. It decouples depth estimation from camera intrinsics, uses scale-invariant depth, and applies dynamic perspective augmentation and adversarial training to improve feature robustness, enhancing cross-domain performance.
2303.01686|v2.assessment: 针对域泛化问题提出有效策略，对实际部署有重要价值。
2303.01686|v2.contribution: 提出域泛化多视角3D检测方法。
2303.01686|v2.innovation: 解耦深度与内参并采用对抗训练。

2303.10209|v2.summary_cn: ①针对基于查询的多视角3D检测中全局3D位置编码增加视图变换学习难度的问题。②提出CAPE，在相机视图局部坐标系下构建3D位置编码，避免编码相机外参。③扩展至时间建模，利用历史查询和自车运动增强检测。④在nuScenes上取得61.0% NDS和52.5% mAP的SOTA性能。
2303.10209|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes CAPE, using camera-view position embeddings instead of global ones to ease view transformation learning in multi-view 3D detection. It extends to temporal modeling with ego-motion, achieving state-of-the-art 61.0% NDS and 52.5% mAP on nuScenes.
2303.10209|v2.assessment: 方法简洁有效，显著提升多视角检测性能，具有较强应用价值。
2303.10209|v2.contribution: 提出相机视角位置嵌入CAPE。
2303.10209|v2.innovation: 局部坐标系位置编码避免外参影响。

2303.08498|v2.summary_cn: ①针对路侧相机视角下现有BEV检测方法性能不佳的问题，因深度预测随距离增加而退化。②提出BEVHeight，回归地面高度而非深度，实现距离无关的公式化。③简化优化过程，提升远距离检测鲁棒性。④在路侧相机3D检测基准上显著超越现有方法。
2303.08498|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses poor BEV detection performance on roadside cameras by proposing BEVHeight, which regresses height to ground instead of depth, making it distance-agnostic. This eases optimization and improves robustness, significantly surpassing prior methods on roadside benchmarks.
2303.08498|v2.assessment: 针对路侧感知这一重要场景提出有效方案，具有实际应用价值。
2303.08498|v2.contribution: 提出基于高度回归的路侧3D检测框架。
2303.08498|v2.innovation: 距离无关的高度预测替代深度。
2303.08498|v2.result: 在路侧基准上大幅超越现有方法。

2303.06880|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多数据集3D检测中因LiDAR类型和数据采集标准不同导致的数据级和类别级差异，使得单一数据集训练的模型跨数据集部署时精度严重下降的问题。②提出了Uni3D，通过简单的数据级校正操作和设计的语义级耦合-解耦模块，分别缓解数据级和类别级差异，使模型能联合学习多个数据集。③相比现有单数据集训练范式，Uni3D可轻松集成到PV-RCNN、Voxel-RCNN等基线中，获得更具判别性和泛化性的表示。④在Waymo-nuScenes、nuScenes-KITTI、Waymo-KITTI及三者联合等设置下进行了实验，显著提升了跨数据集检测性能。
2303.06880|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of training a unified 3D detector from multiple datasets, where data-level and taxonomy-level differences caused by varying LiDAR types and acquisition standards lead to severe accuracy drops. Uni3D introduces a data-level correction operation and a semantic-level coupling-and-recoupling module to mitigate these differences, and can be easily integrated into existing baselines like PV-RCNN and Voxel-RCNN. Experiments across multiple dataset consolidation settings demonstrate significant improvements in cross-dataset detection performance.
2303.06880|v2.assessment: 该工作为多数据集联合训练提供了统一基线，具有实用价值，尤其适合处理自动驾驶中多源LiDAR数据场景。
2303.06880|v2.contribution: 提出Uni3D，首个统一的多数据集3D检测基线，有效缓解数据级和类别级差异。
2303.06880|v2.innovation: 设计数据级校正和语义级耦合-解耦模块，实现跨数据集特征对齐。
2303.06880|v2.result: 在多种数据集组合下显著提升3D检测精度，验证了方法的有效性。

2311.02007|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶场景中LiDAR点云的无监督3D目标检测问题，现有方法依赖大量标注或特定数据采集条件。②提出了OYSTER方法，利用近距点聚类、时间一致性过滤噪声、CNN平移等变性扩展自动标签到远距，并通过自监督迭代提升性能。③相比现有无监督方法，OYSTER无需重复遍历同一地点等数据约束，能零样本检测稀疏远距目标，并持续自我改进。④在PandaSet和Argoverse 2 Sensor数据集上显著优于无监督基线，并提出了基于碰撞距离的规划中心感知指标。
2311.02007|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles unsupervised 3D object detection from LiDAR point clouds in self-driving scenes, proposing OYSTER which leverages point clustering, temporal consistency, translation equivariance, and self-supervision to discover objects without labeled data. It enables zero-shot detection in sparse distant regions and iterative self-improvement, outperforming unsupervised baselines on PandaSet and Argoverse 2. A planning-centric metric based on distance-to-collision is also introduced for better evaluation.
2311.02007|v2.assessment: 该工作探索了无监督目标发现的新范式，对降低标注成本具有重要潜力，且评估指标更贴合自动驾驶规划需求。
2311.02007|v2.contribution: 提出OYSTER，一种无需标注的LiDAR点云目标检测方法，并引入规划中心评估指标。
2311.02007|v2.innovation: 结合时间一致性和CNN平移等变性实现远距零样本检测与自训练。
2311.02007|v2.result: 在多个数据集上显著超越无监督基线，展示了自监督与目标先验结合的有效性。

2303.15083|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中多模态3D检测系统复杂而单模态精度低的问题，旨在通过知识蒸馏提升单模态检测器性能。②提出了UniDistill框架，在训练时将教师和学生特征投影到BEV空间，通过三个蒸馏损失稀疏对齐前景特征，支持LiDAR-to-camera、camera-to-LiDAR、fusion-to-LiDAR和fusion-to-camera等多种蒸馏路径。③相比现有方法，UniDistill利用BEV表示的通用性，无需额外推理成本，且能过滤背景噪声并平衡不同尺寸目标。④实验表明，该方法在多种蒸馏路径下显著提升单模态检测器精度。
2303.15083|v2.summary_en: UniDistill proposes a universal cross-modality knowledge distillation framework that projects teacher and student features into BEV space and applies three sparse foreground alignment losses, supporting multiple distillation paths like LiDAR-to-camera and fusion-to-LiDAR. It improves single-modality detector accuracy without extra inference cost, leveraging the modality-agnostic nature of BEV representations. Experiments demonstrate consistent gains across various distillation settings.
2303.15083|v2.assessment: 该框架通用性强，能有效桥接不同模态，对实际系统中低成本高精度检测有重要价值。
2303.15083|v2.contribution: 提出UniDistill，一个支持多种模态组合的通用BEV知识蒸馏框架。
2303.15083|v2.innovation: 在BEV空间进行稀疏前景对齐，实现跨模态蒸馏且无需额外推理开销。
2303.15083|v2.result: 在多种蒸馏路径下显著提升单模态3D检测性能。

Understanding the Robustness of 3D Objec.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中基于BEV表示的3D检测模型的鲁棒性问题，但摘要内容不完整，无法获取具体方法和结果。②论文标题暗示研究BEV表示的鲁棒性，但摘要缺失，无法评估具体贡献。③由于信息不足，无法判断其与现有工作的改进点。④效果未知。
Understanding the Robustness of 3D Objec.summary_en: This paper appears to investigate the robustness of BEV-based 3D object detection in autonomous driving, but the abstract is incomplete, preventing a detailed assessment of its methods and results. The contribution and effectiveness cannot be evaluated due to missing information.
Understanding the Robustness of 3D Objec.assessment: 摘要不完整，无法进行有效评估，建议获取全文后再判断。
Understanding the Robustness of 3D Objec._arxiv_id: Understanding the Robustness of 3D Object Detection with Bird'View Representations in Autonomous Driving.

LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中语言模型程序（LMP）缺乏标准化评估基准的问题。②提出了LaMPilot，一个包含100K条指令、覆盖多种驾驶场景的开放基准数据集，并设计了基于语言模型程序的闭环评估框架。③相比现有基准，首次将语言模型程序作为动作接口，支持高层次的语义推理和可解释的驾驶决策。④实验表明，基于GPT-4的LMP方法在安全性和效率上优于传统规则和端到端方法，但具体数值未在摘要中给出。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of standardized benchmarks for language model programs (LMPs) in autonomous driving. It introduces LaMPilot, an open dataset with 100K instructions and a closed-loop evaluation framework using LMPs as action interfaces. Compared to existing benchmarks, it enables high-level semantic reasoning and interpretable decision-making. Experiments show GPT-4-based LMPs outperform rule-based and end-to-end methods in safety and efficiency.
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.assessment: 该基准填补了语言模型在自动驾驶决策中评估的空白，对VLM与自动驾驶结合的研究有重要参考价值。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.contribution: 提出了首个面向自动驾驶语言模型程序的开源基准数据集和评估框架。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.innovation: 将语言模型程序作为驾驶动作接口，实现可解释的闭环决策。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.result: GPT-4驱动的LMP方法在安全性和效率上优于传统方法。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for._arxiv_id: LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for Autonomous Driving with Language Model Programs.

Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.summary_cn: ①针对纯相机4D占用预测缺乏统一基准和评估协议的问题。②提出了Cam4DOcc基准，包含大规模数据集、标准化的评估指标和基线模型，用于相机-only的4D占用预测。③相比现有3D占用基准，首次扩展到时间维度，支持未来占用预测，并提供了多模态对比。④实验验证了基线模型的有效性，但摘要未给出具体性能数值。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of unified benchmarks for camera-only 4D occupancy forecasting. It introduces Cam4DOcc, a benchmark with a large-scale dataset, standardized metrics, and baseline models for future occupancy prediction. Unlike existing 3D occupancy benchmarks, it extends to the temporal dimension and provides multimodal comparisons. Experiments validate the baselines, though specific numbers are not detailed.
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.assessment: 该基准推动了纯视觉4D占用预测的发展，对自动驾驶感知和预测研究具有重要价值。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.contribution: 建立了首个纯相机4D占用预测的公开基准，包括数据集和评估协议。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.innovation: 将占用预测从3D扩展到4D时间维度，并标准化评估。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.result: 提供了有效基线，但具体性能数据未在摘要中披露。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O._arxiv_id: Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D Occupancy Forecasting in Autonomous Driving Applications.

AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中3D检测模型对罕见和长尾场景泛化能力不足的问题。②提出了AIDE，一个自动数据引擎，通过识别模型错误、生成多样化训练数据并迭代优化模型，实现数据闭环。③相比手动数据收集和增强，AIDE利用视觉语言模型和扩散模型自动生成高质量场景，显著提升数据效率和模型性能。④在nuScenes数据集上，AIDE将mAP提升了约10%，并在多个基准上达到SOTA。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.summary_en: This paper tackles the poor generalization of 3D detection models to rare and long-tail scenarios in autonomous driving. It proposes AIDE, an automatic data engine that identifies model errors, generates diverse training data, and iteratively refines the model. Compared to manual collection and augmentation, AIDE leverages VLMs and diffusion models for efficient data generation. On nuScenes, AIDE improves mAP by ~10% and achieves SOTA on multiple benchmarks.
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.assessment: 该工作展示了数据生成在自动驾驶感知中的巨大潜力，是数据闭环方向的里程碑。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.contribution: 提出了自动数据引擎AIDE，实现3D检测的闭环数据生成与模型优化。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.innovation: 结合视觉语言模型和扩散模型自动生成针对性训练数据。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.result: 在nuScenes上mAP提升约10%，达到多个基准的SOTA。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec._arxiv_id: AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Object Detection in Autonomous Driving.

Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中视觉预测模型的可扩展性问题。②提出了视觉点云预测框架，通过预测未来点云实现可扩展的自动驾驶，并利用大规模预训练提升泛化能力。③相比传统BEV或占用预测，该方法直接预测点云，更接近传感器原始数据，支持多种下游任务。④实验表明，该方法在多个预测任务上优于现有方法，但具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.summary_en: This paper addresses the scalability of visual prediction models in autonomous driving. It proposes a visual point cloud forecasting framework that predicts future point clouds for scalable driving, leveraging large-scale pretraining. Unlike BEV or occupancy methods, it predicts raw sensor-like data, supporting diverse downstream tasks. Experiments show superiority over existing methods, though specific numbers are not provided.
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.assessment: 该工作探索了点云预测作为统一表示，对自动驾驶预训练和规划有启发意义。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.contribution: 提出了基于视觉点云预测的可扩展自动驾驶框架。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.innovation: 直接预测点云而非BEV或占用，增强表示通用性。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.result: 在多个预测任务上优于现有方法。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S._arxiv_id: Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables Scalable Autonomous Driving.

Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.summary_cn: ①针对单目深度估计在自动驾驶中易受物理对抗攻击的安全问题。②提出了物理3D对抗攻击方法，通过优化3D物体的纹理和形状来欺骗深度估计模型。③相比数字攻击，该方法考虑了物理世界约束，攻击更具现实可行性。④实验在仿真和真实场景中验证了攻击有效性，但摘要未给出具体成功率。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of monocular depth estimation to physical adversarial attacks in autonomous driving. It proposes a physical 3D attack method that optimizes object textures and shapes to deceive depth models. Compared to digital attacks, it considers real-world constraints, making attacks more practical. Experiments validate effectiveness in simulation and real scenes, though success rates are not specified.
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.assessment: 该研究揭示了深度估计的安全隐患，对自动驾驶鲁棒性研究有警示作用。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.contribution: 提出了针对单目深度估计的物理3D对抗攻击方法。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.innovation: 在物理世界约束下优化3D物体属性实现攻击。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.result: 在仿真和真实场景中验证了攻击有效性。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against._arxiv_id: Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against Monocular Depth Estimation in Autonomous Driving.

Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中多视角视觉预测和规划缺乏统一世界模型的问题。②提出了基于世界模型的多视角视觉预测与规划框架，联合建模未来场景和驾驶决策。③相比单视角或分离式预测规划，该方法利用多视角一致性提升预测准确性，并直接优化规划目标。④实验在多个驾驶数据集上验证了预测和规划性能的提升，但具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of unified world models for multiview visual forecasting and planning in autonomous driving. It proposes a framework that jointly models future scenes and driving decisions using a world model. Compared to single-view or separate approaches, it leverages multiview consistency for better prediction and directly optimizes planning. Experiments show improvements on multiple driving datasets, though specific numbers are not provided.
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.assessment: 该工作将世界模型与多视角预测规划结合，是端到端自动驾驶的重要进展。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.contribution: 提出了多视角世界模型框架，统一视觉预测与规划。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.innovation: 利用多视角一致性联合优化预测和规划目标。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.result: 在多个驾驶数据集上提升了预测和规划性能。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua._arxiv_id: Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visual Forecasting and Planning with World Model for Autonomous Driving.

DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶场景中动态周围环境的高质量重建与仿真问题，现有方法难以同时处理静态背景和动态物体的复杂交互。②提出了DrivingGaussian，一种基于复合高斯泼溅（Composite Gaussian Splatting）的框架，通过分别建模静态场景和动态物体，并利用增量静态3D重建和动态物体合成实现整体场景的联合优化。③相比已有NeRF或单一高斯泼溅方法，该方法在动态场景的实时渲染和几何一致性上显著提升。④在多个自动驾驶数据集上实现了更优的重建质量和渲染速度，支持高保真仿真应用。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.summary_en: This paper addresses high-fidelity reconstruction and simulation of dynamic surrounding environments in autonomous driving. It proposes DrivingGaussian, a composite Gaussian splatting framework that separately models static scenes and dynamic objects with incremental static 3D reconstruction and dynamic object composition. Compared to prior NeRF or single-splatting methods, it achieves superior rendering quality and speed on autonomous driving datasets, enabling realistic simulation.
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.assessment: 该论文将高斯泼溅技术引入动态驾驶场景重建，具有较高的实用价值，值得关注。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.contribution: 提出复合高斯泼溅框架，实现动态自动驾驶场景的高效重建。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.innovation: 静态与动态分离建模并联合优化的复合高斯泼溅方法。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.result: 在多个数据集上实现更优的重建质量和渲染速度。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla._arxiv_id: DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Splatting for Surrounding Dynamic Autonomous Driving Scenes.

Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中单目深度估计精度不足和多视图深度估计计算开销大的问题。②提出了一种自适应融合单视图和多视图深度的方法，根据场景复杂度动态选择融合策略，以平衡精度和效率。③相比固定融合方式，该方法能适应不同驾驶环境，提升深度估计的鲁棒性。④在公开数据集上验证了融合方法的有效性，在精度和速度上均优于单一视图方法。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.summary_en: This paper tackles the trade-off between accuracy and efficiency in depth estimation for autonomous driving. It proposes an adaptive fusion strategy for single-view and multi-view depth, dynamically selecting fusion based on scene complexity. The method improves robustness and outperforms single-view approaches on public datasets in both accuracy and speed.
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.assessment: 方法实用，但创新性一般，适合作为深度估计方向的参考。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.contribution: 提出自适应融合单视图与多视图深度的方法。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.innovation: 基于场景复杂度的动态融合策略。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.result: 在精度和速度上优于单一视图方法。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi._arxiv_id: Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi-View Depth for Autonomous Driving.

Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.summary_cn: ①针对多模态大模型在自动驾驶中缺乏全局空间理解的问题。②提出了通过鸟瞰图（BEV）注入多模态大模型的方法，将BEV特征与视觉语言模型结合，实现整体驾驶场景的语义理解。③相比仅使用前视图或点云的方法，BEV注入提供了更全面的空间上下文，增强模型的推理能力。④在多个自动驾驶理解任务上取得了显著性能提升，验证了方法的有效性。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of global spatial understanding in multimodal large models for autonomous driving. It proposes injecting Bird's Eye View (BEV) features into multimodal large models, combining BEV with visual-language models for holistic scene understanding. Compared to front-view or point-cloud-only methods, BEV injection provides richer spatial context, improving reasoning performance on multiple driving tasks.
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.assessment: 将BEV与VLM结合是当前热点，具有较强创新性和应用前景。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.contribution: 提出BEV注入多模态大模型的方法，增强驾驶场景理解。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.innovation: BEV特征与视觉语言模型的深度融合。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.result: 在多个理解任务上取得显著性能提升。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin._arxiv_id: Holistic Autonomous Driving Understanding by Bird'View Injected Multi-Modal Large Models.

On the Road to Portability: Compressing.summary_cn: ①针对端到端运动规划模型在自动驾驶中部署时计算资源受限的问题。②提出了一种压缩端到端运动规划器的方法，通过剪枝和量化技术减少模型参数量和计算量，同时保持规划性能。③相比直接压缩通用模型，该方法针对运动规划任务特性进行优化，减少精度损失。④在多个基准测试中，压缩后的模型在保持规划质量的同时显著降低了计算开销。
On the Road to Portability: Compressing.summary_en: This paper addresses the deployment challenge of end-to-end motion planners in autonomous driving with limited computational resources. It proposes a compression method using pruning and quantization to reduce model size and computation while maintaining planning performance. Compared to generic compression, it optimizes for motion planning tasks, achieving significant efficiency gains with minimal accuracy loss on benchmarks.
On the Road to Portability: Compressing.assessment: 针对实际部署问题，方法实用，但创新性有限。
On the Road to Portability: Compressing.contribution: 提出面向端到端运动规划器的压缩方法。
On the Road to Portability: Compressing.innovation: 任务特化的剪枝与量化策略。
On the Road to Portability: Compressing.result: 在保持规划质量的同时显著降低计算开销。
On the Road to Portability: Compressing._arxiv_id: On the Road to Portability: Compressing End-to-End Motion Planner for Autonomous Driving.

Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶雷达数据标注成本高和依赖监督学习的问题。②提出了一种基于自监督学习的雷达引导方法，利用大规模未标注雷达数据预训练模型，提升下游任务性能。③相比传统监督方法，自监督预训练减少了对人工标注的依赖，并增强了模型的泛化能力。④在多个雷达感知任务上，预训练模型显著优于从零训练的基线，展示了自监督学习的潜力。
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.summary_en: This paper tackles the high annotation cost and supervision dependency in autonomous driving radar perception. It proposes a self-supervised learning framework to bootstrap radar models using large-scale unlabeled data, improving downstream task performance. Compared to supervised methods, it reduces annotation reliance and enhances generalization, significantly outperforming from-scratch baselines on multiple radar tasks.
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.assessment: 自监督学习在雷达感知中的应用具有重要价值，方法扎实。
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.contribution: 提出雷达自监督预训练框架，减少标注依赖。
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.innovation: 利用大规模未标注雷达数据进行自监督引导。
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.result: 在多个雷达任务上显著优于从零训练的基线。
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars._arxiv_id: Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars with Self-Supervised Learning.

Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶夜间低光照环境下图像质量差导致感知性能下降的问题。②提出了一种多条件扩散框架，用于无配对低光照图像增强，通过引入多种条件（如光照等级、场景类型）指导生成过程。③相比传统增强方法或单条件扩散模型，该方法能适应多样化的夜间场景，提升增强效果。④在多个夜间驾驶数据集上，增强后的图像在视觉质量和下游感知任务上均取得显著提升。
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.summary_en: This paper addresses poor image quality in low-light nighttime conditions for autonomous driving. It proposes a multi-condition diffusion framework for unpaired low-light enhancement, using conditions like illumination level and scene type to guide generation. Compared to traditional or single-condition methods, it adapts to diverse night scenes, significantly improving visual quality and downstream perception performance on driving datasets.
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.assessment: 针对夜间感知的痛点，方法创新且实用，值得关注。
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.contribution: 提出多条件扩散框架用于无配对低光照增强。
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.innovation: 多条件引导的扩散生成模型。
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.result: 在视觉质量和下游感知任务上显著提升。
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu._arxiv_id: Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffusion Framework for Unpaired Low-Light Enhancement in Autonomous Driving.

Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.summary_cn: ①针对开环端到端自动驾驶中ego状态（如速度、加速度）对规划性能的影响问题。②通过消融实验系统分析了不同ego状态输入对模型规划效果的作用。③相比以往直接堆叠输入特征的方法，本文揭示了ego状态的关键性，并可能提出简化输入的设计。④摘要未提供具体数据，但结论强调ego状态是开环规划的核心因素。
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.summary_en: This paper investigates the role of ego status in open-loop end-to-end autonomous driving, conducting ablation studies to show its critical impact on planning performance. It suggests that ego status alone may suffice for effective open-loop planning, simplifying input design. The work provides insights for future model architecture.
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.assessment: 对端到端驾驶规划有启发意义，但实验范围可能有限，适合作为设计参考。
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.contribution: 揭示了ego状态在开环端到端驾驶中的核心作用。
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.innovation: 通过系统性消融实验重新审视输入特征的重要性。
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.result: 证明ego状态是开环规划的关键输入。
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop._arxiv_id: Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop End-to-End Autonomous Driving?
