Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.summary_cn: ①针对图像超分辨率任务中模型计算量大、难以高效推理的问题。②探索了在超分辨率网络中应用结构化稀疏性（如通道剪枝）以降低计算成本。③相比通用剪枝方法，该工作专门针对超分辨率网络的特性（如残差结构）进行稀疏性设计。④摘要未提供具体数据，但表明在保持性能的同时实现了推理加速。
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of image super-resolution models for efficient inference. It explores structured sparsity, such as channel pruning, tailored to SR network characteristics like residual blocks. Compared to generic pruning, it offers a specialized approach, achieving inference acceleration with maintained performance, though no specific metrics are provided in the abstract.
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.assessment: 该论文聚焦于超分辨率领域的剪枝，与自动驾驶感知的3D检测、BEV等核心方向关联较弱，但可作为剪枝技术在特定任务中应用的参考。
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.contribution: 为图像超分辨率网络提供了针对性的稀疏化探索。
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.innovation: 将剪枝策略与超分辨率网络结构特性结合。
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.result: 在保持性能的同时实现推理效率提升。
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu._arxiv_id: Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolution for Efficient Inference.

Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.summary_cn: ①针对现有剪枝方法缺乏全局稀疏性约束、导致各层剪枝率不均衡的问题。②提出一种带有全局稀疏性约束的神经网络稀疏化方法，通过优化全局稀疏度目标来统一控制各层剪枝。③相比逐层独立剪枝，该方法能更好地平衡整体模型压缩率与精度。④摘要未给出具体数据，但强调在多个基准上优于现有方法。
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue of imbalanced layer-wise pruning rates in existing methods by introducing a global sparsity constraint. It proposes a sparse training approach that optimizes a global sparsity target across all layers, improving the trade-off between compression and accuracy. The method outperforms prior art on several benchmarks, though specific numbers are not in the abstract.
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.assessment: 全局稀疏性约束是剪枝领域的重要方向，对自动驾驶模型压缩有参考价值，但方法本身非针对感知任务。
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.contribution: 提出全局稀疏性约束的剪枝框架。
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.innovation: 将全局稀疏度作为优化目标统一各层剪枝。
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.result: 在多个基准上优于现有剪枝方法。
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo._arxiv_id: Effective Sparsification of Neural Networks With Global Sparsity Constraint.

Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.summary_cn: ①针对移动端实时超分辨率需求，现有模型难以在算力受限设备上运行。②结合神经架构搜索（NAS）和剪枝搜索，联合优化网络结构和稀疏模式，以在移动端实现实时超分辨率。③相比单独使用NAS或剪枝，联合搜索能更好地适应硬件约束。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在移动设备上达到实时性能。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of real-time super-resolution on mobile devices by jointly searching neural architectures and pruning patterns. It combines NAS and pruning search to optimize both structure and sparsity under hardware constraints. Compared to separate NAS or pruning, this joint approach better adapts to mobile limitations, achieving real-time performance as claimed.
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.assessment: NAS与剪枝的联合搜索对边缘部署有启发，但超分辨率任务与自动驾驶感知核心方向相关性一般。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.contribution: 提出NAS与剪枝联合搜索框架用于移动端超分辨率。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.innovation: 联合优化网络结构和稀疏模式。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.result: 在移动设备上实现实时超分辨率。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso._arxiv_id: Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Resolution with Neural Architecture and Pruning Search.

ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.summary_cn: ①针对传统CNN剪枝方法在移除滤波器时导致精度显著下降的问题。②提出ResRep方法，通过解耦“记忆”和“遗忘”过程：在训练中让部分滤波器通过重参数化变得可移除，同时保持其余部分不变，从而实现无损剪枝。③相比直接剪枝或微调，该方法在保持精度的同时大幅减少计算量。④在ImageNet和CIFAR等基准上，ResRep在相同FLOPs下优于多种SOTA剪枝方法，且精度损失极小。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.summary_en: This paper addresses the accuracy drop in CNN pruning by decoupling the remembering and forgetting processes. ResRep uses re-parameterization to make certain filters removable during training while preserving others, enabling lossless pruning. It achieves state-of-the-art results on ImageNet and CIFAR with minimal accuracy loss at comparable FLOPs, outperforming prior pruning methods.
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.assessment: ResRep是剪枝领域的经典工作，方法简洁有效，对自动驾驶模型压缩有直接参考价值。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.contribution: 提出解耦记忆与遗忘的无损剪枝方法。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.innovation: 通过重参数化实现滤波器可移除性。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.result: 在ImageNet等基准上实现无损剪枝并优于SOTA。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl._arxiv_id: ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupling Remembering and Forgetting.

GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.summary_cn: ①针对基于门控的剪枝方法在训练中不稳定、难以收敛到稀疏解的问题。②提出GDP方法，通过可微分极化（Differentiable Polarization）机制稳定门控训练，使门控值趋向0或1，从而获得清晰的剪枝结构。③相比传统门控剪枝，GDP增强了训练稳定性并提高了剪枝质量。④在多个网络和数据集上，GDP在相同压缩率下精度优于现有门控方法。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.summary_en: This paper addresses the instability of gate-based pruning methods by introducing differentiable polarization. GDP stabilizes gate training by pushing gate values towards 0 or 1, yielding clear pruning structures. It improves training stability and pruning quality, outperforming existing gate-based methods at similar compression ratios on multiple benchmarks.
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.assessment: GDP解决了门控剪枝的稳定性问题，方法具有通用性，对感知模型压缩有参考意义。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.contribution: 提出可微分极化机制稳定门控剪枝。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.innovation: 通过极化损失促进门控二值化。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.result: 在多个数据集上优于现有门控剪枝方法。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v._arxiv_id: GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning via Gates with Differentiable Polarization.

Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.summary_cn: ①针对传统剪枝方法依赖人工设计规则、难以自动适应不同网络结构的问题。②提出Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder（AGED）框架，利用图神经网络自动学习剪枝策略，将网络结构编码为图并解码出剪枝决策。③相比手工规则，AGED能自动发现最优剪枝结构，减少人工干预。④摘要未提供具体数据，但表明在多个基准上达到与SOTA相当的性能。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on manual rules in pruning by proposing an Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder framework. AGED uses graph neural networks to encode network structures and decode pruning decisions automatically. It reduces human intervention and achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art methods on several benchmarks, though specific numbers are not in the abstract.
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.assessment: 将图神经网络用于剪枝策略学习具有创新性，但效果未明确超越现有方法，且与自动驾驶感知关联一般。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.contribution: 提出基于图神经网络的自动剪枝框架。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.innovation: 用图编码器-解码器学习剪枝策略。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.result: 在多个基准上达到与SOTA相当的性能。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne._arxiv_id: Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Network Pruning.

Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.summary_cn: ①针对特征匹配中大量离群对应点导致位姿估计精度下降的问题。②提出了一种基于共识学习的渐进式对应点剪枝方法，通过迭代学习内点一致性来剔除离群点。③相比传统手工几何约束方法，该方法利用可学习网络自动捕获全局和局部共识模式。④在多个标准匹配基准上显著提升了内点率和位姿估计精度。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of outlier correspondences in feature matching. It proposes a progressive pruning method based on consensus learning, which iteratively removes outliers by learning inlier consistency. Compared to hand-crafted geometric constraints, it learns global and local consensus patterns, achieving higher inlier ratios and pose accuracy on standard benchmarks.
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.assessment: 该方法对特征匹配和位姿估计有实用价值，但与自动驾驶核心感知任务关联较弱。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.contribution: 提出了一种基于共识学习的渐进式对应点剪枝框架。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.innovation: 将共识学习与渐进式剪枝结合，实现端到端的离群点剔除。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.result: 在多个基准上提升了内点率和位姿估计精度。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co._arxiv_id: Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Consensus Learning.

Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.summary_cn: ①针对冷冻电镜断层扫描体积图像信噪比低、噪声严重的问题。②提出了一种自监督方法，仅利用单张含噪体积图像，结合稀疏约束进行图像恢复。③相比需要干净标签的监督方法，该方法无需配对数据，更适用于实际成像场景。④实验表明该方法能有效抑制噪声并保留结构细节。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.summary_en: This paper tackles the low signal-to-noise ratio in cryo-electron tomography volumetric images. It proposes a self-supervised restoration method using a single noisy volume with sparsity constraints, eliminating the need for clean labels. The method effectively suppresses noise while preserving structural details.
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.assessment: 领域较为专门，与自动驾驶感知方向相关性低。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.contribution: 提出了一种单张噪声体积的自监督恢复方法。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.innovation: 利用稀疏约束实现无需干净标签的体积图像恢复。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.result: 有效提升图像信噪比和结构保真度。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography Volumetric Image Restoration from Single Noisy Volume with Sparsity Constraint.

Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.summary_cn: ①针对GAN压缩中生成图像质量下降的问题。②提出了一种在线多粒度蒸馏方法，从多个特征粒度（像素、特征图、语义）同时蒸馏知识到轻量生成器。③相比离线蒸馏，在线方式避免了预训练教师模型的额外开销，并更充分利用中间层信息。④在多个GAN压缩任务上取得了更好的生成质量与压缩率平衡。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.summary_en: This paper addresses quality degradation in GAN compression. It proposes an online multi-granularity distillation method that transfers knowledge from multiple feature levels (pixel, feature, semantic) to a lightweight generator. Compared to offline distillation, it avoids extra teacher training and better utilizes intermediate features, achieving better quality-compression trade-offs.
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.assessment: 对模型压缩和知识蒸馏有参考价值，但非自动驾驶核心方向。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.contribution: 提出了在线多粒度蒸馏用于GAN压缩。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.innovation: 多粒度在线蒸馏机制，无需预训练教师。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.result: 在多个GAN压缩任务上取得更优的生成质量。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo._arxiv_id: Online Multi-Granularity Distillation for GAN Compression.

2102.11535|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有NAS方法需要大量训练或评估导致资源消耗大的问题。②提出了一种无需训练的NAS框架TE-NAS，通过分析神经正切核谱和线性区域数量来评估架构，无需任何训练和标签。③相比基于超网或近似训练的方法，该方法完全避免了训练开销，并减少了搜索偏差。④在NAS-Bench-201和DARTS搜索空间上，仅用4个GPU小时即可达到与训练方法相当的性能。
2102.11535|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy resource consumption in NAS. It proposes TE-NAS, a training-free framework that ranks architectures by analyzing the neural tangent kernel spectrum and the number of linear regions, requiring no training or labels. Compared to supernet-based methods, it eliminates training cost and search bias, achieving comparable performance on NAS-Bench-201 and DARTS in only 4 GPU hours.
2102.11535|v2.assessment: 该工作对高效NAS有重要贡献，理论启发性强，值得关注。
2102.11535|v2.contribution: 提出了无需训练的NAS框架TE-NAS。
2102.11535|v2.innovation: 利用NTK谱和线性区域数量作为架构性能指标。
2102.11535|v2.result: 在4个GPU小时内达到与训练方法相当的性能。

2103.09377|v2.summary_cn: ①针对二值神经网络精度低和训练成本高的问题。②提出并证明了多奖券彩票假设，即随机初始化的过参数化网络包含多个子网络，这些子网络无需训练即可达到与训练后稠密网络相当的精度，且对二值量化鲁棒。③相比传统彩票假设，该方法无需迭代训练和剪枝，直接通过剪枝和量化随机权重网络获得紧凑二值网络。④在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上验证了该方法的有效性，模型越深越宽效果越好。
2103.09377|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the low accuracy and high training cost of binary neural networks. It proposes and proves the Multi-Prize Lottery Ticket Hypothesis, showing that over-parameterized random networks contain subnetworks that achieve comparable accuracy to trained dense networks without further training and are robust to binarization. Compared to the original lottery ticket hypothesis, it avoids iterative training, achieving compact binary networks by pruning and quantizing random weights, validated on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet.
2103.09377|v2.assessment: 该工作对网络剪枝和二值化有理论创新，实用性强。
2103.09377|v2.contribution: 提出了多奖券彩票假设并验证了其有效性。
2103.09377|v2.innovation: 无需训练即可获得高精度二值子网络。
2103.09377|v2.result: 在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上实现了高精度二值网络。

2009.08576|v2.summary_cn: ①针对初始化时剪枝方法（如SNIP、GraSP、SynFlow）效果不佳的问题。②通过实验分析发现，这些方法剪枝后的权重随机打乱或重新初始化后精度不变，说明其逐权重决策可被逐层剪枝比例替代。③相比现有方法，该工作揭示了初始化剪枝启发式的局限性，并指出剪枝决策缺乏层内区分度。④实验表明这些方法仅优于随机剪枝，但仍低于训练后幅度剪枝。
2009.08576|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates why pruning at initialization methods underperform. It shows that randomly shuffling pruned weights or resampling initial values preserves accuracy, indicating per-weight decisions are replaceable by per-layer pruning ratios. This reveals limitations of current heuristics, as they only surpass random pruning but remain below post-training magnitude pruning.
2009.08576|v2.assessment: 该工作对初始化剪枝领域有重要批判性分析，启发后续研究。
2009.08576|v2.contribution: 揭示了初始化剪枝方法的逐权重决策可被逐层比例替代。
2009.08576|v2.innovation: 通过随机打乱实验证明剪枝决策缺乏层内区分度。
2009.08576|v2.result: 指出现有初始化剪枝方法效果有限。

Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对网络剪枝领域中的初始化时剪枝（Pruning at Initialization）问题，旨在减少训练成本并保持模型性能。②由于摘要为空，无法确定具体方法，可能涉及在初始化阶段基于某种准则（如梯度或连接敏感性）进行剪枝。③相比已有工作，可能强调无需预训练即可实现高效剪枝，但缺乏细节。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses pruning at initialization to reduce training cost while maintaining performance. The method likely involves criteria-based pruning before training, but details are unavailable due to missing abstract. Improvements over existing methods are unclear, and no quantitative results are provided.
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.assessment: 由于摘要缺失，论文信息不完整，难以评估其学术价值，暂不推荐重点关注。
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.contribution: 提出初始化时剪枝的框架，但缺乏具体细节。
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.innovation: 在初始化阶段进行剪枝，避免预训练开销。

2105.03193|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对网络剪枝后重训练策略（如权重回退和学习率回退）优于传统微调的原因不明的问题。②通过大量实验验证并分析学习率回退的有效性，发现其成功关键在于使用大学习率，并观察到其他大学习率调度（如1-cycle）也有类似现象。③相比已有工作，揭示了学习率调度在剪枝重训练中的关键作用，并展示随机剪枝网络配合合适调度可超越方法性剪枝网络。④实验表明，正确选择学习率调度可显著提升剪枝后模型性能，甚至随机剪枝优于传统微调的方法性剪枝。
2105.03193|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates why retraining variants like weight rewinding and learning rate rewinding outperform fine-tuning in pruned networks. Through extensive experiments, it identifies large learning rates as the key factor, and shows that random pruning with appropriate schedules can beat methodical pruning with fine-tuning. The findings emphasize the critical role of learning rate schedules in retraining.
2105.03193|v2.assessment: 该论文对剪枝重训练机制提供了深入分析，对实际剪枝应用有重要指导意义，值得关注。
2105.03193|v2.contribution: 揭示学习率调度在剪枝重训练中的核心作用。
2105.03193|v2.innovation: 发现大学习率是学习率回退成功的关键，并推广到其他调度。
2105.03193|v2.result: 随机剪枝配合大学习率调度可超越传统微调的方法性剪枝。

Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对基于幅度的剪枝方法中，全局稀疏度分配不均导致性能下降的问题。②提出了层自适应稀疏度方法，根据每层的重要性动态分配剪枝比例。③相比固定比例剪枝，该方法能更合理地保留关键层参数，提升剪枝后模型精度。④由于摘要不完整，具体效果数据未提供，但预期在图像分类等任务上优于均匀剪枝。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of uneven sparsity distribution in magnitude-based pruning. It proposes a layer-adaptive sparsity method that dynamically allocates pruning ratios based on layer importance. Compared to fixed-ratio pruning, it better preserves critical parameters, potentially improving accuracy, though specific results are unavailable.
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.assessment: 论文针对剪枝中的关键问题提出改进，但摘要信息有限，需进一步阅读全文评估。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.contribution: 提出层自适应稀疏度分配策略。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.innovation: 基于层重要性动态调整剪枝比例。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.result: 预期提升剪枝后模型性能，但无具体数据。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud._arxiv_id: Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitude-based Pruning.

2210.06707|v2.summary_cn: ①针对低比特量化视觉Transformer（ViT）性能严重下降的问题，特别是自注意力图的信息失真。②提出了信息校正模块（IRM）和分布引导蒸馏（DGD）方案，用于全量化ViT（Q-ViT），以消除量化引起的注意力图失真。③相比现有量化方法，首次系统分析了低比特ViT性能瓶颈，并针对性地设计校正和蒸馏策略。④在DeiT和Swin骨干上，Q-ViT显著优于先前方法，例如ViT-S的理论加速可达6倍，同时保持较高精度。
2210.06707|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the severe performance drop in low-bit quantized vision transformers (ViTs), identifying information distortion in self-attention maps as the bottleneck. It proposes an information rectification module (IRM) and a distribution-guided distillation (DGD) scheme for fully quantized ViTs (Q-ViT), achieving superior performance on DeiT and Swin backbones with up to 6x theoretical acceleration for ViT-S.
2210.06707|v2.assessment: 该论文为低比特ViT量化提供了系统性解决方案，对边缘部署有重要价值，值得关注。
2210.06707|v2.contribution: 提出了针对全量化ViT的信息校正与蒸馏框架，显著提升低比特性能。
2210.06707|v2.innovation: 首次识别自注意力图失真为量化瓶颈，并设计IRM和DGD联合优化。
2210.06707|v2.result: 在多个ViT骨干上实现SOTA量化性能，ViT-S加速6倍且精度损失小。

2203.09931|v2.summary_cn: ①针对大规模非结构化3D点云属性压缩问题，旨在减少存储开销。②提出了3DAC深度压缩网络，将颜色和反射率等属性转换为变换系数，并设计深度熵模型建模概率，最终压缩为属性比特流。③相比现有方法，显式建模属性变换和先前编码属性的信息，提升压缩率。④在ScanNet和SemanticKITTI数据集上，3DAC实现了优越的压缩率和重建质量。
2203.09931|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles attribute compression for large-scale unstructured 3D point clouds, proposing 3DAC, a deep compression network that converts attributes to transform coefficients and uses a deep entropy model for probability estimation. It achieves superior compression rates and reconstruction quality on ScanNet and SemanticKITTI.
2203.09931|v2.assessment: 对点云存储和传输有实际意义，但相关性略低于核心感知任务。
2203.09931|v2.contribution: 提出了3DAC深度熵模型，有效压缩点云属性。
2203.09931|v2.innovation: 利用属性变换和先前编码信息建模概率，提升压缩效率。
2203.09931|v2.result: 在公开数据集上实现SOTA压缩率与重建质量。

2204.12684|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有点云压缩方法忽略局部密度信息的问题，影响细节表示。②提出了一种密度保持的深度点云压缩方法，采用自编码器结构，编码器下采样并学习点特征，解码器上采样，并设计密度嵌入、局部位置嵌入和祖先嵌入。③通过显式预测上采样因子和方向/尺度，并设计子点卷积层，缓解聚类问题。④在SemanticKITTI和ShapeNet上，实现了SOTA的率失真权衡。
2204.12684|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the overlooked local density in point cloud compression, proposing a density-preserving deep method with an auto-encoder that encodes density and geometry embeddings, and decodes with adaptive upsampling. It achieves state-of-the-art rate-distortion trade-off on SemanticKITTI and ShapeNet.
2204.12684|v2.assessment: 对点云处理有贡献，但更偏向压缩而非感知，相关性中等。
2204.12684|v2.contribution: 提出了密度保持的点云压缩框架，提升细节保留。
2204.12684|v2.innovation: 引入密度嵌入和子点卷积，解决聚类问题。
2204.12684|v2.result: 在多个数据集上实现SOTA压缩性能。

2202.10203|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中任务间干扰导致灾难性遗忘的问题。②提出了稀疏神经网络持续学习（SNCL），使用变分贝叶斯稀疏先验激活神经元，并结合全经验回放（FER）和损失感知的储层采样策略。③相比现有方法，通过稀疏激活减少参数干扰，保留模型容量。④在多个基准上，SNCL显著优于现有CL方法，有效缓解遗忘。
2202.10203|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by proposing SNCL, a sparse neural network with variational Bayesian sparsity priors and full experience replay, which minimizes parameter interference. It outperforms existing CL methods on benchmarks, effectively reducing forgetting.
2202.10203|v2.assessment: 对持续学习场景有重要价值，与自动驾驶自适应感知相关。
2202.10203|v2.contribution: 提出了基于贝叶斯稀疏和全经验回放的持续学习框架。
2202.10203|v2.innovation: 利用稀疏激活减少任务间干扰，并设计损失感知采样。
2202.10203|v2.result: 在多个CL基准上实现SOTA性能。

2110.08232|v2.summary_cn: ①针对动态剪枝中任务损失和正则化损失平衡复杂、超参数选择不透明的问题。②提出了一种基于自监督掩码预测的动态剪枝方法，灵感来自Hebbian理论，预测当前层滤波器掩码，并作为二分类问题训练。③通过解耦任务和剪枝损失，并基于热图质量动态估计k值，简化超参数选择。④在多个网络和数据集上，实现了FLOPs减少和精度保持，优于现有动态剪枝方法。
2110.08232|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses complexity in dynamic pruning by proposing a self-supervised mask prediction approach inspired by Hebbian theory, decoupling task and pruning losses and enabling pre-training FLOPs estimation. It achieves effective FLOPs reduction with maintained accuracy, outperforming prior methods.
2110.08232|v2.assessment: 对模型压缩和高效推理有重要贡献，与自动驾驶部署相关。
2110.08232|v2.contribution: 提出了自监督掩码预测的动态剪枝方法，简化训练流程。
2110.08232|v2.innovation: 基于Hebbian理论和热图质量动态估计剪枝率。
2110.08232|v2.result: 在多个基准上实现SOTA剪枝性能。

Revisiting Random Channel Pruning for Ne.summary_cn: ①该论文摘要不完整，无法获取具体问题和方法细节。②根据标题，可能重新审视随机通道剪枝在神经网络压缩中的作用。③缺乏实验数据和详细描述，难以评估改进点。④效果未知。

2110.12007|v2.summary_cn: ①针对传统剪枝方法在训练后期进行导致训练计算量大的问题，以及训练前剪枝导致性能下降的问题。②提出一种策略，在训练早期进行结构剪枝，通过初始密集训练几个epoch快速引导架构，并利用神经元重要性排序持续评估主导子网络，引入早期剪枝指标（EPI）基于子网络架构相似性触发剪枝。③相比已有工作，结合了训练后剪枝和训练前剪枝的优点，在不损害性能的前提下尽可能早地剪枝。④在ImageNet上的实验表明，EPI能够快速跟踪适合剪枝的早期训练epoch，实现训练成本降低且性能保持。
2110.12007|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between post-training pruning (efficient inference but heavy training) and pre-training pruning (training cost reduction but performance degradation). It proposes an early structural pruning policy that uses a few dense training epochs to guide architecture discovery and an Early Pruning Indicator (EPI) based on sub-network architectural similarity to trigger pruning when structure stabilizes. Experiments on ImageNet show EPI effectively identifies early epochs suitable for pruning, reducing training cost without hurting performance.
2110.12007|v2.assessment: 该论文为网络剪枝领域提供了新的视角，即剪枝时机的重要性，对训练效率优化有实际意义，但方法复杂度较高。
2110.12007|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于子网络架构稳定性的早期剪枝策略，平衡了训练效率和模型性能。
2110.12007|v2.innovation: 引入早期剪枝指标（EPI）动态判断剪枝时机，而非固定于初始化或训练后。
2110.12007|v2.result: 在ImageNet上实现了早期剪枝，降低了训练成本且保持了模型性能。

2203.07808|v2.summary_cn: ①针对非结构化剪枝在训练前或训练中应用时，固定子空间约束导致强偏差的问题。②提出交叉空间剪枝（IP），使用自适应滤波器基的线性组合表示滤波器，在动态交叉空间中剪枝，将基系数置零而训练未剪枝系数和基。③相比标准非结构化剪枝，IP提供了数学证据证明其优越性，并在所有测试的先进非结构化剪枝方法上表现更好。④在ImageNet和高稀疏度等挑战性场景下，IP在相同运行时和参数成本下显著超越标准剪枝，性能提升归因于改进的可训练性和超参数鲁棒性。
2203.07808|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the bias induced by standard unstructured pruning (SP) which fixes a subspace for filters, especially when applied before or during training. It introduces interspace pruning (IP), which represents filters in a dynamic interspace via linear combinations of an adaptive filter basis, zeroing basis coefficients while jointly training unpruned coefficients and bases. IP outperforms SP on all tested state-of-the-art pruning methods, especially in challenging scenarios like ImageNet or high sparsity, with equal runtime and parameter costs, due to improved trainability.
2203.07808|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种新颖的剪枝表示方法，理论上和实验上均验证了其优势，对稀疏训练领域有重要贡献。
2203.07808|v2.contribution: 提出了交叉空间剪枝（IP），通过自适应滤波器基改进非结构化剪枝的训练效果。
2203.07808|v2.innovation: 利用动态滤波器基表示替代固定子空间，增强了剪枝后模型的可训练性。
2203.07808|v2.result: 在多个数据集和剪枝方法上，IP显著优于标准非结构化剪枝，尤其在ImageNet和高稀疏度场景。

2205.11819|v2.summary_cn: ①针对特洛伊攻击检测问题，即在无干净训练数据情况下识别被注入触发器的DNN。②提出利用稀疏性检测特洛伊网络，通过观察特洛伊特征对网络剪枝更稳定，定位“获胜特洛伊彩票”子网络，该子网络保留几乎全部特洛伊信息但在干净输入上仅随机性能，然后恢复嵌入的触发器。③相比已有检测方法，无需干净数据，创新性地结合了彩票假设和剪枝。④在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet等数据集上，使用不同网络架构进行了广泛实验，验证了方法的有效性。
2205.11819|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses Trojan attack detection in DNNs without access to clean training data. It leverages sparsity by observing that Trojan features are more stable to network pruning than benign ones, and proposes locating a 'winning Trojan lottery ticket' subnetwork that preserves Trojan information but performs at chance level on clean inputs, then recovering the trigger. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet with various architectures demonstrate its effectiveness.
2205.11819|v2.assessment: 该论文将剪枝与安全检测结合，提出了新颖且实用的特洛伊检测方法，对模型安全性研究有重要价值。
2205.11819|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于稀疏性的特洛伊网络检测框架，无需干净训练数据即可恢复触发器。
2205.11819|v2.innovation: 利用特洛伊特征对剪枝的稳定性差异，通过彩票假设隔离特洛伊子网络。
2205.11819|v2.result: 在多个数据集和架构上成功检测特洛伊网络并恢复触发器，性能优于现有方法。

2204.12266|v2.summary_cn: ①针对图像恢复任务中深度模型计算量大，而现有N:M结构化剪枝未考虑不同层计算复杂度和性能需求差异的问题。②提出一种新颖的剪枝方法，为每层确定N:M结构化稀疏的剪枝比例，以优化效率和恢复精度之间的权衡。③相比已有N:M剪枝，该方法实现了层自适应剪枝，更贴合图像恢复网络的需求。④在超分辨率和去模糊任务上的实验表明，该方法显著优于之前的剪枝方法，代码已开源。
2204.12266|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of N:M structured pruning for image restoration, which ignores varying computational and performance requirements across layers. It proposes a novel pruning method that determines per-layer pruning ratios for N:M structured sparsity, optimizing the trade-off between efficiency and restoration accuracy. Experiments on super-resolution and deblurring tasks show significant improvements over previous pruning methods.
2204.12266|v2.assessment: 该论文针对图像恢复任务定制了剪枝策略，具有实际应用价值，但创新性相对有限。
2204.12266|v2.contribution: 提出了层自适应N:M结构化剪枝方法，用于图像恢复网络的高效压缩。
2204.12266|v2.innovation: 根据层复杂度动态调整剪枝比例，而非统一设置。
2204.12266|v2.result: 在超分辨率和去模糊任务上，性能显著优于现有剪枝方法。

2210.07372|v2.summary_cn: ①针对点云3D目标检测中固有的稀疏占用问题，以及现有Transformer方法未充分利用稀疏性的挑战。②提出SWFormer，一种基于窗口的稀疏Transformer，将3D点转换为稀疏体素和窗口，通过分桶方案高效处理变长稀疏窗口，并引入多尺度特征融合和窗口移位捕获跨窗口相关性，以及体素扩散技术解决稀疏特征检测难题。③相比之前的方法，SWFormer充分利用点云稀疏性，实现了可扩展和准确的检测。④在Waymo开放数据集上，SWFormer在官方测试集上达到73.36 L2 mAPH（车辆和行人），优于所有先前单阶段和两阶段模型，且效率更高。
2210.07372|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the sparse nature of point clouds in 3D object detection, which limits the effectiveness of standard Transformers. It proposes SWFormer, a sparse window Transformer that converts points into sparse voxels and windows, processes them efficiently via bucketing, and captures cross-window correlations with multi-scale fusion and shifting, plus a voxel diffusion technique. On the Waymo Open Dataset, SWFormer achieves state-of-the-art 73.36 L2 mAPH on vehicle and pedestrian, outperforming all previous models while being more efficient.
2210.07372|v2.assessment: 该论文是3D检测领域的重要进展，创新性地将稀疏窗口Transformer应用于点云，性能卓越，对自动驾驶感知有直接贡献。
2210.07372|v2.contribution: 提出了SWFormer，一种高效利用点云稀疏性的窗口Transformer，用于3D目标检测。
2210.07372|v2.innovation: 结合稀疏窗口、分桶方案和体素扩散，解决了稀疏点云中的检测挑战。
2210.07372|v2.result: 在Waymo数据集上达到SOTA性能，优于所有先前模型。

2209.00219|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多实例点云配准问题，即估计源点云在目标点云中的多个姿态，挑战在于一个实例的内点对应关系是其他实例的外点。②提出PointCLM，一种基于对比学习的框架，首先利用对比学习学习输入假定对应关系的良好分布深度表示，然后基于这些表示提出外点剪枝策略和聚类策略，高效移除外点并将剩余对应关系分配给正确实例。③相比已有依赖耗时假设采样或空间一致性特征的方法，PointCLM更高效且性能更好。④在合成和真实数据集上，PointCLM大幅优于现有最先进方法。
2209.00219|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-instance point cloud registration, where inlier correspondences of one instance are outliers for others, making it challenging. It proposes PointCLM, a contrastive learning framework that learns well-distributed deep representations for putative correspondences, then uses an outlier pruning strategy and clustering to remove outliers and assign correspondences to correct instances. PointCLM outperforms state-of-the-art methods on both synthetic and real datasets by a large margin.
2209.00219|v2.assessment: 该论文在多实例配准问题上提出了有效的对比学习方案，方法新颖且性能显著，对3D感知有参考价值。
2209.00219|v2.contribution: 提出了基于对比学习的多实例点云配准框架，结合外点剪枝和聚类策略。
2209.00219|v2.innovation: 利用对比学习学习判别性表示，并设计高效的外点剪枝和聚类方法。
2209.00219|v2.result: 在合成和真实数据集上大幅超越现有最先进方法。

2205.00760|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模点云压缩中熵编码效率低的问题，提出一种基于八叉树的多级框架，利用兄弟节点子代、祖先和邻居的上下文构建熵模型，并引入体素几何感知模块拟合二次曲面提供几何先验，从而将占用信息编码为更紧凑的比特流。相比现有方法，在KITTI Odometry和nuScenes数据集上分别实现了11-16%和12-14%的比特率降低，同时通过两步启发式解码策略提升了重建质量。
2205.00760|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of entropy coding in large-scale point cloud compression by proposing an octree-based multi-level framework that leverages sibling, ancestor, and neighbor contexts, along with voxel-based quadratic surface priors, to encode occupancy information compactly. It achieves 11-16% and 12-14% bitrate reductions on KITTI Odometry and nuScenes datasets, respectively, with improved reconstruction quality via a two-step heuristic decoding strategy.
2205.00760|v2.assessment: 该论文针对自动驾驶场景中的点云压缩问题，提出了有效的熵模型和几何先验，显著提升了压缩效率，对自动驾驶感知系统的数据传输和存储具有重要价值。
2205.00760|v2.contribution: 提出了一种结合上下文和表面先验的八叉树点云压缩框架，显著降低了比特率。
2205.00760|v2.innovation: 创新性地将兄弟子代上下文和局部二次曲面拟合引入熵编码，增强了模型对点云结构的建模能力。
2205.00760|v2.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上分别实现了11-16%和12-14%的比特率降低。

2209.08194|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer在人体姿态估计中全局注意力计算开销大的问题，提出Token剪枝姿态Transformer（PPT），通过定位粗略人体掩膜并仅对选定token进行自注意力计算，显著降低计算复杂度。该方法扩展到多视角场景，提出人体区域融合策略，将所有人前景像素作为对应候选，在COCO和MPII上达到与先前方法相当的精度，同时减少计算量，并在Human3.6M和Ski-Pose上实现新的最先进性能。
2209.08194|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost of global attention in vision transformers for human pose estimation by proposing the token-Pruned Pose Transformer (PPT), which performs self-attention only on selected tokens within a rough human mask. It extends to multi-view with a human area fusion strategy, achieving comparable accuracy on COCO and MPII with reduced computation, and state-of-the-art results on Human3.6M and Ski-Pose.
2209.08194|v2.assessment: 该论文通过token剪枝有效降低了Transformer在姿态估计中的计算开销，并成功扩展到多视角场景，对高效视觉Transformer设计具有参考价值。
2209.08194|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于token剪枝的高效姿态估计Transformer，并设计了多视角融合策略。
2209.08194|v2.innovation: 创新性地利用人体掩膜进行token剪枝，并引入人体区域融合以增强多视角一致性。
2209.08194|v2.result: 在多个基准上达到最先进性能，同时显著减少计算量。

SPViT: Enabling Faster Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper introduces SPViT, a latency-aware soft token pruning method for vision transformers, which dynamically prunes redundant tokens based on hardware latency to accelerate inference. It aims to improve speed while maintaining accuracy, but the abstract lacks detailed experimental results.
SPViT: Enabling Faster Vision Transforme.assessment: 该论文关注Transformer的效率优化，与视觉感知相关，但摘要信息有限，需进一步查阅全文。

2204.04662|v2.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出两阶段学习范式FOSTER，灵感来自梯度提升算法。第一阶段动态扩展新模块以拟合目标模型与原始模型输出之间的残差，第二阶段通过有效的蒸馏策略移除冗余参数和特征维度，保持单骨干网络。在CIFAR-100和ImageNet-100/1000上验证了方法的有效性，达到最先进性能。
2204.04662|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning by proposing a two-stage paradigm FOSTER, inspired by gradient boosting. It first expands new modules to fit residuals between target and original model outputs, then removes redundant parameters via distillation to maintain a single backbone, achieving state-of-the-art performance on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-100/1000.
2204.04662|v2.assessment: 该论文在类增量学习领域提出了新颖的两阶段方法，有效平衡了稳定性和可塑性，对持续学习研究有重要贡献。
2204.04662|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于梯度提升的两阶段类增量学习框架，实现了高效的知识更新和压缩。
2204.04662|v2.innovation: 创新性地将残差拟合和特征压缩结合，解决了稳定性-可塑性困境。
2204.04662|v2.result: 在多个基准上达到最先进性能。

2212.08254|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在后训练量化（PTQ）中低比特精度下降严重的问题。②提出RepQ-ViT框架，通过量化尺度重参数化解耦量化与推理过程，对LayerNorm后激活使用通道级量化，对Softmax后激活使用log√2量化，再重参数化为硬件友好的层级量化。③相比现有方法，不牺牲量化性能来适配硬件，而是同时保证精度和推理效率。④在低比特场景下显著减少精度损失，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2212.08254|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses severe accuracy degradation in post-training quantization of vision transformers at low bit-widths. It proposes RepQ-ViT, which decouples quantization and inference via scale reparameterization, applying channel-wise and log√2 quantization to extreme activations, then reparameterizing to hardware-friendly forms. This achieves both accurate quantization and efficient inference, outperforming prior PTQ methods.
2212.08254|v2.assessment: 该论文为ViT量化提供了新思路，对部署场景有实用价值，但属于模型压缩方向，与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联度中等。
2212.08254|v2.contribution: 提出基于尺度重参数化的ViT后训练量化框架，解决低比特精度下降问题。
2212.08254|v2.innovation: 解耦量化与推理过程，结合复杂量化器与简化推理量化器。
2212.08254|v2.result: 在低比特量化下减少精度损失，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。

2303.17605|v2.summary_cn: ①针对高分辨率视觉Transformer计算复杂度高、难以在延迟敏感应用（如自动驾驶）中部署的问题。②提出SparseViT，利用窗口注意力中激活稀疏性，通过窗口激活剪枝实现实际加速，并引入稀疏感知适应和进化搜索优化层间稀疏配置。③相比CNN，窗口ViT的批处理特性使剪枝能转化为真实延迟降低。④在单目3D检测任务中，相比密集模型实现1.5倍、1.4倍和1.3倍加速，60%稀疏度下延迟降低约50%。
2303.17605|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles high computational cost of high-resolution vision transformers in latency-sensitive applications. SparseViT leverages activation sparsity in window-based ViTs, enabling actual speedup via window activation pruning, with sparsity-aware adaptation and evolutionary search for optimal layerwise sparsity. It achieves 1.5x, 1.4x, and 1.3x speedups in monocular 3D detection, with ~50% latency reduction at 60% sparsity.
2303.17605|v2.assessment: 该论文直接面向自动驾驶3D检测场景，将剪枝转化为实际加速，具有高实用价值。
2303.17605|v2.contribution: 提出SparseViT，实现窗口ViT激活稀疏性带来的实际延迟降低。
2303.17605|v2.innovation: 利用窗口注意力的批处理特性，结合进化搜索优化层间稀疏配置。
2303.17605|v2.result: 在单目3D检测中实现1.3-1.5倍加速，60%稀疏度下延迟降低约50%。

2304.10716|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer中token剪枝导致信息丢失、性能下降的问题。②提出联合Token剪枝与压缩模块（TPS），先剪枝保留子集，再通过单向最近邻匹配和相似性融合将剪枝token信息压缩到保留token中。③相比仅剪枝方法，减少信息损失，提升压缩效率。④在ImageNet分类中，将DeiT-tiny和small计算量缩减至35%时，相比基线提升1%-6%准确率。
2304.10716|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses information loss in token pruning for vision transformers. It proposes a joint Token Pruning & Squeezing module (TPS) that prunes tokens and squeezes their information into reserved tokens via nearest-neighbor matching and similarity-based fusion. This reduces information loss, improving accuracy by 1%-6% over baselines at 35% computational budget on ImageNet.
2304.10716|v2.assessment: 该论文在ViT压缩领域有创新，但主要面向图像分类，与自动驾驶感知关联度一般。
2304.10716|v2.contribution: 提出联合剪枝与压缩模块，减少token剪枝的信息损失。
2304.10716|v2.innovation: 通过单向最近邻匹配和相似性融合实现信息压缩。
2304.10716|v2.result: 在ImageNet上以35%计算量提升1%-6%准确率。

2305.10727|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer在GPU上加速部署困难的问题。②提出GPUSQ-ViT压缩方案，结合2:4结构化剪枝和量化，利用GPU对稀疏模式和整数张量的加速，并通过稀疏蒸馏感知的量化感知训练和混合策略知识蒸馏。③相比现有方法，最大化利用GPU硬件特性，支持监督和无监督学习。④在模型大小上减少6.4-12.7倍，推理速度提升30.3-62倍。
2305.10727|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses challenging acceleration deployment of vision transformers on GPU. GPUSQ-ViT combines 2:4 structured pruning and quantization, leveraging GPU acceleration for sparse patterns and integer tensors, with sparse-distillation-aware QAT and mixed-strategy KD. It achieves state-of-the-art compression, reducing model size 6.4-12.7x and speeding up inference 30.3-62x.
2305.10727|v2.assessment: 该论文针对GPU硬件优化ViT压缩，具有实际部署价值，但主要面向通用视觉任务，与自动驾驶感知间接相关。
2305.10727|v2.contribution: 提出GPU友好的ViT压缩方案，结合2:4稀疏性和量化。
2305.10727|v2.innovation: 利用GPU的2:4稀疏计算加速，结合稀疏蒸馏感知的量化训练。
2305.10727|v2.result: 模型大小减少6.4-12.7倍，推理速度提升30.3-62倍。

2303.04935|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer模型计算成本高、内存占用大，且现有剪枝方法缺乏可解释性、忽略内部单元与目标类别关系的问题。②提出X-Pruner框架，通过端到端学习可解释性感知掩码来度量每个可剪枝单元对目标类别的贡献，并自适应搜索逐层剪枝阈值。③相比现有不可解释的剪枝方法，创新性地将可解释性融入剪枝准则，能保留最具信息量的单元。④在DeiT和Swin Transformer等代表性模型上进行了综合实验，验证了方法的有效性。
2303.04935|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and memory footprint of vision transformers and the lack of explainability in existing pruning methods. It proposes X-Pruner, a novel explainable pruning framework that learns explainability-aware masks end-to-end to measure each unit's contribution to target classes and adaptively searches layer-wise thresholds. Compared to unexplainable pruning, it preserves the most informative units, with comprehensive experiments on DeiT and Swin Transformer demonstrating its effectiveness.
2303.04935|v2.assessment: 该论文将可解释性引入剪枝准则，为Transformer剪枝提供了新视角，值得关注。
2303.04935|v2.contribution: 提出一种基于可解释性感知掩码的视觉Transformer剪枝框架X-Pruner。
2303.04935|v2.innovation: 创新性地将可解释性度量融入剪枝掩码学习，实现端到端自适应剪枝。
2303.04935|v2.result: 在DeiT和Swin Transformer上验证了剪枝性能的优越性。

Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of limited labeled data in semi-supervised semantic segmentation by proposing a density-guided contrastive learning method that exploits sparsity. It enhances feature learning by leveraging density information, improving over existing semi-supervised approaches. Experiments confirm its effectiveness, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.assessment: 方法有一定创新性，但摘要信息有限，需进一步阅读全文评估。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.contribution: 提出密度引导的对比学习框架用于半监督语义分割。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.innovation: 利用密度信息引导对比学习，挖掘数据稀疏性。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.result: 在半监督分割任务上取得性能提升。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras._arxiv_id: Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contrastive Learning for Semi-Supervised Semantic Segmentation.

2303.14042|v2.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中内存预算有限、旧类样本存储受限的问题。②提出通过下采样非判别性像素压缩样本，并生成0-1掩码，从而在内存中保存更多压缩样本。③提出类增量掩码生成模型CIM，解决CAM热图阈值选择困难和动态环境下的阈值变化问题。④通过双层优化交替训练CIM和CIL模型，实验验证了方法的有效性。
2303.14042|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited memory budget in exemplar-based class-incremental learning by compressing exemplars via downsampling non-discriminative pixels and generating 0-1 masks. It proposes a class-incremental masking model to handle CAM threshold issues and dynamic environments, optimized via bilevel optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate its effectiveness.
2303.14042|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地压缩样本以突破few-shot限制，对持续学习领域有重要价值。
2303.14042|v2.contribution: 提出样本压缩策略和CIM模型，突破类增量学习中的内存限制。
2303.14042|v2.innovation: 通过自适应掩码生成实现样本压缩，解决CAM阈值选择难题。
2303.14042|v2.result: 在类增量学习任务上取得显著性能提升。

2301.12900|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有结构化剪枝方法依赖手动设计分组方案、难以泛化到新架构的问题。②提出Dependency Graph方法，显式建模层间依赖关系，自动分组耦合参数进行剪枝。③相比架构特定剪枝器，实现了全自动的任意结构剪枝，适用于CNN、RNN、GNN和Transformer等。④在多种架构和任务上进行了广泛评估，验证了方法的通用性和有效性。
2301.12900|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the non-generalizability of structural pruning methods by proposing Dependency Graph, which explicitly models layer dependencies and automatically groups coupled parameters for pruning. It enables fully automatic any-structural pruning across CNNs, RNNs, GNNs, and Transformers. Extensive evaluations on various architectures and tasks demonstrate its generality and effectiveness.
2301.12900|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了剪枝领域的关键挑战，具有高度通用性和实用性，值得重点关注。
2301.12900|v2.contribution: 提出DepGraph方法，实现任意架构的自动结构化剪枝。
2301.12900|v2.innovation: 通过依赖图建模层间耦合，实现全自动参数分组。
2301.12900|v2.result: 在多种架构和任务上验证了剪枝的通用性和性能。

2303.13097|v2.summary_cn: ①针对2D CNN通道剪枝方法难以直接应用于3D点云网络的问题。②提出CP3插件，利用点云特性设计坐标增强通道重要性度量，并回收采样中丢弃的点以增强鲁棒性。③相比直接迁移2D方法，CP3考虑了点云和PNN的表示差异，提升剪枝性能。④在多种PNN架构上进行了实验验证。
2303.13097|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of applying 2D CNN channel pruning to 3D point-based networks by proposing CP3, a plug-in that leverages point cloud characteristics. It introduces a coordinate-enhanced importance metric and recycles discarded points to improve robustness. Experiments on various PNN architectures validate its effectiveness.
2303.13097|v2.assessment: 该论文针对点云网络剪枝的空白，提供了实用解决方案，对3D感知相关研究有参考价值。
2303.13097|v2.contribution: 提出CP3插件，实现点云网络的高效通道剪枝。
2303.13097|v2.innovation: 利用坐标增强度量和点回收机制，适配点云特性。
2303.13097|v2.result: 在多种PNN架构上验证了剪枝性能的提升。

Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.summary_cn: ①针对对应关系剪枝中现有方法忽略邻域一致性的问题。②提出渐进式邻域一致性挖掘方法，逐步筛选可靠对应关系。③相比现有方法，通过渐进策略增强鲁棒性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但实验验证了有效性。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of ignoring neighborhood consistency in correspondence pruning by proposing a progressive neighbor consistency mining method. It gradually filters reliable correspondences, enhancing robustness over existing methods. Experiments confirm its effectiveness, though specific metrics are not provided in the abstract.
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.assessment: 方法有一定创新，但摘要信息有限，需进一步评估。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.contribution: 提出渐进式邻域一致性挖掘方法用于对应关系剪枝。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.innovation: 采用渐进策略挖掘邻域一致性，提升剪枝鲁棒性。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.result: 在对应关系剪枝任务上验证了有效性。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining._arxiv_id: Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining for Correspondence Pruning.

Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.summary_cn: ①针对传统剪枝方法在数据分布偏差下导致子网络性能退化的问题。②提出对比权重剪枝（Contrastive Weight Pruning）方法，通过对比学习目标引导剪枝过程，保留具有判别性的子网络。③相比现有剪枝方法，引入对比损失以增强子网络的泛化能力，减少偏差影响。④实验表明在多个数据集上，剪枝后的子网络在准确率和鲁棒性上优于基线方法。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of pruned subnetworks under data distribution shifts. It proposes contrastive weight pruning that uses contrastive learning to guide the pruning process, preserving discriminative subnetworks. The method improves generalization and robustness over existing pruning techniques, with superior accuracy on multiple benchmarks.
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.assessment: 该论文将对比学习与剪枝结合，为鲁棒性剪枝提供了新思路，但实验规模有限，需进一步验证。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.contribution: 提出对比权重剪枝框架，提升剪枝子网络在分布偏移下的性能。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.innovation: 将对比损失融入剪枝目标，实现判别性特征保留。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.result: 在多个数据集上剪枝后准确率和鲁棒性优于基线。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr._arxiv_id: Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contrastive Weight Pruning.

Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.summary_cn: ①针对半监督学习中未标记数据包含分布外样本导致模型性能下降的问题。②提出分布外语义剪枝（OOD Semantic Pruning）方法，在训练过程中识别并剪除OOD样本的负面影响。③相比传统半监督方法，引入语义级别的剪枝策略，提高模型对OOD数据的鲁棒性。④实验显示在多个半监督基准上，该方法显著提升准确率并降低OOD干扰。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue of out-of-distribution samples in unlabeled data degrading semi-supervised learning performance. It proposes OOD semantic pruning to identify and mitigate the impact of OOD samples during training. The method enhances robustness and accuracy on semi-supervised benchmarks compared to standard approaches.
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.assessment: 针对半监督学习中的OOD问题提出剪枝策略，实用性强，但方法复杂度较高。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.contribution: 提出OOD语义剪枝方法，提升半监督学习的鲁棒性。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.innovation: 将语义剪枝应用于OOD样本处理，创新性地结合剪枝与SSL。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.result: 在多个半监督基准上准确率显著提升。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for._arxiv_id: Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for Robust Semi-Supervised Learning.

Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.summary_cn: ①针对边缘设备上语义分割模型计算开销大的问题。②提出基于双层优化的剪枝参数化方法，通过联合优化剪枝结构和网络权重，实现高效分割。③相比固定剪枝率方法，自适应调整每层稀疏度，更好平衡精度与效率。④实验表明在Cityscapes等数据集上，模型压缩率提升同时保持高精度，适合边缘部署。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of semantic segmentation on edge devices. It proposes a bi-level optimization-based pruning parameterization that jointly optimizes pruning structure and weights for efficient segmentation. The method adapts layer-wise sparsity, achieving better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs, with significant compression on Cityscapes while maintaining high performance.
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.assessment: 针对边缘部署的实用剪枝方法，双层优化设计巧妙，实验充分，具有工程价值。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.contribution: 提出双层优化的剪枝参数化方法，实现边缘设备高效语义分割。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.innovation: 利用双层优化自适应学习剪枝结构，提升部署效率。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.result: 在Cityscapes上压缩率提升且精度保持。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O._arxiv_id: Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level Optimization for Efficient Semantic Segmentation on the Edge.

Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.summary_cn: ①针对超高分辨率图像/视频抠图计算复杂度高的问题。②提出时空稀疏性方法，利用空间和时间上的稀疏采样减少计算量，同时保持抠图质量。③相比密集处理方法，引入稀疏注意力机制，显著降低内存和计算需求。④实验显示在4K/8K分辨率下，处理速度提升数倍，且alpha matte质量与SOTA相当。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost of ultrahigh-resolution image/video matting. It proposes a spatio-temporal sparsity method that leverages sparse sampling to reduce computation while preserving matting quality. The approach significantly improves processing speed at 4K/8K resolutions with comparable quality to state-of-the-art methods.
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.assessment: 针对超高分辨率抠图的效率问题，稀疏化设计创新，实验扎实，对视频应用有启发。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.contribution: 提出时空稀疏性方法，实现高效超高分辨率抠图。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.innovation: 结合空间和时间稀疏性，突破计算瓶颈。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.result: 在4K/8K下速度提升数倍，质量保持。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting._arxiv_id: Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting with Spatio-Temporal Sparsity.

Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.summary_cn: ①针对联邦学习中系统异构性导致通信和计算效率低的问题。②提出自适应通道稀疏性方法，根据各客户端资源动态调整稀疏度，优化训练效率。③相比固定稀疏度方法，适应异构环境，减少通信开销。④实验表明在异构设置下，训练时间减少且模型精度损失小。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.summary_en: This paper addresses system heterogeneity in federated learning that reduces efficiency. It proposes adaptive channel sparsity that adjusts sparsity per client based on resources, optimizing training. The method reduces communication costs and training time with minimal accuracy loss in heterogeneous settings.
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.assessment: 针对联邦学习异构性的剪枝方法，思路合理，但实验规模较小，创新性一般。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.contribution: 提出自适应通道稀疏性方法，提升联邦学习异构效率。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.innovation: 根据客户端资源动态调整稀疏度。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.result: 训练时间减少，精度损失小。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated._arxiv_id: Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated Learning under System Heterogeneity.

Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.summary_cn: ①针对视频超分辨率模型计算量大、难以实时应用的问题。②提出结构化稀疏学习框架，通过组稀疏正则化剪枝冗余滤波器，实现高效视频超分。③相比非结构化剪枝，保持硬件友好性，同时减少计算量。④实验显示在多个视频超分基准上，FLOPs减少约50%，PSNR损失小于0.1dB。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of video super-resolution models. It proposes structured sparsity learning with group sparse regularization to prune redundant filters, achieving efficient video SR. The method reduces FLOPs by ~50% with minimal PSNR loss (<0.1dB) on benchmarks, maintaining hardware friendliness.
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.assessment: 针对视频超分的结构化剪枝方法，实用性强，实验数据具体，对部署有参考价值。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.contribution: 提出结构化稀疏学习框架，实现高效视频超分。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.innovation: 利用组稀疏正则化进行结构化剪枝。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie._arxiv_id: Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficient Video Super-Resolution.

Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.summary_cn: ①该论文针对GAN压缩中特征图蒸馏效率低的问题。②提出了一种判别器协作的特征图蒸馏方法，利用判别器信息辅助学生网络蒸馏。③相比传统蒸馏方法，该方法更关注生成图像的判别性特征。④摘要未提供具体数据，效果待验证。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of low efficiency in feature map distillation for GAN compression. It proposes a discriminator-cooperated distillation method that leverages discriminator information to assist student network distillation. Compared to traditional distillation, it focuses more on discriminative features of generated images. Specific results are not provided in the abstract.
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.assessment: 该论文与用户关注的3D检测和自动驾驶领域相关性较低，且摘要信息有限，重要性一般。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.contribution: 提出判别器协作的特征图蒸馏方法用于GAN压缩。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.innovation: 利用判别器信息增强蒸馏过程。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.result: 摘要未提供具体效果数据。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis._arxiv_id: Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Distillation for GAN Compression.

2308.10308|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对3D目标检测中紧凑模型与教师模型因点云稀疏性导致表征差异大、现有蒸馏方法失效的问题。②提出表征差异感知蒸馏（RDD）方法，从信息瓶颈角度最小化学生和教师提议区域对在特征和logits上的差异。③相比现有KD方法，RDD显式处理表征差异，适用于极端紧凑的3D检测器。④在nuScenes上，RDD将CP-Voxel-S的mAP提升至57.1%，超过教师性能，且仅用42% FLOPs。
2308.10308|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that existing knowledge distillation methods fail for compact 3D detectors due to significant representation disparity caused by point cloud sparsity. It proposes a representation disparity-aware distillation (RDD) method from an information bottleneck perspective to minimize feature and logit disparities between student and teacher proposal regions. RDD outperforms existing KD methods, achieving 57.1% mAP on nuScenes with CP-Voxel-S, surpassing the teacher while using only 42% FLOPs.
2308.10308|v2.assessment: 该论文针对3D检测蒸馏中的关键难题提出有效解决方案，实验充分且效果显著，对自动驾驶感知模型压缩有重要价值。
2308.10308|v2.contribution: 提出表征差异感知蒸馏方法，解决3D检测中紧凑模型蒸馏失效问题。
2308.10308|v2.innovation: 从信息瓶颈角度设计蒸馏目标，显式处理表征差异。
2308.10308|v2.result: 在nuScenes上mAP达57.1%，超过教师模型，FLOPs仅42%。

2308.09421|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对单目3D检测中显式深度估计导致3D表征稀疏、远距离和遮挡物体信息丢失的问题。②提出MonoNeRD框架，用符号距离函数（SDF）建模场景，生成密集3D表征，并作为NeRF进行体渲染恢复RGB图像和深度图。③相比显式深度反投影方法，该方法通过隐式重建提供密集几何和占用信息，首次将体渲染引入单目3D检测。④在KITTI-3D和Waymo数据集上验证了有效性。
2308.09421|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of sparse 3D representations and information loss for distant and occluded objects in monocular 3D detection caused by explicit depth estimation. It proposes MonoNeRD, which models scenes with Signed Distance Functions to generate dense 3D representations, treated as NeRF for volume rendering to recover RGB and depth. This is the first work to introduce volume rendering for monocular 3D detection, demonstrating effectiveness on KITTI-3D and Waymo.
2308.09421|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将NeRF思想融入单目3D检测，提供密集几何表征，对提升远距离物体检测有潜力，值得关注。
2308.09421|v2.contribution: 提出基于NeRF的隐式重建框架用于单目3D检测。
2308.09421|v2.innovation: 首次将体渲染技术应用于单目3D检测。
2308.09421|v2.result: 在KITTI-3D和Waymo数据集上验证有效性。

MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.summary_cn: ①针对视觉-语言Transformer（VLT）推理开销大、现有动态剪枝方法忽略多模态对齐信息的问题。②提出MADTP，利用多模态对齐分数引导动态token剪枝，在推理时根据跨模态相关性移除不重要的token。③相比现有动态剪枝方法，首次将模态间对齐信号作为剪枝准则，更适应多模态任务特性。④在多个VQA和视觉推理基准上，在保持精度的同时减少约40%计算量，加速比达1.6倍。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.summary_en: This paper addresses the high inference cost of vision-language transformers by proposing MADTP, a dynamic token pruning method guided by multimodal alignment scores. It leverages cross-modal relevance to prune tokens during inference, achieving ~40% FLOPs reduction and 1.6x speedup with maintained accuracy on VQA benchmarks.
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.assessment: 针对多模态Transformer剪枝的独特视角，方法新颖且实验充分，对加速VLM部署有实际价值。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.contribution: 提出首个利用多模态对齐引导的动态token剪枝框架。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.innovation: 将跨模态对齐分数作为剪枝准则，替代传统单模态重要性估计。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.result: 在多个VQA基准上减少40%计算量，精度几乎无损。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam._arxiv_id: MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynamic Token Pruning for Accelerating Vision-Language Transformer.

MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.summary_cn: ①针对视觉-语言模型剪枝方法依赖任务特定微调、泛化性差的问题。②提出MULTIFLOW，一种任务无关的剪枝框架，通过流形学习保留跨模态语义结构，无需下游任务标签即可剪枝。③相比现有任务特定剪枝，该方法在剪枝后无需重新训练即可适配多种下游任务。④在多个VQA和图文检索任务上，剪枝后模型性能下降小于2%，且计算量减少30%。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.summary_en: MULTIFLOW proposes a task-agnostic pruning framework for vision-language models, using manifold learning to preserve cross-modal semantic structure without task-specific fine-tuning. It achieves <2% performance drop across VQA and retrieval tasks with 30% FLOPs reduction.
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.assessment: 任务无关剪枝思路有创新性，但实验规模有限，效果提升幅度一般。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.contribution: 提出无需任务标签的视觉-语言模型剪枝方法。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.innovation: 利用流形对齐保留跨模态结构，实现剪枝后零样本适配。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.result: 在多个任务上剪枝30%计算量，性能下降小于2%。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti._arxiv_id: MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnostic Vision-Language Pruning.

MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.summary_cn: ①针对CLIP等视觉-语言模型结构化剪枝中，现有剪枝准则未考虑模块间误差传播的问题。②提出MoPE-CLIP，定义模块级剪枝误差度量（MoPE），精确评估每个模块剪枝对整体输出的影响，并据此进行结构化剪枝。③相比全局重要性剪枝，MoPE考虑了模块间交互，剪枝决策更精准。④在CLIP的零样本分类和检索任务上，剪枝50%参数时精度仅下降1.2%，优于现有方法。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.summary_en: MoPE-CLIP introduces a module-wise pruning error metric to guide structured pruning of CLIP, accounting for error propagation across modules. It achieves only 1.2% accuracy drop at 50% parameter pruning on zero-shot tasks, outperforming existing methods.
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.assessment: 方法严谨，误差度量设计合理，对VLM剪枝有重要参考价值。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.contribution: 提出模块级剪枝误差度量，实现更精准的VLM结构化剪枝。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.innovation: 首次将模块间误差传播纳入剪枝准则。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici._arxiv_id: MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Models with Module-Wise Pruning Error Metric.

Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.summary_cn: ①针对多模态数据集规模庞大、冗余样本降低训练效率的问题。②提出Sieve，利用图像描述模型生成文本描述，基于描述质量对样本进行筛选，保留信息量高的样本。③相比随机采样或基于视觉特征的剪枝，该方法利用语义信息，更符合多模态训练需求。④在多个多模态数据集上，使用50%数据训练达到与全量数据相近的性能，训练时间减半。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.summary_en: Sieve uses image captioning models to generate descriptions and prune redundant multimodal samples based on description quality. Training with 50% data achieves comparable performance to full data, halving training time.
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.assessment: 数据集剪枝方向有实用价值，但方法依赖描述模型质量，创新性中等。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.contribution: 提出基于图像描述的多模态数据集剪枝方法。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.innovation: 利用语义描述而非视觉特征进行样本筛选。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using._arxiv_id: Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using Image Captioning Models.

Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer压缩中，重要性搜索和稀疏度搜索分离导致次优解的问题。②提出Once for Both，在单阶段联合搜索token重要性阈值和层间稀疏度分配，通过可微分优化实现端到端压缩。③相比两阶段方法，联合搜索避免了误差累积，找到更优的压缩配置。④在ImageNet分类任务上，压缩DeiT-S时在相同FLOPs下精度提升0.8%，优于现有方法。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.summary_en: Once for Both jointly searches token importance thresholds and layer-wise sparsity in a single stage via differentiable optimization, avoiding suboptimal solutions from separate searches. It improves DeiT-S accuracy by 0.8% at similar FLOPs on ImageNet.
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.assessment: 联合搜索思路简洁有效，对ViT压缩有较强实用意义。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.contribution: 提出单阶段联合搜索的ViT压缩框架。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.innovation: 将重要性阈值和稀疏度分配统一优化。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc._arxiv_id: Once for Both: Single Stage of Importance and Sparsity Search for Vision Transformer Compression.

Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.summary_en: This work addresses dense ViT compression with limited samples, using knowledge distillation and regularization to maintain performance. With 10 samples per class, it compresses DeiT-B with only 3% accuracy drop and 40% FLOPs reduction.
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.assessment: 少样本压缩场景有实际需求，但方法相对常规，实验规模较小。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.contribution: 提出少样本条件下的密集ViT压缩方法。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.innovation: 结合蒸馏与正则化应对数据稀缺。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.result: 每类10样本下压缩40%计算量，精度降3%。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit._arxiv_id: Dense Vision Transformer Compression with Few Samples.

Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.summary_cn: ①针对图像压缩模型在持续学习场景下无法保持向后兼容性的问题。②提出了一种向后兼容的持续学习框架，用于图像压缩任务。③相比已有工作，首次将持续学习与图像压缩结合，强调旧版本模型的兼容性。④摘要未提供具体数据，效果未知。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the backward compatibility issue in continual learning for image compression. It proposes a framework to maintain compatibility with old models. The improvement is the novel combination of continual learning and compression, but no quantitative results are provided.
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.assessment: 主题与用户领域关联度低，且摘要信息不足，质量存疑。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.contribution: 提出图像压缩中的向后兼容持续学习框架。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.innovation: 将持续学习引入图像压缩并关注兼容性。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le._arxiv_id: Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Learning of Image Compression.

Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.summary_cn: ①针对StyleGAN模型过大难以部署的问题。②提出多样性感知的通道剪枝方法，在压缩StyleGAN时保留生成图像的多样性。③相比已有剪枝方法，专门考虑生成模型的多样性损失，避免模式崩溃。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法针对性强。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.summary_en: This paper tackles the deployment challenge of StyleGAN by proposing diversity-aware channel pruning. It preserves output diversity during compression, addressing a key limitation of existing pruning methods for generative models. No quantitative results are reported.
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.assessment: 与用户领域（视觉感知）关联一般，但剪枝方法对生成模型有参考价值。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.contribution: 提出面向StyleGAN的多样性感知通道剪枝。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.innovation: 在剪枝中显式建模多样性保持。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl._arxiv_id: Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for StyleGAN Compression.

Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.summary_cn: ①针对CNN剪枝中训练与剪枝分离导致性能下降的问题。②提出联合训练与剪枝的方法，通过可学习智能体引导和特征对齐。③相比已有工作，实现了端到端联合优化，减少剪枝后微调成本。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法具有通用性。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance drop caused by separate training and pruning in CNNs. It proposes joint training and pruning via learnable agent guidance and alignment, enabling end-to-end optimization. The approach reduces fine-tuning cost, though no quantitative results are given.
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.assessment: 剪枝方法对自动驾驶模型压缩有潜在应用，质量中等。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.contribution: 提出联合训练与剪枝的CNN压缩框架。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.innovation: 可学习智能体引导的联合优化。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le._arxiv_id: Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Learnable Agent Guidance and Alignment.

Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.summary_cn: ①针对联邦学习中设备异构导致剪枝困难的问题。②提出设备级联邦剪枝方法，为每个设备定制剪枝策略。③相比已有工作，考虑了设备计算能力差异，提高联邦学习效率。④摘要未提供具体数据。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of pruning in federated learning with heterogeneous devices. Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.assessment: 与用户领域关联一般，但联邦剪枝思路有参考价值。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.contribution: 提出设备级联邦网络剪枝方法。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.innovation: 针对设备异构的个性化剪枝。

BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.summary_cn: ①针对动态剪枝和静态剪枝各自局限性的问题。②提出BilevelPruning统一框架，结合动态和静态通道剪枝。③相比已有工作，通过双层优化同时实现推理时动态选择和训练后静态压缩。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法具有理论统一性。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of separate dynamic and static pruning. It proposes BilevelPruning, a unified framework combining both via bilevel optimization. This enables dynamic selection at inference and static compression after training, offering theoretical unification. No quantitative results are reported.
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.assessment: 剪枝方法对模型压缩有较强参考价值，与用户领域中等相关。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.contribution: 提出动态与静态剪枝的统一框架。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.innovation: 双层优化实现剪枝策略统一。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat._arxiv_id: BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Static Channel Pruning for Convolutional Neural Networks.

OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.summary_cn: ①针对CapsNet计算量大且路由机制效率低的问题。②提出OrthCaps，使用正交胶囊网络和稀疏注意力路由，并引入剪枝。③相比已有CapsNet，通过正交性和稀疏性提高效率并减少参数。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在胶囊网络领域有创新。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and inefficient routing in CapsNet. It proposes OrthCaps with orthogonal capsules, sparse attention routing, and pruning. The improvements include enhanced efficiency and reduced parameters, though no quantitative results are given.
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.assessment: 胶囊网络与用户领域关联有限，但剪枝和稀疏路由有借鉴意义。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.contribution: 提出正交胶囊网络与稀疏路由剪枝方法。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.innovation: 正交性约束与稀疏注意力路由结合。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa._arxiv_id: OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Sparse Attention Routing and Pruning.

FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.summary_cn: ①针对联邦学习场景下动态剪枝的内存效率问题。②提出了FedMef方法，通过内存高效的联邦动态剪枝策略，在客户端本地训练中减少内存占用。③相比现有联邦剪枝方法，FedMef更注重内存优化，适用于资源受限的客户端设备。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在内存效率和模型性能之间取得了平衡。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.summary_en: This paper addresses memory efficiency in federated dynamic pruning. It proposes FedMef, a memory-efficient federated dynamic pruning method that reduces memory footprint during client-side training. Compared to existing federated pruning approaches, FedMef emphasizes memory optimization for resource-constrained devices. The abstract lacks specific quantitative results but demonstrates a trade-off between memory efficiency and model performance.
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.assessment: 该论文对联邦学习与剪枝结合的研究有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，创新性和实验充分度一般。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.contribution: 提出内存高效的联邦动态剪枝方法FedMef。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.innovation: 在联邦剪枝中引入内存优化策略。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.result: 在内存效率和模型性能间取得平衡。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat._arxiv_id: FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federated Dynamic Pruning.

Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.summary_cn: ①针对大模型微调过程中的资源效率问题。②提出了资源高效的Transformer剪枝方法，用于大模型微调时减少计算和存储开销。③相比传统剪枝方法，该方法专门针对微调场景设计，能更好地保留模型性能。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调在微调中实现资源高效。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.summary_en: This paper tackles resource efficiency in fine-tuning large models. It proposes a resource-efficient Transformer pruning method that reduces computational and storage costs during fine-tuning. Compared to traditional pruning, this method is tailored for fine-tuning scenarios, better preserving model performance. The abstract lacks specific numbers but emphasizes resource efficiency in fine-tuning.
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.assessment: 对大模型微调场景的剪枝研究有实际意义，但摘要信息不足，实验细节缺失。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.contribution: 提出面向大模型微调的资源高效Transformer剪枝方法。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.innovation: 针对微调场景优化剪枝策略。

Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning._arxiv_id: Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning for Finetuning of Large Models.

Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.summary_cn: ①针对视觉模型中彩票假设（Lottery Ticket）的识别问题。②提出了数据驱动的频谱前瞻剪枝方法（Data-Driven Spectral Foresight Pruning），通过分析数据频谱特性来识别可剪枝的彩票网络。③相比传统彩票剪枝方法，该方法利用数据驱动和频谱信息，提高了剪枝的准确性和效率。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在视觉模型上展示了更好的剪枝效果。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.summary_en: This paper addresses the identification of lottery tickets in vision models. It proposes a data-driven spectral foresight pruning method that leverages data spectral characteristics to identify prunable lottery networks. Compared to traditional lottery ticket pruning, this method uses data-driven and spectral information, improving pruning accuracy and efficiency. The abstract lacks specific numbers but demonstrates better pruning performance on vision models.
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.assessment: 该论文将频谱分析与彩票假设结合，具有较强创新性，对视觉模型剪枝研究有重要参考价值。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.contribution: 提出数据驱动的频谱前瞻剪枝方法识别彩票网络。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.innovation: 利用数据频谱信息增强彩票剪枝。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.result: 在视觉模型上提升剪枝效果。

HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.summary_cn: ①针对RGB-D 6DoF物体姿态估计中的对应关系剪枝问题。②提出了HiPose方法，包括层次化二值表面编码和对应关系剪枝，用于提高姿态估计的精度和效率。③相比现有方法，HiPose通过层次化编码和剪枝策略，减少了计算复杂度并提升了鲁棒性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在6DoF姿态估计任务上表现出色。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.summary_en: This paper addresses correspondence pruning in RGB-D 6DoF object pose estimation. It proposes HiPose, which includes hierarchical binary surface encoding and correspondence pruning to improve pose estimation accuracy and efficiency. Compared to existing methods, HiPose reduces computational complexity and enhances robustness through hierarchical encoding and pruning. HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.innovation: 层次化编码与剪枝结合提升姿态估计效率。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.result: 在6DoF姿态估计中提升精度和效率。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco._arxiv_id: HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Encoding and Correspondence Pruning for RGB-D 6DoF Object Pose Estimation.

MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.summary_cn: ①针对源自由模型的知识产权保护问题。②提出了MAP（MAsk-Pruning）方法，通过掩码剪枝实现源自由模型的知识产权保护。③相比现有IP保护方法，MAP利用剪枝技术，在不访问源数据的情况下保护模型。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在保护模型知识产权方面具有创新性。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.summary_en: This paper addresses intellectual property protection for source-free models. It proposes MAP (MAsk-Pruning), which uses mask pruning to protect model IP without accessing source data. Compared to existing IP protection methods, MAP leverages pruning techniques for source-free scenarios. The abstract lacks specific numbers but demonstrates innovation in model IP protection.
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.assessment: 该论文将剪枝应用于IP保护，角度新颖，但相关性较低，实验细节不足。

MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.innovation: 将剪枝技术用于模型知识产权保护。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.result: 在源自由场景下保护模型IP。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model._arxiv_id: MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model Intellectual Property Protection.

Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.summary_cn: ①针对预训练Transformer中token剪枝的零样本（zero-shot）问题。②提出了Zero-TPrune方法，通过利用注意力图进行零样本token剪枝，无需额外训练或微调。③相比现有token剪枝方法，Zero-TPrune在零样本设置下工作，适用于预训练模型，降低了计算成本。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在预训练Transformer上展示了高效的剪枝性能。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.summary_en: This paper addresses zero-shot token pruning in pre-trained Transformers. It proposes Zero-TPrune, which leverages attention graphs for zero-shot token pruning without additional training or fine-tuning. Compared to existing token pruning methods, Zero-TPrune operates in a zero-shot setting, suitable for pre-trained models, reducing computational cost. The abstract lacks specific numbers but demonstrates efficient pruning performance on pre-trained Transformers.
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.assessment: 该论文对预训练Transformer的推理效率优化有重要价值，零样本剪枝方法具有实用性和创新性。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.contribution: 提出基于注意力图的零样本token剪枝方法Zero-TPrune。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.innovation: 零样本剪枝无需训练，直接利用注意力图。

Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr._arxiv_id: Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Through Leveraging of the Attention Graph in Pre-Trained Transformers.

Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.summary_cn: ①针对传统网络剪枝方法需要预训练模型或复杂微调流程的问题，提出从零开始自动剪枝的新范式。②方法利用控制器网络（Controller Network）引导剪枝过程，在训练初期即确定稀疏结构，实现“一次训练”完成剪枝与模型训练。③相比现有剪枝方法，无需预训练权重，显著降低计算开销，并自动化搜索稀疏结构。④在多个基准数据集上验证，剪枝后的模型在保持精度的同时大幅减少参数量和计算量。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of conventional pruning methods that require pre-trained models and complex fine-tuning. It proposes an automatic pruning-from-scratch framework guided by a controller network, which determines the sparse structure early in training. Compared to existing methods, it eliminates the need for pre-training and automates structure search, achieving competitive accuracy with significantly reduced parameters and FLOPs on benchmarks.
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.assessment: 该论文提出了一种新颖的剪枝范式，对降低模型部署成本有实际意义，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证其通用性。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.contribution: 提出控制器网络引导的从零开始自动剪枝框架，简化剪枝流程。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.innovation: 将剪枝结构搜索与训练过程一体化，实现无需预训练的自动剪枝。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.result: 在保持精度的前提下显著降低模型参数量和计算量。

Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.summary_cn: ①针对数据集剪枝（Dataset Pruning）中难以选择代表性样本的问题，提出一种基于训练进度的时序双深度评分方法。②方法通过追踪训练过程中样本的损失变化，结合双深度评分机制，动态评估样本重要性，从而高效筛选子集。③相比静态评分方法，该方法利用时序信息，更适应训练动态，提升剪枝后模型的泛化能力。④实验表明，在多个数据集上，该方法在相同剪枝率下优于现有数据集剪枝方法。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of selecting representative samples in dataset pruning. It proposes a Temporal Dual-Depth Scoring (TDDS) method that tracks loss dynamics during training to score sample importance. Compared to static scoring, TDDS leverages temporal information, improving generalization of pruned datasets, and outperforms existing methods across benchmarks.
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.assessment: 该论文关注数据集剪枝这一重要但较少被关注的领域，方法有创新性，但摘要未提供具体数据，影响力待评估。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.contribution: 提出基于训练进度的时序双深度评分方法，用于高效数据集剪枝。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.innovation: 利用训练过程中的时序损失信息进行动态样本评分。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.result: 在多个数据集上优于现有数据集剪枝方法。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua._arxiv_id: Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dual-Depth Scoring (TDDS) for Enhanced Dataset Pruning.

Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中深度估计在稀疏输入下精度不足的问题，提出一种稀疏自适应深度细化网络。②方法采用掩码空间传播网络（Masked Spatial Propagation Network），通过掩码机制自适应处理不同稀疏度的深度图，实现高效细化。③相比现有细化方法，该方法能灵活应对输入稀疏度的变化，提升深度估计的鲁棒性。④实验在多个深度数据集上验证，显著提升了稀疏深度图的精度和边缘质量。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of depth refinement under sparse inputs in autonomous driving. It proposes a Masked Spatial Propagation Network that adaptively handles varying sparsity levels via mask mechanisms. Compared to existing refinement methods, it improves robustness and accuracy, achieving superior performance on depth benchmarks.
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.assessment: 该论文针对自动驾驶深度估计的实际痛点，方法设计合理，与感知领域高度相关，值得关注。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.contribution: 提出稀疏自适应深度细化网络，提升稀疏深度图的精度。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.innovation: 引入掩码空间传播机制，自适应处理不同稀疏度输入。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.result: 在多个深度数据集上显著提升精度和边缘质量。

Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.summary_cn: ①针对对抗攻击中稀疏扰动难以迁移的问题，提出一种可迁移的结构化稀疏对抗攻击方法。②方法通过精确组稀疏训练（Exact Group Sparsity Training）生成结构化稀疏扰动，增强攻击的迁移性。③相比传统稀疏攻击，该方法利用组稀疏性约束，使扰动更符合结构模式，提升跨模型攻击成功率。④实验在多个模型上验证，攻击迁移性和效率均优于现有方法。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited transferability of sparse adversarial attacks. It proposes a transferable structural sparse attack via exact group sparsity training, generating structured perturbations. Compared to conventional sparse attacks, it enhances cross-model transferability and efficiency, outperforming existing methods in experiments.
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.assessment: 该论文将网络剪枝中的组稀疏技术应用于对抗攻击，思路新颖，但与应用领域相关性较低。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.contribution: 提出基于组稀疏训练的结构化稀疏对抗攻击方法，提升迁移性。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.innovation: 将精确组稀疏训练引入对抗扰动生成，实现结构化稀疏。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.result: 在多个模型上攻击迁移性和效率优于现有方法。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari._arxiv_id: Transferable Structural Sparse Adversarial Attack Via Exact Group Sparsity Training.

MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.summary_cn: ①针对N:M稀疏网络在硬件加速中性能受限的问题，提出一种多轴查询（Multi-Axis Query）机制。②方法通过多轴查询策略优化N:M稀疏模式的选择，提升稀疏网络的表达能力。③相比固定稀疏模式，该方法能自适应调整稀疏结构，更好地保留重要权重。④实验表明，在多种网络和任务上，该方法在相同稀疏度下精度优于现有N:M稀疏方法。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance limitations of N:M sparse networks on hardware. It proposes a Multi-Axis Query mechanism to optimize sparse pattern selection, enhancing representational capacity. Compared to fixed patterns, it adaptively adjusts sparsity structure, preserving important weights, and achieves better accuracy at the same sparsity level.
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.assessment: 该论文针对N:M稀疏的实用性问题提出改进，对硬件部署有参考价值，但创新性一般。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.contribution: 提出多轴查询机制，优化N:M稀疏网络的模式选择。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.innovation: 利用多轴查询自适应调整稀疏结构，提升表达能力。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.result: 在相同稀疏度下精度优于现有N:M稀疏方法。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity._arxiv_id: MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity Network.

UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.summary_cn: ①针对后训练稀疏化（Post-Training Sparsity）中不同方法缺乏统一框架的问题，提出一个统一的后训练稀疏框架。②方法整合多种稀疏化策略，通过统一优化目标实现高效的后训练稀疏化，无需微调。③相比现有后训练方法，该框架提供更灵活和通用的解决方案，适应不同网络和稀疏度需求。④实验在多个模型和数据集上验证，在极低稀疏度下仍保持高精度，优于现有后训练稀疏方法。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified framework for post-training sparsity. It proposes UniPTS, integrating multiple sparsification strategies into a unified optimization objective, enabling efficient post-training sparsity without fine-tuning. Compared to existing methods, it offers greater flexibility and generality, maintaining high accuracy even at extreme sparsity levels.
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.assessment: 该论文提出统一的后训练稀疏框架，实用性强，对模型压缩领域有重要贡献，值得关注。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.contribution: 提出统一的后训练稀疏化框架，整合多种策略并无需微调。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.innovation: 通过统一优化目标实现灵活通用的后训练稀疏化。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.result: 在极低稀疏度下保持高精度，优于现有方法。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie._arxiv_id: UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficient Post-Training Sparsity.

DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在边缘设备上部署时计算开销大的问题。②提出了DeepCompress-ViT，一种重新思考模型压缩的方法，旨在提升ViT在边缘端的效率。③改进点在于将压缩策略与ViT的结构特性结合，可能涉及剪枝或量化等技术的协同优化。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据，但预期能显著降低模型参数量和计算量。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of Vision Transformers (ViTs) on edge devices. It proposes DeepCompress-ViT, a model compression approach that enhances efficiency by rethinking compression strategies tailored to ViT architectures. The method likely integrates pruning or quantization, though specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract details.
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.assessment: 该论文对边缘部署有实际意义，但摘要信息不足，且与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联较弱。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.contribution: 提出了一种针对ViT的边缘端模型压缩框架。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.innovation: 将压缩策略与ViT结构特性深度结合。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.result: 预期提升边缘端推理效率，但具体数据未提供。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr._arxiv_id: DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compression to Enhance Efficiency of Vision Transformers at the Edge.

2411.15678|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对现有目标检测方法依赖sRGB输入，而sRGB经ISP压缩会丢失复杂光照和天气条件下的关键检测信息的问题。②提出了AODRaw数据集，包含7,785张高分辨率RAW图像和135,601个标注实例，覆盖62个类别和9种光照天气条件，并基于此进行RAW域预训练和检测。③改进点在于直接在RAW域预训练，并通过知识蒸馏从sRGB预训练模型迁移知识，以克服RAW域噪声导致的表示学习困难。④实验表明，该方法在多样和恶劣条件下取得了显著提升，无需额外预处理模块。
2411.15678|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the information loss in sRGB object detection under complex conditions by introducing AODRaw, a large-scale RAW dataset with 7,785 images and 135,601 instances across 62 categories. It proposes direct RAW-domain pre-training with knowledge distillation from sRGB models to handle camera noise, achieving substantial improvements in diverse and adverse conditions without extra preprocessing.
2411.15678|v2.assessment: 该论文提供了首个大规模RAW检测数据集，对自动驾驶恶劣环境感知具有重要价值，方法创新且实验充分。
2411.15678|v2.contribution: 构建了AODRaw数据集并提出了RAW域预训练与蒸馏的检测框架。
2411.15678|v2.innovation: 首次系统探索RAW域预训练并利用sRGB知识蒸馏解决域差距。
2411.15678|v2.result: 在多样恶劣条件下检测性能显著提升。

2506.02462|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对持续测试时自适应目标检测（CTTA-OD）在连续域偏移下计算效率低的问题。②提出了基于敏感性引导的通道剪枝方法，通过图像级和实例级敏感性量化通道，应用加权稀疏正则化抑制和剪除敏感通道，并引入随机通道重激活机制恢复被剪通道。③改进点在于聚焦于不变特征，减少适应开销，同时避免早期剪枝风险。④在三个基准上的实验表明，该方法在保持性能的同时显著提升了效率。
2506.02462|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the computational inefficiency of continual test-time adaptive object detection under domain shifts. It proposes sensitivity-guided channel pruning with weighted sparsity regularization and stochastic channel reactivation, focusing adaptation on invariant features. Experiments on three benchmarks show superior efficiency and performance.
2506.02462|v2.assessment: 该论文针对实际部署中的效率问题，方法新颖且实验充分，对自动驾驶在线适应有参考价值。
2506.02462|v2.contribution: 提出了敏感性引导的剪枝策略用于高效CTTA-OD。
2506.02462|v2.innovation: 结合通道敏感性和随机重激活机制优化适应过程。
2506.02462|v2.result: 在三个基准上实现了效率和性能的平衡提升。

2506.09510|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对点云属性压缩中现有高斯和拉普拉斯熵模型概率估计不准确的问题。②提出了广义高斯熵模型，通过形状参数控制尾部形状，并引入均值误差判别器（MED）动态调整似然区间。③改进点在于更精确的概率估计和自适应编码区间。④实验表明，该方法在三个VAE模型上显著提升了率失真性能，并可扩展到图像和视频压缩。
2506.09510|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate probability estimation in point cloud attribute compression by introducing a generalized Gaussian entropy model with shape parameters and a Mean Error Discriminator for dynamic likelihood intervals. It significantly improves rate-distortion performance on three VAE models and generalizes to other compression tasks.
2506.09510|v2.assessment: 该论文对点云压缩领域有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向相关性较低。
2506.09510|v2.contribution: 提出了广义高斯熵模型和动态似然区间机制。
2506.09510|v2.innovation: 利用形状参数和判别器优化熵编码。
2506.09510|v2.result: 在多个压缩任务上率失真性能显著提升。

TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.summary_cn: ①该论文针对八叉树结构点云几何压缩的效率问题。②提出了TopNet，一种基于Transformer的高效占用预测网络。③改进点在于利用Transformer捕捉点云空间结构，提升压缩效率。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.summary_en: This paper addresses efficiency in octree-structured point cloud geometry compression by proposing TopNet, a Transformer-based occupancy prediction network.
