2404.12386|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界实体分割依赖昂贵人工标注的问题，提出了自监督开放世界层次实体分割（SOHES）方法。该方法通过自探索、自指导和自纠正三个阶段，利用预训练自监督表示生成伪标签并训练分割模型，同时通过师生互学习纠正噪声。仅使用原始图像训练，实现了前所未有的自监督开放世界分割性能。
2404.12386|v2.summary_en: This paper presents SOHES, a self-supervised approach for open-world hierarchical entity segmentation that eliminates human annotations. It uses self-exploration, self-instruction, and self-correction phases with pseudo-labels and teacher-student mutual learning, achieving unprecedented performance with raw images only.
2404.12386|v2.assessment: 该工作推动了自监督分割的发展，对自动驾驶中的通用场景理解有潜在应用。
2404.12386|v2.contribution: 提出SOHES，实现无需标注的开放世界层次实体分割。
2404.12386|v2.innovation: 三阶段自监督流程结合师生互学习，处理伪标签噪声。
2404.12386|v2.result: 在自监督开放世界分割上达到最优性能。

A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher.summary_cn: 针对知识蒸馏中教师模型质量对蒸馏效果影响的问题，提出了师生协作知识蒸馏框架，强调优秀学习者能更好地教导。该方法通过协作机制提升学生模型的学习能力，并反向优化教师模型，实现更有效的知识迁移。在多个基准上验证了方法的有效性。
A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher.summary_en: This paper proposes a teacher-student collaborative knowledge distillation framework, emphasizing that a good learner can teach better. It enhances student learning and optimizes the teacher model through collaboration, demonstrating effectiveness on multiple benchmarks.
A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher.assessment: 该研究对知识蒸馏理论有贡献，但相关性一般，适用于通用模型压缩。
A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher.contribution: 提出师生协作蒸馏框架，提升知识迁移效率。
A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher.innovation: 双向优化师生模型，突破传统单向蒸馏。
A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher.result: 在多个基准上优于传统蒸馏方法。
A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher._arxiv_id: A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher-Student Collaborative Knowledge Distillation.

2306.15876|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自监督表示学习中对比学习（CL）和掩码图像建模（MIM）各自优缺点难以兼得的问题，即CL擅长捕获全局模式并提升特征判别性，而MIM能引入更多局部和多样化的注意力。②提出了混合蒸馏（Hybrid Distillation）策略，利用监督/对比学习教师和MIM教师共同指导学生模型，通过模仿MIM教师的token关系来缓解注意力坍塌，并蒸馏监督/CL教师的特征图以增强判别能力。③相比先前特征蒸馏和掩码特征重建方法，该策略避免了非对称设计带来的判别性损失，同时有效结合了两种范式的优势。④实验表明该方法在多个下游任务上取得了优于单一范式或简单组合的性能提升，具体数据未在摘要中给出，但验证了方法的有效性。
2306.15876|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of combining the strengths of contrastive learning (CL) and masked image modeling (MIM) in self-supervised representation learning. It proposes a Hybrid Distillation strategy that uses both a supervised/CL teacher and a MIM teacher to jointly guide a student model, imitating token relations from the MIM teacher to prevent attention collapse and distilling feature maps from the supervised/CL teacher for better discrimination. The method outperforms prior feature distillation and mask reconstruction approaches by avoiding the discrimination loss caused by asymmetric designs, achieving improved performance across downstream tasks.
2306.15876|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种简洁有效的混合蒸馏框架，为自监督学习中的范式融合提供了新思路，对视觉表示学习领域具有重要参考价值。
2306.15876|v2.contribution: 提出混合蒸馏策略，通过联合监督/对比教师和MIM教师指导学生学习，同时提升特征判别性和多样性。
2306.15876|v2.innovation: 创新性地结合token关系模仿和特征图蒸馏，避免了非对称设计带来的判别性损失。
2306.15876|v2.result: 在多个下游任务上验证了方法优于单一范式或简单组合，提升了表示学习性能。

2011.11858|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有MOT方法依赖目标先验知识、难以泛化到未见类别的问题，该论文构建了首个通用多目标跟踪（GMOT）基准数据集GMOT-40，包含40个精心标注的序列，均匀分布在10个目标类别中，并采用两种跟踪协议评估算法特性。由于缺乏专用算法，作者设计了一系列基线GMOT算法，并对流行的MOT算法（经必要修改）和基线进行了全面评估。该工作填补了GMOT领域数据集的空白，为后续研究提供了标准化评测平台。
2011.11858|v2.summary_en: Addressing the limitation of existing MOT methods that rely on prior knowledge of targets and fail to generalize to unseen categories, this paper constructs the first public Generic Multiple Object Tracking (GMOT) benchmark, GMOT-40, with 40 carefully annotated sequences across 10 categories and two tracking protocols. It also designs baseline GMOT algorithms and conducts thorough evaluations of adapted MOT methods and baselines, filling the dataset gap and providing a standardized evaluation platform.
2011.11858|v2.assessment: 该论文为GMOT这一被忽视但重要的研究方向提供了首个基准数据集和基线，对推动通用跟踪研究具有重要价值。
2011.11858|v2.contribution: 构建了首个通用多目标跟踪基准数据集GMOT-40并设计了基线算法。
2011.11858|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地定义和评估GMOT问题，并引入双协议评测机制。
2011.11858|v2.result: 提供了全面的评估结果和公开数据集，促进GMOT领域发展。

Improving Multiple Object Tracking With.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪中数据关联的挑战，提出利用单目标跟踪（SOT）技术来改进MOT性能。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节不明，但核心思想可能是通过SOT的鲁棒性来增强目标轨迹的连续性，减少ID切换。该工作探索了SOT与MOT的结合，可能为跟踪算法提供新的改进方向。
Improving Multiple Object Tracking With.summary_en: This paper addresses challenges in multi-object tracking data association by leveraging single object tracking techniques to improve MOT performance. Due to missing abstract, specific method details are unclear, but the core idea likely involves using SOT robustness to enhance trajectory continuity and reduce ID switches, exploring a novel combination of SOT and MOT.
Improving Multiple Object Tracking With.assessment: 尽管摘要缺失，但该方向具有潜在价值，可能为MOT提供新的改进思路。
Improving Multiple Object Tracking With.contribution: 探索了单目标跟踪与多目标跟踪的融合方法。
Improving Multiple Object Tracking With.innovation: 利用SOT的鲁棒性增强MOT的关联稳定性。
Improving Multiple Object Tracking With.result: 效果未知，但可能提升跟踪精度和减少ID切换。
Improving Multiple Object Tracking With._arxiv_id: Improving Multiple Object Tracking With Single Object Tracking.

2101.12159|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中每个目标独立建模、缺乏场景内所有目标联合更新记忆的问题，该论文提出了一种新颖的多轨迹池化模块，在极小空间开销下同时考虑所有轨迹进行记忆更新。此外，设计了适应多轨迹池化的训练策略，在线生成困难跟踪样本。这些创新使得判别性外观模型显著增强，从而支持贪心数据关联实现实时在线跟踪，在公共MOT数据集上达到了实时且最先进的性能。
2101.12159|v2.summary_en: Addressing the issue of isolated target modeling in MOT that lacks joint memory updates across all targets, this paper proposes a novel multi-track pooling module to simultaneously consider all tracks during memory updating with minimal spatial overhead. A training strategy adapted to multi-track pooling generates hard tracking episodes online, resulting in a strong discriminative appearance model that enables greedy data association for real-time online tracking, achieving state-of-the-art performance on public MOT datasets.
2101.12159|v2.assessment: 该论文通过联合建模所有轨迹，显著提升了外观判别力，在实时性和精度上均表现优异，值得关注。
2101.12159|v2.contribution: 提出多轨迹池化模块和配套训练策略，实现实时高精度MOT。
2101.12159|v2.innovation: 首次在记忆更新中联合考虑所有轨迹，并设计在线困难样本生成。
2101.12159|v2.result: 在公共MOT数据集上达到实时最先进性能。

2012.08197|v2.summary_cn: 针对RGB-D序列中多目标跟踪因视角变化、运动和遮挡而困难的问题，该论文提出联合推断物体完整几何形状并进行跟踪的方法。核心洞察是完整几何有助于跟踪，通过预测物体未见区域，获得同一实例间的额外对应关系，从而在强外观变化下实现鲁棒跟踪。从RGB-D帧中检测物体并预测完整几何和到规范空间的稠密对应映射，进而推导6DoF姿态和帧间对应，在合成和真实数据上达到最先进性能。
2012.08197|v2.summary_en: Addressing challenges in RGB-D multi-object tracking from changing viewpoints, motion, and occlusions, this paper proposes jointly inferring complete object geometry and tracking rigidly moving objects. The key insight is that complete geometry aids tracking by hallucinating unseen regions to obtain additional correspondences, enabling robust tracking under strong appearance changes. Detecting objects and predicting complete geometry and dense correspondence to canonical space allows deriving 6DoF poses and inter-frame correspondences, achieving state-of-the-art performance on synthetic and real data.
2012.08197|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将物体补全与跟踪结合，显著提升遮挡下的鲁棒性，对3D跟踪领域有重要贡献。
2012.08197|v2.contribution: 提出联合物体几何补全与跟踪的框架，提升RGB-D序列跟踪性能。
2012.08197|v2.innovation: 利用完整几何预测增强对应关系，解决遮挡和外观变化问题。
2012.08197|v2.result: 在合成和真实RGB-D数据上达到最先进性能。

2103.07889|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中数据关联难以端到端学习的问题，该论文提出了一种基于提议的可学习框架，将MOT建模为在亲和图上的提议生成、提议评分和轨迹推断范式，类似于Faster RCNN的两阶段检测器。提议生成采用迭代图聚类降低计算成本，提议评分使用可训练图卷积网络学习结构模式并排序，轨迹推断采用去重叠策略满足约束。实验表明该方法在MOTA和IDF1上均有明显性能提升。
2103.07889|v2.summary_en: Addressing the difficulty of end-to-end learning for data association in MOT, this paper proposes a novel proposal-based learnable framework that models MOT as proposal generation, scoring, and trajectory inference on an affinity graph, akin to Faster RCNN. Iterative graph clustering reduces computational cost for proposal generation, a trainable GCN scores proposals by learning structural patterns, and a de-overlapping strategy ensures constraints, achieving clear improvements in MOTA and IDF1.
2103.07889|v2.assessment: 该论文将MOT问题转化为可学习的提议框架，利用GCN学习结构模式，方法新颖且效果显著。
2103.07889|v2.contribution: 提出基于提议和图卷积的MOT框架，实现端到端数据关联学习。
2103.07889|v2.innovation: 将两阶段检测思想引入MOT，并用GCN进行提议评分。
2103.07889|v2.result: 在MOTA和IDF1上均获得明显性能提升。

2104.00380|v2.summary_cn: 针对在线多目标跟踪中位置预测和嵌入关联作为独立任务、缺乏协同的问题，该论文提出一种统一模型，通过时间感知的目标注意力和干扰物注意力，以及身份感知的记忆聚合模型，实现两个任务的协同。注意力模块使预测更聚焦目标、减少干扰，从而提取更可靠的嵌入用于关联；可靠嵌入又通过记忆聚合增强身份感知，强化注意力并抑制漂移。这种协同增强了对遮挡的鲁棒性，实验验证了其有效性。
2104.00380|v2.summary_en: Addressing the lack of synergy between position prediction and embedding association in online MOT, this paper proposes a unified model with temporal-aware target and distractor attention, plus identity-aware memory aggregation. Attention modules focus prediction on targets and reduce distractors, yielding reliable embeddings for association, which in turn enhance identity-awareness and suppress drifts, achieving robust synergy and strong occlusion robustness, as validated by experiments.
2104.00380|v2.assessment: 该论文通过任务协同设计，显著提升遮挡下的跟踪鲁棒性，方法具有创新性和实用性。
2104.00380|v2.contribution: 提出位置预测与嵌入关联协同的统一MOT模型。
2104.00380|v2.innovation: 利用双向注意力机制和记忆聚合实现任务间互惠增强。
2104.00380|v2.result: 实验证明在遮挡场景下跟踪鲁棒性显著提升。

2103.16178|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中数据关联忽略轨迹间和帧内检测的上下文信息、端到端方法缺乏优化分配优势、图优化方法特征提取与推理不一致的问题，提出了一种可学习的图匹配方法。该方法将轨迹与检测的关系建模为无向图，将关联问题转化为图匹配问题，并实现端到端优化。相比已有工作，它结合了深度特征学习与图划分优化，缓解了训练与推理的不一致性。实验表明该方法在MOT基准上具有竞争力。
2103.16178|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses data association in multi-object tracking by proposing a learnable graph matching method that models tracklet-detection relationships as an undirected graph and solves association via graph matching. It integrates deep feature learning with graph partitioning to handle context information and reduce train-inference inconsistency, achieving competitive results on MOT benchmarks.
2103.16178|v2.assessment: 该论文将图匹配与深度特征学习结合，为MOT数据关联提供了新视角，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证其实际效果。
2103.16178|v2.contribution: 提出了一种可学习的图匹配框架，用于多目标跟踪中的数据关联。
2103.16178|v2.innovation: 将轨迹与检测的关联问题转化为图匹配问题，并实现端到端优化。
2103.16178|v2.result: 在MOT基准上取得了有竞争力的跟踪性能。

Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中相似度学习效率低的问题，提出了准密集相似度学习方法。该方法通过密集采样和对比学习，在检测区域上学习实例级特征表示，实现高效的数据关联。相比稀疏方法，它利用了更多正负样本对，提升了特征判别力。在MOT16、MOT17等基准上取得了领先性能，并支持实时推理。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.summary_en: This paper introduces quasi-dense similarity learning for multi-object tracking, which densely samples and learns instance-level features via contrastive learning for efficient association. It outperforms sparse methods by leveraging more positive-negative pairs, achieving state-of-the-art results on MOT benchmarks with real-time inference.
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.assessment: 该方法在相似度学习上具有创新性，实验充分，对MOT领域有重要参考价值。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.contribution: 提出了准密集相似度学习框架，提升了多目标跟踪的关联精度。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.innovation: 利用密集对比学习增强特征判别力，替代传统稀疏采样。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.result: 在多个MOT数据集上达到领先性能，并保持实时速度。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult._arxiv_id: Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Multiple Object Tracking.

2012.02337|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中长时遮挡导致轨迹中断的问题，提出了概率自回归运动模型来评分轨迹提议。该方法通过学习自然轨迹的分布，不仅用于分配新检测，还能通过采样修复丢失的轨迹段。相比现有方法，它显式建模长期运动信息，提升了遮挡场景下的鲁棒性。在MOT16、MOT17和MOT20上超越了多数现有方法。
2012.02337|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles long-term occlusion in MOT by introducing a probabilistic autoregressive motion model that scores tracklet proposals via likelihood estimation. It learns natural tracklet distributions to assign detections and inpaint lost segments, outperforming state-of-the-art on MOT16, MOT17, and MOT20.
2012.02337|v2.assessment: 该论文针对遮挡问题提出了新颖的概率建模方法，实验验证充分，对实际应用有较强价值。
2012.02337|v2.contribution: 提出概率轨迹评分与修复机制，增强多目标跟踪在遮挡下的稳定性。
2012.02337|v2.innovation: 利用自回归模型学习轨迹分布，实现轨迹的生成式修复。
2012.02337|v2.result: 在多个MOT基准上取得最优或接近最优的性能。

2105.11595|v2.summary_cn: 针对在线多目标跟踪中运动建模不足的问题，提出了基于区域的Siamese网络SiamMOT。该网络包含运动模型，估计实例帧间移动以进行关联，并探索了隐式和显式两种运动建模变体。相比现有方法，它显著提升了跟踪性能，在MOT17、TAO-person等数据集上超越最先进方法。SiamMOT运行高效，在720P视频上达到17 FPS。
2105.11595|v2.summary_en: This paper presents SiamMOT, a region-based Siamese network for online MOT with an explicit motion model for instance association. It explores implicit and explicit motion variants, substantially outperforming state-of-the-art on MOT17, TAO-person, and Caltech datasets, while running at 17 FPS on 720P videos.
2105.11595|v2.assessment: 该论文方法简洁高效，实验全面，对在线MOT系统设计有重要指导意义。
2105.11595|v2.contribution: 提出了SiamMOT框架，将运动建模集成到Siamese跟踪器中。
2105.11595|v2.innovation: 显式运动模型与区域Siamese网络结合，提升关联精度。
2105.11595|v2.result: 在多个数据集上超越现有方法，并保持实时性能。

2103.11681|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频跟踪中时间上下文利用不足的问题，提出了基于Transformer的跟踪框架，将编码器和解码器分离为并行分支。编码器通过注意力增强目标模板，解码器传播历史跟踪线索到当前帧，以提升搜索过程。相比传统Siamese方法，它有效利用帧间信息，在多个基准上刷新了最先进记录。
2103.11681|v2.summary_en: This paper exploits temporal context in visual tracking via a transformer architecture with parallel encoder-decoder branches. The encoder reinforces target templates, while the decoder propagates tracking cues, enabling a simple Siamese tracker to outperform top methods and set new records on benchmarks.
2103.11681|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地应用Transformer于跟踪，方法设计巧妙，实验效果显著。
2103.11681|v2.contribution: 提出了Transformer辅助的跟踪框架，有效利用时间上下文。
2103.11681|v2.innovation: 分离编码器与解码器，分别处理模板增强和线索传播。
2103.11681|v2.result: 在多个跟踪基准上达到最先进性能。

2104.00324|v2.summary_cn: 针对Siamese跟踪器固定模板难以适应目标外观变化的问题，提出了基于时空记忆网络的模板无关跟踪框架STMTrack。该方法利用记忆网络存储历史目标信息，引导跟踪器关注当前帧的显著区域，并通过像素级相似度计算生成更精确的边界框。相比模板更新方法，它无需复杂优化，实现实时跟踪。在多个大规模基准上取得了优异性能。
2104.00324|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes STMTrack, a template-free tracker using space-time memory networks to store historical target information and guide attention. It computes pixel-level similarity for accurate bounding boxes, avoiding complex template updates and achieving real-time performance with competitive results on large-scale benchmarks.
2104.00324|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了模板更新难题，方法新颖且实用，对长期跟踪有重要贡献。
2104.00324|v2.contribution: 提出了基于时空记忆的模板无关跟踪框架。
2104.00324|v2.innovation: 利用记忆网络动态利用历史信息，替代固定模板。
2104.00324|v2.result: 在多个基准上取得领先性能，并支持实时跟踪。

TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.summary_cn: ①针对多人体关节3D姿态跟踪问题，现有方法通常分步处理检测与关联，缺乏端到端优化。②提出TesseTrack，一种可学习的端到端框架，直接联合估计多人体姿态并跟踪，利用时空一致性约束。③相比传统两步法，该方法通过统一网络同时优化姿态与关联，减少误差累积。④在公开数据集上展示了优于基线方法的跟踪精度，但摘要未提供具体数值。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-person articulated 3D pose tracking by proposing TesseTrack, an end-to-end learnable framework that jointly estimates poses and associations. It improves over two-stage methods by reducing error accumulation through unified optimization. Results show superior tracking accuracy on public benchmarks, though specific numbers are not given in the abstract.
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.assessment: 端到端跟踪思路有潜力，但领域相关性较低，且摘要信息有限，质量一般。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.contribution: 提出首个端到端可学习的多人体3D姿态跟踪框架。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.innovation: 将姿态估计与跟踪关联统一为可微分流程。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.result: 在公开数据集上优于分步基线方法。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P._arxiv_id: TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-Person Articulated 3D Pose Tracking.

CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.summary_cn: ①针对点云中刚体和关节物体的类别级姿态跟踪问题，现有方法依赖实例级模型或缺乏泛化能力。②提出CAPTRA，一种类别级姿态跟踪方法，通过编码器-解码器结构从点云预测姿态增量，并处理刚体与关节物体。③相比实例级方法，该方法在类别内泛化到未见实例，且无需CAD模型。④在合成和真实数据集上验证了有效性，但摘要未给出具体精度数据。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.summary_en: CAPTRA tackles category-level pose tracking for rigid and articulated objects from point clouds, using an encoder-decoder to predict pose increments. It generalizes to unseen instances within a category without CAD models, unlike instance-level approaches. Experiments on synthetic and real data confirm effectiveness, though quantitative results are omitted in the abstract.
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.assessment: 对3D感知有参考价值，但非核心领域，方法常规，创新性中等。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.contribution: 提出类别级点云姿态跟踪方法，支持刚体和关节物体。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.innovation: 利用类别级编码器实现跨实例泛化。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.result: 在合成与真实数据上验证了有效性。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for._arxiv_id: CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for Rigid and Articulated Objects from Point Clouds.

Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.summary_cn: ①针对点云单目标跟踪中特征判别性不足的问题，现有方法未充分利用目标框信息。②提出Box-Aware Feature Enhancement方法，通过引入目标框的几何与语义信息增强特征表示，提升跟踪鲁棒性。③相比仅依赖点云特征的基线，该方法显式建模框与特征的关系，增强目标定位能力。④在多个点云跟踪基准上取得改进，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.summary_en: This work enhances single object tracking on point clouds by incorporating box-aware features, leveraging geometric and semantic cues from target boxes. It improves discriminative power over point-only baselines. Experiments on tracking benchmarks show gains, though specific metrics are not stated in the abstract.
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.assessment: 与3D跟踪相关，但方法较简单，创新性有限，适合作为参考。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.contribution: 提出框感知特征增强模块用于点云单目标跟踪。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.innovation: 显式融合目标框信息到特征提取过程。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.result: 在点云跟踪基准上优于基线。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single._arxiv_id: Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single Object Tracking on Point Clouds.

Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪中依赖大量标注数据的问题，现有自监督方法缺乏跨输入一致性约束。②提出Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking with Cross-input Consistency，利用同一场景不同视角或时间输入的一致性作为监督信号，训练跟踪模型。③相比监督方法，该方法无需标注，且通过一致性正则化提升特征稳定性。④在多个MOT数据集上接近监督方法性能，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_en: This paper proposes a self-supervised multi-object tracking method using cross-input consistency, where consistency across different views or timestamps serves as supervision. It eliminates annotation needs and improves feature stability via regularization. Results approach supervised baselines on MOT datasets, though exact numbers are absent in the abstract.
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.assessment: 自监督跟踪思路新颖，与自动驾驶多目标跟踪相关，质量较好。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.contribution: 提出跨输入一致性的自监督多目标跟踪框架。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.innovation: 利用多视角/时间一致性作为无监督训练信号。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.result: 在MOT数据集上接近监督方法性能。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking with Cross-input Consistency.

Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.summary_cn: 该论文针对RGBD视频中通用3D单目标跟踪缺乏统一基准和基线方法的问题。作者构建了一个新的RGBD 3D跟踪基准数据集，并提出了一个基线方法。相比已有的仅基于RGB或点云的跟踪工作，该工作将RGB和深度信息结合，提供了更全面的评估平台。摘要未提供具体数据，但基准和基线为后续研究奠定了基础。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified benchmark and baseline for generic 3D object tracking in RGBD videos. The authors construct a new RGBD 3D tracking benchmark dataset and propose a baseline method. Compared to existing RGB-only or point-cloud-based tracking works, this work combines RGB and depth information, providing a more comprehensive evaluation platform. Specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract, but the benchmark and baseline lay a foundation for future research.
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.assessment: 该工作为RGBD 3D跟踪提供了标准化的评估基准，对推动该方向研究有重要价值。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.contribution: 构建了RGBD视频中通用3D跟踪的基准数据集和基线方法。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.innovation: 首次系统性地将RGB和深度信息结合用于通用3D跟踪基准构建。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.result: 提供了基准和基线，但摘要中未给出具体性能数据。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide._arxiv_id: Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Videos: Benchmark and Baseline.

2110.06864|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪中低分检测框被直接丢弃导致目标丢失和轨迹碎片化的问题。作者提出ByteTrack方法，通过关联几乎所有检测框（包括低分框），利用低分框与轨迹的相似性恢复真实目标并过滤背景。相比仅关联高分框的传统方法，该方法在9种SOTA跟踪器上IDF1一致提升1-10点。在MOT17测试集上首次达到80.3 MOTA、77.3 IDF1和63.1 HOTA，且单V100 GPU上运行速度30 FPS，并在MOT20、HiEve和BDD100K上取得SOTA。
2110.06864|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of discarding low-score detection boxes in multi-object tracking, which causes object loss and fragmented trajectories. The authors propose ByteTrack, which associates almost every detection box, using similarities between low-score boxes and tracklets to recover true objects and filter background. Compared to traditional high-score-only association, it consistently improves IDF1 by 1-10 points on 9 SOTA trackers. It achieves 80.3 MOTA, 77.3 IDF1, and 63.1 HOTA on MOT17 test set at 30 FPS on a single V100 GPU, and SOTA on MOT20, HiEve, and BDD100K.
2110.06864|v2.assessment: 该工作简单有效，是MOT领域的里程碑式工作，对实际应用有重大影响。
2110.06864|v2.contribution: 提出关联所有检测框的通用MOT方法，显著提升跟踪性能。
2110.06864|v2.innovation: 利用低分检测框的相似性恢复目标，突破了传统高分框关联的局限。
2110.06864|v2.result: 在MOT17上达到80.3 MOTA，多个基准上SOTA。

CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云3D跟踪中模板与搜索区域间外观差异大导致关联困难的问题。作者提出CMT（Context-Matching-Guided Transformer）方法，利用上下文匹配引导Transformer学习模板与搜索区域间的鲁棒关联。相比传统Siamese网络仅依赖局部特征，该方法通过上下文信息增强关联能力。摘要未提供具体数据，但方法设计具有创新性。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of robust cross-correlation learning between template and search area in point cloud 3D tracking due to large appearance variation. The authors propose CMT, a context-matching-guided Transformer that leverages contextual information to enhance association. Compared to traditional Siamese networks relying on local features, this method improves robustness. Specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.assessment: 该工作将Transformer与上下文匹配结合，为点云3D跟踪提供了新思路。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.contribution: 提出上下文匹配引导的Transformer用于点云3D跟踪。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.innovation: 利用上下文信息引导跨注意力学习，增强关联鲁棒性。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.result: 摘要未提供具体性能数据。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer._arxiv_id: CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer for 3D Tracking in Point Clouds.

2207.11995|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云单目标跟踪中模板与搜索区域间鲁棒互相关学习困难的问题。作者提出3D Siamese Transformer网络，使用Siamese点Transformer编码器学习形状上下文，并通过迭代粗到细相关网络增强关联。相比传统Siamese网络，该方法利用自注意力捕获非局部信息，并通过交叉注意力进行特征增强。摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在结构上有明显创新。
2207.11995|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of robust cross-correlation learning in point cloud single object tracking. The authors propose a 3D Siamese Transformer network with a Siamese point Transformer encoder for shape context and an iterative coarse-to-fine correlation network. Compared to traditional Siamese networks, it uses self-attention for non-local information and cross-attention for feature enhancement. Specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
2207.11995|v2.assessment: 该工作将Transformer架构引入Siamese跟踪，提升了点云跟踪的特征表达能力。
2207.11995|v2.contribution: 提出3D Siamese Transformer网络用于点云单目标跟踪。
2207.11995|v2.innovation: 结合自注意力与交叉注意力，实现粗到细的关联学习。
2207.11995|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体性能数据。

2208.01957|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D多目标跟踪中数据关联过度依赖外观特征的问题。作者提出PolarMOT方法，仅利用3D空间中物体间的几何关系（局部极坐标编码）进行数据关联，通过图神经网络将关联视为边分类。相比基于外观的方法，该表示对全局变换和非完整运动具有不变性，泛化性强。在nuScenes数据集上取得SOTA，并跨数据集（KITTI）和跨地点（波士顿、新加坡、卡尔斯鲁厄）表现优异。
2208.01957|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the over-reliance on appearance-based cues in 3D multi-object tracking. The authors propose PolarMOT, which encodes only geometric relationships between objects via localized polar coordinates and uses a graph neural network for data association as edge classification. Compared to appearance-based methods, this representation is invariant to global transformations and smooth trajectory changes. It achieves SOTA on nuScenes and generalizes well across locations and datasets.
2208.01957|v2.assessment: 该工作证明了纯几何关系在3D MOT中的强大潜力，具有出色的泛化能力。
2208.01957|v2.contribution: 提出仅基于几何关系的3D MOT方法，实现跨数据集泛化。
2208.01957|v2.innovation: 利用局部极坐标编码几何关系，结合GNN进行关联。
2208.01957|v2.result: 在nuScenes上SOTA，并跨数据集表现优异。

2207.10031|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对MOT数据集缺乏综合复杂度度量的问题。作者提出MOTCOM指标，结合遮挡、异常运动和视觉相似性三个子指标，用于描述序列复杂度。相比传统的密度和轨迹数量，MOTCOM能更准确地反映序列难度。在MOT17、MOT20和MOTSynth上评估，证明其有效性。
2207.10031|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a comprehensive complexity metric for MOT datasets. The authors propose MOTCOM, combining three sub-metrics for occlusion, erratic motion, and visual similarity. Compared to conventional density and track counts, MOTCOM better describes sequence complexity. Evaluations on MOT17, MOT20, and MOTSynth demonstrate its effectiveness.
2207.10031|v2.assessment: 该工作为MOT数据集分析提供了新工具，有助于更细粒度地理解跟踪性能。
2207.10031|v2.contribution: 提出MOT数据集复杂度度量MOTCOM。
2207.10031|v2.innovation: 结合多因素子指标，提供更全面的复杂度评估。
2207.10031|v2.result: 在多个数据集上验证了其优于传统指标。

2208.03727|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪中相邻帧目标间的一对一分配问题，现有方法依赖固定阈值丢弃特征距离过大的匹配对，但不同视频的Re-ID特征距离分布差异大，单一阈值不鲁棒。②提出一种高效计算每对目标边际概率的方法，作为归一化距离替代原始特征距离，该距离在不同视频间更稳定，从而可使用统一阈值。③改进点在于用边际概率替代原始距离，无需针对每个视频调整阈值，且方法通用，可应用于现有跟踪器。④在MOT17和MOT20基准上，应用该方法可使IDF1指标提升约1个点，且概率更具可解释性，便于后续后处理。
2208.03727|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the one-to-one assignment problem in multi-object tracking, where fixed thresholds for discarding impossible matches are unreliable due to varying Re-ID feature distance distributions across videos. It proposes an efficient method to compute marginal probabilities for each object pair, serving as a normalized distance that is more stable, enabling a single threshold for all videos. Applied to existing trackers, it achieves about one point improvement in IDF1 on MOT17 and MOT20 benchmarks, with more interpretable outputs.
2208.03727|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种简单而有效的通用改进方案，解决了多目标跟踪中阈值选择的关键问题，具有较高的实用价值。
2208.03727|v2.contribution: 提出基于边际概率的归一化距离，统一了多目标跟踪中的匹配阈值。
2208.03727|v2.innovation: 利用边际概率替代原始特征距离，实现跨视频稳定的匹配决策。

2207.09603|v2.summary_cn: ①针对Transformer跟踪器中注意力机制独立计算相关性导致注意力权重噪声大、模糊的问题，限制了性能提升。②提出注意力中的注意力（AiA）模块，通过在所有相关性向量中寻求共识来增强正确相关性并抑制错误相关性，可应用于自注意力和交叉注意力块；并构建了AiATrack框架，引入高效特征复用和目标-背景嵌入以充分利用时间参考。③改进点在于通过共识机制细化注意力权重，并设计了流线型跟踪框架。④在六个跟踪基准上达到最先进性能，同时保持实时速度。
2207.09603|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles noisy and ambiguous attention weights in Transformer trackers by proposing an Attention-in-Attention (AiA) module that seeks consensus among correlation vectors to enhance correct correlations and suppress erroneous ones. It introduces AiATrack, a streamlined framework with efficient feature reuse and target-background embeddings, achieving state-of-the-art performance on six benchmarks at real-time speed.
2207.09603|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地改进了Transformer注意力机制，显著提升了跟踪精度和鲁棒性，是该领域的重要进展。
2207.09603|v2.contribution: 提出AiA模块和AiATrack框架，提升Transformer跟踪器的性能。
2207.09603|v2.innovation: 通过注意力共识机制细化相关性计算。
2207.09603|v2.result: 在六个基准上达到SOTA并保持实时速度。

2207.13784|v2.summary_cn: ①针对混合现实头戴显示器仅跟踪头部和手部姿态，导致虚拟化身仅显示上半身的问题，限制了协作场景的应用。②提出AvatarPoser，首个仅利用头部和手部运动输入预测全身姿态的学习方法，基于Transformer编码器提取特征，并解耦全局运动与局部关节方向，通过逆运动学优化细化手臂位置。③改进点在于无需额外传感器，仅用稀疏输入即可估计全身姿态。④实验表明能生成类似动作捕捉的准确全身运动，但摘要未提供具体数值。
2207.13784|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of Mixed Reality avatars showing only upper bodies by proposing AvatarPoser, the first learning-based method to predict full-body poses from head and hand motion only. It uses a Transformer encoder, decouples global motion from local joint orientations, and refines arm positions via inverse kinematics, achieving accurate full-body motions without extra sensors.
2207.13784|v2.assessment: 该论文针对MR应用有创新性，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低。
2207.13784|v2.contribution: 提出仅用头部和手部输入预测全身姿态的方法。
2207.13784|v2.innovation: 利用Transformer和逆运动学实现稀疏输入下的全身姿态估计。
2207.13784|v2.result: 生成类似动作捕捉的全身运动。

2208.05810|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉跟踪中现有学习方法大多采用帧级训练，忽略了跟踪本质上是序列级任务，导致训练与测试在数据分布和目标函数上不一致。②提出基于强化学习的序列级训练策略，包括序列级数据采样、学习目标和数据增强设计。③改进点在于将训练从帧级提升到序列级，更符合跟踪任务的时序特性。④在LaSOT、TrackingNet和GOT-10k基准上，四种代表性跟踪模型（SiamRPN++、SiamAttn、TransT、TrDiMP）均通过该训练方法一致提升，无需修改架构。
2208.05810|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inconsistency between frame-level training and sequence-level testing in visual tracking by introducing a sequence-level training strategy based on reinforcement learning, including sequence-level data sampling, objectives, and augmentation. It consistently improves four representative trackers (SiamRPN++, SiamAttn, TransT, TrDiMP) on LaSOT, TrackingNet, and GOT-10k without architecture changes.
2208.05810|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种通用训练策略，能显著提升多种跟踪器性能，具有广泛适用性。
2208.05810|v2.contribution: 提出序列级训练策略，弥合跟踪训练与测试的差距。
2208.05810|v2.innovation: 将强化学习应用于序列级跟踪训练。
2208.05810|v2.result: 四种跟踪器在多个基准上一致提升。

2203.11191|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉跟踪中目标范围估计问题，现有跟踪器以边界框为中心，但物体形状复杂且不轴对齐时，边界框包含大量背景像素，描述不准确。②提出以分割为中心的跟踪流程，不仅输出高精度分割掩码，内部也使用分割掩码而非边界框，并设计独立的实例定位组件来条件化分割解码器。③改进点在于用分割掩码替代边界框作为内部表示，更好区分目标与背景。④在LaSOT上达到新的最先进水平，成功AUC为69.7%。
2203.11191|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inaccuracy of bounding-box-centric trackers for complex-shaped objects by proposing a segmentation-centric tracking pipeline that internally uses segmentation masks instead of boxes, with a separate instance localization component to condition the segmentation decoder. It achieves a new state-of-the-art on LaSOT with a success AUC of 69.7%.
2203.11191|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将分割引入跟踪核心流程，显著提升复杂场景下的跟踪精度。
2203.11191|v2.contribution: 提出分割中心的跟踪流程，提升目标表示精度。
2203.11191|v2.innovation: 内部使用分割掩码替代边界框。

Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visua.summary_cn: ①论文标题为“Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visual Tracking”，但摘要为空，无法获取具体问题、方法、改进和效果信息。②基于标题推测，可能涉及利用层次化特征嵌入来提升视觉跟踪性能。③由于缺乏摘要，无法评估其创新性和贡献。④效果未知。
Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visua.summary_en: The paper titled 'Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visual Tracking' has an empty abstract, so no specific problem, method, or results can be summarized. It likely focuses on hierarchical feature embedding for tracking, but details are unavailable.
Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visua.assessment: 由于摘要缺失，无法进行有效评估，建议获取全文后再判断。
Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visua._arxiv_id: Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visual Tracking.

2204.12489|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对立体声麦克风对中声音到达时间差（ITD）估计问题，即通过双耳时间延迟推断声源方向，核心挑战在于找到两路信号间的对应关系。②提出利用自监督学习，借鉴视觉跟踪中的对比随机游走（Contrastive Random Walk）方法，从无标注立体声数据中学习循环一致的表示，并进一步提出多模态对比学习模型，利用人脸视觉表征解决多说话人混合场景下特定人的时间延迟估计。③相比传统信号处理方法，该方法无需人工标注，通过自监督方式学习对应关系；相比已有监督方法，在无标签数据上达到同等性能。④在“野外”互联网录音上，该方法与监督方法性能相当；多模态模型在视觉引导的定位任务中有效。
2204.12489|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses interaural time delay (ITD) estimation for sound source direction, proposing a self-supervised approach that adapts contrastive random walk from visual tracking to learn cycle-consistent representations from unlabeled stereo audio. It also introduces a multimodal contrastive model for visually-guided delay estimation of a specific speaker in mixtures. The method achieves performance on par with supervised methods on in-the-wild recordings.
2204.12489|v2.assessment: 该论文虽与自动驾驶视觉领域关联度低，但自监督对应学习思想有一定借鉴价值，适合关注跨模态自监督方法的研究者。
2204.12489|v2.contribution: 提出基于自监督时间延迟估计的声音定位方法，并扩展至多模态视觉引导场景。
2204.12489|v2.innovation: 将视觉跟踪中的对比随机游走适配到音频对应学习，实现无监督ITD估计。
2204.12489|v2.result: 在野外录音上与监督方法性能持平，多模态模型有效解决特定说话人定位。

CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云跟踪中因目标稀疏和遮挡导致的上下文信息利用不足问题。②提出CXTrack，通过引入局部和全局上下文信息增强目标特征，并设计上下文感知的匹配模块。③相比现有方法，显式建模空间上下文以区分相似目标。④在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上提升了跟踪精度，但摘要未提供具体数值。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient contextual information in 3D point cloud tracking. It proposes CXTrack with context-aware feature enhancement and matching. It improves tracking accuracy on KITTI and nuScenes, though specific numbers are absent.
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.assessment: 针对点云跟踪的上下文建模有明确动机，但实验细节不足，影响力有限。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.contribution: 提出上下文感知的3D点云跟踪框架。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.innovation: 显式利用局部和全局上下文进行目标区分。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上提升精度，但无具体数据。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki._arxiv_id: CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracking with Contextual Information.

2302.03802|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多相机3D多目标跟踪中长时遮挡和轨迹不连续问题。②提出PF-Track，基于tracking-by-attention框架，通过Past Reasoning模块利用历史帧查询增强特征，Future Reasoning模块预测未来轨迹以维持遮挡目标。③相比现有方法，显式结合过去和未来推理，实现端到端训练。④在nuScenes上AMOTA大幅提升，ID-Switches减少90%，达到数量级改进。
2302.03802|v2.summary_en: This work tackles long-term occlusion and discontinuity in multi-camera 3D MOT. PF-Track integrates past and future reasoning within a tracking-by-attention framework, enhancing features and predicting trajectories. It improves AMOTA significantly and reduces ID-Switches by 90% on nuScenes.
2302.03802|v2.assessment: 方法创新性强，实验效果显著，是多相机3D跟踪的重要进展。
2302.03802|v2.contribution: 提出端到端多相机3D MOT框架，结合过去与未来推理。
2302.03802|v2.innovation: Past和Future Reasoning模块协同处理遮挡和轨迹预测。

MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.summary_cn: ①针对端到端MOT方法（如MOTR）在复杂场景下检测性能不足的问题。②提出MOTRv2，利用预训练目标检测器提供高质量检测结果，作为查询初始化引导跟踪。③相比MOTR，通过解耦检测和跟踪，降低训练难度并提升鲁棒性。④在DanceTrack和BDD100X等数据集上达到SOTA，但摘要未提供具体数值。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.summary_en: This paper addresses weak detection in end-to-end MOT. MOTRv2 bootstraps with pretrained detectors to initialize queries, decoupling detection and tracking. It achieves SOTA on DanceTrack and BDD100X, though specific metrics are omitted.
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.assessment: 实用性强，有效提升端到端跟踪的检测质量，但创新性略逊于PF-Track。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.contribution: 利用预训练检测器增强端到端MOT的检测能力。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.innovation: 检测与跟踪解耦的查询初始化策略。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O._arxiv_id: MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking by Pretrained Object Detectors.

Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.summary_cn: ①针对SORT方法在遮挡和相机运动下鲁棒性不足的问题。②提出OC-SORT，引入观测中心的思想，通过运动方向一致性和观测中心更新修正轨迹。③相比SORT，增强了对噪声检测和遮挡的鲁棒性。④在MOT17和MOT20上显著提升HOTA和IDF1，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.summary_en: This paper addresses robustness issues in SORT under occlusion and camera motion. OC-SORT introduces observation-centric updates and motion direction consistency. It significantly improves HOTA and IDF1 on MOT17/MOT20, though specifics are absent.
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.assessment: 简洁有效，对经典SORT的改进具有广泛适用性。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.contribution: 提出观测中心SORT，提升跟踪鲁棒性。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.innovation: 观测中心更新和运动方向一致性约束。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.result: 在MOT基准上显著提升性能。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR._arxiv_id: Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SORT for Robust Multi-Object Tracking.

MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.summary_cn: ①针对MOT中短期和长期运动建模不充分的问题。②提出MotionTrack，分别学习短期运动（用于关联）和长期运动（用于重识别），并融合两者。③相比单一运动模型，更全面处理遮挡和轨迹中断。④在MOT17和MOT20上提升性能，但摘要未提供具体数值。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient short-term and long-term motion modeling in MOT. MotionTrack learns both motion types and fuses them for association and re-identification. It improves performance on MOT17/MOT20, though specifics are absent.
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.assessment: 运动建模思路合理，但实验细节和对比不够突出。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.contribution: 提出双运动模型融合的MOT方法。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.innovation: 短期与长期运动的分工与融合。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term._arxiv_id: MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term and Long-Term Motions for Multi-Object Tracking.

Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.summary_cn: ①针对MOT中目标外观相似导致身份混淆的问题。②提出Focus On Details，通过提取细粒度特征（如局部区域）增强目标表示。③相比全局特征，更关注细节区分。④在MOT17和MOT20上提升IDF1，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.summary_en: This paper addresses identity confusion in MOT due to similar appearances. It proposes diverse fine-grained representation learning. It improves IDF1 on MOT17/MOT20, though specifics are absent.
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.assessment: 细粒度特征思路有价值，但创新性和实验强度一般。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.contribution: 提出细粒度表示增强MOT特征。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr._arxiv_id: Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tracking with Diverse Fine-Grained Representation.

Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多目标跟踪中缺乏自然语言交互能力的问题，提出Referring Multi-Object Tracking任务。②方法上，可能结合了语言描述与视觉跟踪，利用文本引导目标关联。③相比传统MOT，创新在于引入语言模态，增强目标描述灵活性。④由于摘要缺失，具体效果未提及，但任务设定具有新颖性。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of natural language interaction in multi-object tracking by proposing the Referring Multi-Object Tracking task. It likely integrates language descriptions with visual tracking to guide target association. Compared to traditional MOT, the innovation lies in incorporating language modality for flexible target specification. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.assessment: 任务设定新颖，但缺乏摘要细节，需进一步验证方法有效性。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.contribution: 提出Referring Multi-Object Tracking任务，将语言引入多目标跟踪。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.innovation: 结合自然语言描述与多目标跟踪，实现跨模态目标关联。

UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多目标跟踪中身份特征不充分的问题，提出统一模型UTM。②方法上，通过身份感知特征增强模块提升目标区分度。③相比现有方法，统一了检测与跟踪流程，增强特征鲁棒性。④由于摘要缺失，具体性能数据未提及。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient identity features in multi-object tracking by proposing a unified model UTM with identity-aware feature enhancement. It unifies detection and tracking pipelines to improve feature robustness. Specific performance metrics are unavailable due to missing abstract.
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.assessment: 统一模型思路有潜力，但需实验数据支撑。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.contribution: 提出UTM统一多目标跟踪模型，增强身份特征。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.innovation: 身份感知特征增强模块，提升目标区分能力。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking._arxiv_id: UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking Model with Identity-Aware Feature Enhancement.

3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自由活动鸟类的2D-3D跟踪标注难题，提出自动化标注方法3D-POP。②方法上，结合标记点运动捕捉与无标记跟踪，实现自动化标注。③相比手动标注，提高了效率和一致性。④由于摘要缺失，具体效果未提及。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.summary_en: This paper addresses the annotation challenge for tracking freely moving birds by proposing an automated approach 3D-POP, combining marker-based motion capture with markerless tracking. It improves efficiency and consistency over manual annotation. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.assessment: 应用场景特定，与自动驾驶相关性低。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.contribution: 提出3D-POP自动化标注方法，用于鸟类2D-3D跟踪。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.innovation: 结合标记与无标记技术，实现自动化标注。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac._arxiv_id: 3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approach to Facilitate Markerless 2D-3D Tracking of Freely Moving Birds with Marker-Based Motion Capture.

Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视觉跟踪中的时序建模问题，提出自回归视觉跟踪方法。②方法上，利用自回归模型预测目标状态序列。③相比传统跟踪器，增强了时序一致性。④由于摘要缺失，具体性能数据未提及，但自回归范式在跟踪中具有创新性。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses temporal modeling in visual tracking by proposing an autoregressive approach. It uses autoregressive models to predict target state sequences, enhancing temporal consistency. Specific performance metrics are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.assessment: 自回归范式在跟踪中具有创新性，值得关注。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.contribution: 提出自回归视觉跟踪方法，改进时序建模。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.innovation: 将自回归模型应用于目标状态预测。

2303.13913|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对服装类别级姿态跟踪问题，提出完整解决方案。②方法上，包括VR-Garment记录系统、VR-Folding数据集和GarmentTracking跟踪框架，预测点云序列的完整服装姿态。③相比基线，在速度和精度上均有提升，尤其处理大形变。④实验表明性能优越，代码和数据集已开源。
2303.13913|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses category-level garment pose tracking by proposing a complete package including VR-Garment recording system, VR-Folding dataset, and GarmentTracking framework. It predicts complete garment pose from point cloud sequences, outperforming baselines in speed and accuracy, especially under large non-rigid deformation. Codes and datasets are open-sourced.
2303.13913|v2.assessment: 数据集和框架完整，对非刚性物体跟踪有参考价值。
2303.13913|v2.contribution: 提出服装姿态跟踪的完整解决方案，含数据集和框架。
2303.13913|v2.innovation: 结合VR采集与端到端跟踪，处理非刚性形变。
2303.13913|v2.result: 在速度和精度上优于基线。

2303.05071|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对3D单目标跟踪中遮挡和尺寸差异导致的外观变化问题，提出MBPTrack。②方法上，采用记忆机制利用历史信息，并通过盒先验进行粗到细定位。③相比现有方法，利用第一帧盒先验自适应采样参考点，提升不同尺寸目标的定位精度。④在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo上达到最先进性能。
2303.05071|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses appearance variation in 3D single object tracking caused by occlusion and size differences by proposing MBPTrack. It uses a memory mechanism and box priors for coarse-to-fine localization, adaptively sampling reference points. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on KITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo.
2303.05071|v2.assessment: 方法创新且实验充分，对自动驾驶3D跟踪有重要价值。
2303.05071|v2.contribution: 提出MBPTrack，结合记忆网络和盒先验提升3D跟踪性能。
2303.05071|v2.innovation: 利用盒先验自适应采样，实现粗到细定位。
2303.05071|v2.result: 在多个基准上达到最先进性能。

2309.14491|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中闭集3D感知模型无法处理部署后遇到的新物体类别，且现有无监督方法仅能处理移动物体、缺乏语义标签的问题。②提出一种多模态自动标注流水线，利用点云序列中的运动线索与2D图像-文本对，通过视觉-语言知识蒸馏生成任意类别（open-set）的3D边界框和轨迹，同时处理静态和动态物体。③相比仅提供类别无关标签且限于移动物体的先前工作，本方法支持开放词汇语义标签，并扩展至静态物体。④在Waymo Open Dataset上，多种无监督3D感知任务显著优于先前方法。
2309.14491|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of closed-set 3D perception models in autonomous driving for handling novel object categories post-deployment. It proposes a multi-modal auto-labeling pipeline that leverages motion cues from point cloud sequences and 2D image-text pairs, combined with vision-language knowledge distillation, to generate amodal 3D boxes and tracklets for open-set categories, covering both static and moving objects. The method outperforms prior unsupervised approaches by large margins on Waymo Open Dataset across various tasks.
2309.14491|v2.assessment: 该工作将开放词汇能力引入无监督3D感知，显著提升自动驾驶场景的泛化性和实用性，具有重要研究价值。
2309.14491|v2.contribution: 提出首个能生成开放词汇语义标签的无监督3D自动标注流水线，覆盖静态和动态物体。
2309.14491|v2.innovation: 结合运动线索与2D视觉-语言知识蒸馏，实现无需3D人工标签的开放集3D感知。
2309.14491|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上大幅超越现有无监督方法，验证了方法的有效性。

2308.06904|v2.summary_cn: ①针对Transformer跟踪器速度慢、难以在计算受限设备上部署的问题。②提出HiT，一种高效跟踪模型家族，核心是Bridge Module，将深层特征的高层信息融入浅层大分辨率特征，并设计双图像位置编码同时编码搜索区域和模板的位置信息。③相比现有高效跟踪器，通过桥接模块和位置编码改进特征质量，在保持高性能的同时提升速度。④在Nvidia Jetson AGX边缘设备上达到61 fps，在LaSOT上取得64.6% AUC，超越所有先前高效跟踪器。
2308.06904|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the low-speed issue of Transformer-based visual trackers for deployment on resource-limited devices. It introduces HiT, an efficient tracking family with a Bridge Module that integrates high-level deep features into shallow large-resolution features, plus a dual-image position encoding for search and template regions. HiT achieves 61 fps on Nvidia Jetson AGX and 64.6% AUC on LaSOT, surpassing prior efficient trackers.
2308.06904|v2.assessment: 该工作针对边缘部署的实时性需求，提供了有效的轻量化Transformer跟踪方案，但创新性相对有限。
2308.06904|v2.contribution: 提出Bridge Module和双图像位置编码，实现高效且高性能的轻量级Transformer跟踪器。
2308.06904|v2.innovation: 通过桥接模块融合多尺度特征，并创新性地编码双图像位置信息。
2308.06904|v2.result: 在边缘设备上实现61 fps，并在LaSOT上达到64.6% AUC，优于现有高效跟踪器。

2309.00942|v2.summary_cn: ①针对无监督多目标跟踪中缺乏标签、物体相互干扰和遮挡导致关联困难的问题。②提出UCSL方法，包含三个对比模块：自对比（帧内直接和帧间间接对比）、交叉对比（对齐跨帧和连续帧匹配结果）和模糊对比（匹配模糊物体以增强关联确定性）。③相比现有无监督方法，通过多级对比学习挖掘样本特征的潜在一致性，减少遮挡负面影响。④在现有基准上，仅用有限的ReID头帮助即超越现有无监督方法，甚至优于许多全监督方法。
2309.00942|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of unsupervised multiple object tracking without labels, where mutual interference and occlusion complicate association. It proposes UCSL with three contrast modules—self-contrast, cross-contrast, and ambiguity contrast—to learn discriminative representations and mitigate occlusion effects. UCSL outperforms existing unsupervised methods and even surpasses many fully supervised approaches on benchmarks.
2309.00942|v2.assessment: 该工作通过对比学习有效解决无监督MOT的关联难题，性能提升显著，具有较强实用价值。
2309.00942|v2.contribution: 提出三模块对比相似性学习框架，实现无需标签的高效多目标跟踪。
2309.00942|v2.innovation: 引入交叉对比和模糊对比机制，增强特征鲁棒性和关联确定性。
2309.00942|v2.result: 在多个基准上超越现有无监督方法，部分指标优于全监督方法。

ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi.summary_cn: ①针对视觉跟踪中固定分辨率输入导致计算浪费和性能受限的问题。②提出ZoomTrack，一种目标感知的非均匀缩放方法，根据目标区域动态调整输入图像的分辨率分配。③相比均匀缩放，通过自适应分配计算资源提升跟踪效率。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果待验证。
ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficient computation in visual tracking due to fixed-resolution input. It proposes ZoomTrack, a target-aware non-uniform resizing method that adaptively allocates resolution based on target regions. The effectiveness is not detailed in the abstract, requiring further validation.
ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi.assessment: 该工作思路新颖，但摘要信息不足，缺乏实验数据支撑，当前评估有限。
ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi.contribution: 提出目标感知的非均匀缩放策略，优化跟踪中的计算资源分配。
ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi.innovation: 动态调整输入分辨率以匹配目标区域，提升效率。
ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi.result: 摘要未提供具体效果数据，需进一步验证。
ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi._arxiv_id: ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resizing for Efficient Visual Tracking.

DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪中目标间外观相似和遮挡导致的身份混淆问题。②提出了DeconfuseTrack方法，通过解耦特征学习和关联策略来减少混淆。③相比现有方法，引入了专门的混淆处理模块，增强了判别性。④在多个基准上提升了跟踪性能，但摘要未提供具体数据。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.summary_en: This paper addresses identity confusion in multi-object tracking caused by similar appearances and occlusions. It proposes DeconfuseTrack, which decouples feature learning and association to reduce confusion. The method improves tracking performance on benchmarks, though specific numbers are not given in the abstract.
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.assessment: 针对跟踪中的常见难题，但缺乏具体实验数据，创新性一般。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.contribution: 提出了一种减少多目标跟踪中身份混淆的解耦方法。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.innovation: 通过解耦特征与关联策略处理混淆问题。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.result: 在多个基准上提升了跟踪性能。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f._arxiv_id: DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion for Multi-Object Tracking.

Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪方法在跨域场景下泛化能力不足的问题。②提出了提升跟踪模型泛化性的方法，可能包括数据增强或域适应策略。③相比现有工作，强调了跨数据集和跨环境的鲁棒性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在多个数据集上表现稳定。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.summary_en: This paper tackles the poor generalization of multi-object tracking methods across domains. It proposes strategies to enhance robustness, likely via augmentation or domain adaptation. The approach shows stable performance across datasets, though no specific metrics are mentioned.
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.assessment: 关注泛化性，对实际部署有价值，但细节不足。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.contribution: 提出了提升多目标跟踪跨域泛化能力的方法。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.innovation: 通过域适应或增强策略增强泛化性。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.result: 在多个数据集上表现稳定。

Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.summary_cn: ①针对低光环境下多目标跟踪性能急剧下降的问题。②提出了专门针对暗光场景的跟踪方法，可能结合图像增强和鲁棒特征提取。③相比现有方法，考虑了光照条件对检测和关联的影响。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调在暗光基准上的显著提升。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the severe performance drop of multi-object tracking in low-light conditions. It proposes a method tailored for dark scenes, likely combining image enhancement and robust feature extraction. The approach shows significant improvements on dark benchmarks, though specific numbers are absent.
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.assessment: 针对实际挑战性场景，具有应用价值，但需更多实验细节。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.contribution: 提出了暗光环境下的多目标跟踪方法。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.innovation: 结合图像增强与鲁棒特征提取应对低光。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.result: 在暗光基准上显著提升。

HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.summary_cn: ①针对视觉跟踪中目标外观变化和干扰物导致的漂移问题。②提出了HIPTrack，利用历史提示（historical prompts）来增强跟踪器的记忆和判别能力。③相比现有方法，引入了基于提示学习的机制，动态利用历史信息。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在多个跟踪基准上达到先进性能。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.summary_en: This paper addresses drift in visual tracking caused by appearance changes and distractors. It proposes HIPTrack, which uses historical prompts to enhance memory and discrimination. The method leverages prompt learning to dynamically exploit historical information, achieving state-of-the-art results on benchmarks.
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.assessment: 提示学习在跟踪中的应用具有创新性，与VLM趋势相关。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.contribution: 提出了基于历史提示的视觉跟踪方法。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.innovation: 将提示学习引入跟踪以利用历史信息。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.result: 在多个基准上达到先进性能。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica._arxiv_id: HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historical Prompts.

MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.summary_cn: ①针对手部姿态跟踪中生物力学约束缺失的问题。②提出了MS-MANO，在手部模型中加入生物力学约束以提升姿态估计的合理性。③相比现有方法，增强了模型的物理一致性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在姿态精度上有所提升。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of biomechanical constraints in hand pose tracking. It proposes MS-MANO, which incorporates biomechanical constraints into the hand model for more plausible poses. The method improves physical consistency, though no specific metrics are given.
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.assessment: 领域较窄，与自动驾驶感知相关性低。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.contribution: 提出了带生物力学约束的手部姿态跟踪模型。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.innovation: 在手部模型中引入生物力学约束。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.result: 提升了姿态估计的合理性。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit._arxiv_id: MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking with Biomechanical Constraints.

2407.04926|v2.summary_cn: ①针对基于注意力的3D跟踪（TBA）方法在自动驾驶中性能落后于检测跟踪（TBD）方法的问题。②提出了JDT3D，一个联合检测与跟踪的LiDAR框架，并分析了TBA的不足，提出两种通用方法：轨迹采样增强和基于置信度的查询传播。③相比现有TBA方法，显著缩小了与TBD的差距。④在nuScenes测试集上达到0.574 AMOTA，超过所有现有LiDAR TBA方法6%以上。
2407.04926|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates why tracking-by-attention (TBA) methods lag behind tracking-by-detection (TBD) in 3D LiDAR tracking. It proposes JDT3D, a joint detector and tracker, with two generalizable methods: track sampling augmentation and confidence-based query propagation. JDT3D achieves 0.574 AMOTA on nuScenes, outperforming all LiDAR TBA methods by over 6%.
2407.04926|v2.assessment: 针对自动驾驶3D跟踪的关键问题，实验充分，性能领先，具有重要参考价值。
2407.04926|v2.contribution: 提出了JDT3D，缩小了TBA与TBD在3D跟踪中的性能差距。
2407.04926|v2.innovation: 通过轨迹采样增强和置信度查询传播改进TBA。
2407.04926|v2.result: 在nuScenes上达到0.574 AMOTA，超过现有TBA方法6%以上。

2409.17221|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪（MOT）依赖大量逐帧边界框和ID标注的问题，本文提出Walker，首个仅需稀疏边界框标注且无需跟踪标签的自监督跟踪器。方法上，构建准稠密时间外观图，设计多正样本对比目标优化图上的随机游走以学习实例相似性，并引入算法强制实例间互斥连接属性以优化拓扑。推理时，基于运动约束的双向游走最大似然转移状态进行关联。在MOT17、DanceTrack和BDD100K上达到与监督方法竞争的性能，且相比先前自监督跟踪器，标注需求减少高达400倍。
2409.17221|v2.summary_en: Addressing the heavy annotation burden in multi-object tracking, this paper introduces Walker, the first self-supervised tracker learning from videos with sparse bounding boxes and no tracking labels. It builds a quasi-dense temporal appearance graph, optimizes random walks with a multi-positive contrastive objective, and enforces mutually-exclusive connections for MOT. Achieving competitive results on MOT17, DanceTrack, and BDD100K, it outperforms prior self-supervised methods while reducing annotation requirements by up to 400x.
2409.17221|v2.assessment: 该工作显著降低了MOT的标注成本，是自监督跟踪领域的重要进展，对自动驾驶等数据稀缺场景具有潜在价值。
2409.17221|v2.contribution: 提出首个基于稀疏标注的自监督多目标跟踪框架，大幅减少标注需求。
2409.17221|v2.innovation: 将随机游走与多正样本对比学习结合，并引入互斥连接约束以优化跟踪拓扑。
2409.17221|v2.result: 在多个基准上超越先前自监督方法，标注需求降低400倍。

Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.summary_cn: 针对3D单目标跟踪中依赖大量3D标注且训练效率低的问题，本文提出通过2D匹配蒸馏和3D预训练来提升跟踪性能。方法上，利用2D跟踪器提供的匹配信息作为辅助监督，蒸馏到3D网络，并结合大规模3D预训练以增强特征表示。相比仅依赖3D标注的方法，该策略有效利用了2D数据丰富性，提高了跟踪精度和泛化能力。实验表明，该方法在多个3D跟踪基准上取得了显著改进。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.summary_en: To improve 3D single object tracking with limited 3D annotations, this work proposes boosting performance via 2D matching distillation and 3D pre-training. It leverages 2D tracker outputs as auxiliary supervision and employs large-scale 3D pre-training for better feature learning. Experiments show significant gains on multiple 3D tracking benchmarks, demonstrating improved accuracy and generalization.
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.assessment: 该工作结合2D和3D信息，为3D跟踪提供了一种有效的训练增强策略，但创新性相对常规。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.contribution: 提出2D匹配蒸馏与3D预训练结合的方法，提升3D单目标跟踪性能。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.innovation: 利用2D跟踪知识蒸馏到3D网络，并引入3D预训练。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.result: 在多个3D跟踪基准上取得显著性能提升。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with._arxiv_id: Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with 2D Matching Distillation and 3D Pre-training.

2401.11204|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D单目标跟踪中类别特定模型参数冗余、泛化受限的问题，本文首次提出统一模型，用单一网络和共享参数同时跟踪所有类别。方法上，设计AdaFormer，一种基于Transformer的点集表示学习网络，自适应编码跨类别数据中动态变化的形状和尺寸信息，并将模板目标的尺寸和形状先验融入输入和学习目标。相比类别特定模型，该方法减少了参数冗余，提高了跨类别泛化能力，在多个基准上验证了有效性。
2401.11204|v2.summary_en: Addressing the parameter redundancy and limited generalization of category-specific 3D single object tracking models, this paper introduces a unified model tracking all categories with shared parameters. It proposes AdaFormer, a transformer-based network that adaptively encodes shape and size variations, incorporating template priors. This reduces redundancy and improves cross-category generalization, validated on multiple benchmarks.
2401.11204|v2.assessment: 该工作推动了3D SOT向统一模型发展，具有较高的实用价值和创新性。
2401.11204|v2.contribution: 首次提出跨类别统一的3D单目标跟踪模型，减少参数冗余。
2401.11204|v2.innovation: 设计AdaFormer自适应编码形状和尺寸，并利用模板先验。
2401.11204|v2.result: 在多个基准上验证了统一模型的有效性和泛化能力。

BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.summary_cn: 针对野生动物监测中多目标跟踪和重识别数据集缺乏的问题，本文提出BuckTales，一个多无人机采集的野生羚羊数据集。该数据集包含多视角、多场景的无人机视频，用于多目标跟踪和重识别任务。提供了详细的标注和评估协议，旨在促进野生动物视觉追踪研究。相比现有数据集，其特点在于多无人机视角和真实野外环境。
BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.summary_en: To address the lack of datasets for wildlife monitoring, this paper introduces BuckTales, a multi-UAV dataset for tracking and re-identification of wild antelopes. It provides multi-view, multi-scenario videos with detailed annotations and evaluation protocols, aiming to advance wildlife vision research. The dataset features realistic field conditions and multi-drone perspectives.
BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.assessment: 该数据集对野生动物监测领域有贡献，但与自动驾驶核心方向相关性较低。
BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.contribution: 提供多无人机野生羚羊跟踪与重识别数据集。
BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.innovation: 多无人机视角和真实野外环境的数据采集。
BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.result: 为野生动物视觉追踪提供新基准。
BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi._arxiv_id: BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi-object tracking and re-identification of wild antelopes.

2411.00553|v2.summary_cn: 针对端到端Transformer跟踪器在异构场景中训练时面临负干扰和域泛化差的问题，本文提出PASTA框架，结合参数高效微调（PEFT）和模块化深度学习（MDL）。方法上，定义关键场景属性（如相机视角、光照条件），为每个属性训练专用PEFT模块，并在参数空间组合这些专家模块，实现对新域的系统性泛化且不增加推理时间。在MOTSynth上的实验及对MOT17和PersonPath22的零样本评估表明，基于精选模块的跟踪器优于单一模型。
2411.00553|v2.summary_en: Addressing negative interference and poor domain generalization in end-to-end trackers, this paper proposes PASTA, combining PEFT and modular deep learning. It trains specialized PEFT modules for key scenario attributes and combines them in parameter space, enabling systematic generalization without extra inference cost. Experiments on MOTSynth and zero-shot evaluations on MOT17 and PersonPath22 show that a modular tracker outperforms its monolithic counterpart.
2411.00553|v2.assessment: 该工作为多场景跟踪提供了高效的模块化解决方案，具有较强实用性和创新性。
2411.00553|v2.contribution: 提出PASTA框架，结合PEFT和MDL提升跟踪器的域泛化能力。
2411.00553|v2.innovation: 基于场景属性的模块化参数组合，实现零样本泛化。
2411.00553|v2.result: 在多个基准上超越单一模型，零样本评估表现优异。

2411.01756|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言（VL）跟踪器因依赖模糊人工文本描述而性能逊于纯视觉跟踪器的问题，本文提出ChatTracker，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）生成高质量语言描述以增强跟踪。方法上，提出基于反射的提示优化模块，通过跟踪反馈迭代细化模糊描述，并设计简单有效的VL跟踪框架，可作为即插即用模块提升VL和视觉跟踪器性能。实验表明，ChatTracker在多个基准上显著提高了跟踪精度。
2411.01756|v2.summary_en: To address the performance gap of VL trackers due to ambiguous manual descriptions, this paper proposes ChatTracker, leveraging MLLMs to generate high-quality language descriptions. It introduces a reflection-based prompt optimization module to iteratively refine descriptions with tracking feedback, and a plug-and-play VL framework. Experiments show significant improvements on multiple benchmarks.
2411.01756|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙结合MLLM与跟踪，有效解决了描述模糊问题，具有较高创新性和应用潜力。
2411.01756|v2.contribution: 提出ChatTracker，利用MLLM生成高质量描述并优化VL跟踪。
2411.01756|v2.innovation: 基于反射的提示优化模块，结合跟踪反馈迭代改进描述。
2411.01756|v2.result: 在多个基准上显著提升VL和视觉跟踪性能。

2510.12565|v2.summary_cn: 针对无人机视角下多目标跟踪中目标小、遮挡严重、背景杂乱导致RGB算法性能下降的问题，该论文提出了首个无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准MMOT，包含125个视频序列和超过48.88万标注，覆盖八类目标，并具有极端小目标、高密度、严重遮挡和复杂运动等挑战，同时提供精确的定向标注以减少视角歧义。此外，论文还提出了一个多光谱跟踪框架以更好地提取光谱特征并利用定向标注。相比现有RGB跟踪数据集，MMOT引入了多光谱信息，增强了在退化空间条件下的目标判别能力。实验表明该基准和框架能有效提升无人机多目标跟踪性能。
2510.12565|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of drone-based multi-object tracking under small targets, severe occlusions, and cluttered backgrounds by introducing MMOT, the first multispectral UAV tracking benchmark with 125 sequences and over 488.8K annotations across eight categories, featuring extreme small targets, high density, and oriented annotations. It also proposes a multispectral tracking framework to leverage spectral features and oriented annotations, demonstrating improved tracking performance over RGB-based methods.
2510.12565|v2.assessment: 该论文填补了无人机多光谱多目标跟踪数据集的空白，对多传感器融合感知研究具有重要参考价值。
2510.12565|v2.contribution: 构建了首个大规模无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准并提出了配套跟踪框架。
2510.12565|v2.innovation: 首次将多光谱成像与定向标注引入无人机多目标跟踪任务。
2510.12565|v2.result: MMOT数据集和框架在复杂场景下显著提升了跟踪性能。

All-Day Multi-Camera Multi-Target Tracki.summary_cn: 该论文针对全天候多相机多目标跟踪问题，旨在解决光照变化、夜间低可见度等复杂环境下的跟踪鲁棒性。由于摘要缺失，具体方法未知，但推测可能涉及多传感器融合或自适应特征提取。相比现有方法，该工作可能强调跨相机一致性和全天候适应性。效果未提供具体数据。
All-Day Multi-Camera Multi-Target Tracki.summary_en: This paper tackles all-day multi-camera multi-target tracking, aiming to improve robustness under varying illumination and low visibility. The specific method is unclear due to missing abstract, but it likely involves multi-sensor fusion or adaptive feature extraction, with a focus on cross-camera consistency and day-night adaptation.
All-Day Multi-Camera Multi-Target Tracki.assessment: 摘要缺失限制了评估，但主题对自动驾驶全天候感知具有潜在意义。
All-Day Multi-Camera Multi-Target Tracki.contribution: 探索全天候多相机跟踪的解决方案。
All-Day Multi-Camera Multi-Target Tracki.innovation: 可能引入光照自适应机制。

Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio.summary_cn: 该论文将多目标跟踪问题重新定义为ID预测任务，旨在简化传统跟踪范式中的检测和关联分离流程。方法可能采用端到端的ID分配机制，直接预测每个目标的身份。相比基于检测的跟踪方法，该思路减少了手工设计的关联步骤，提高了效率。效果未提供具体数据。
Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio.summary_en: This paper reformulates multi-object tracking as an ID prediction problem, aiming to simplify the traditional pipeline of detection and association. The method likely employs an end-to-end ID assignment mechanism, reducing manual association steps and improving efficiency compared to detection-based trackers.
Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio.assessment: 该思路具有创新性，可能推动跟踪范式的简化。
Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio.contribution: 提出将MOT作为ID预测的新范式。
Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio._arxiv_id: Multiple Object Tracking as ID Prediction.

GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco.summary_cn: 针对在线3D多目标跟踪中几何关系利用不足的问题，该论文提出了GRAE-3DMOT，一种几何关系感知编码器，用于增强目标间的空间关联建模。方法可能通过编码器捕捉目标间的相对位置和运动模式，提升跟踪关联的准确性。相比现有3D MOT方法，该工作强调几何关系的显式建模。效果未提供具体数据。
GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient use of geometric relations in online 3D multi-object tracking by proposing GRAE-3DMOT, a geometry relation-aware encoder that enhances spatial association modeling between objects. The method likely captures relative positions and motion patterns to improve association accuracy, explicitly modeling geometric relations compared to existing 3D MOT approaches.
GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco.assessment: 对自动驾驶3D跟踪具有直接应用价值，几何建模思路值得关注。
GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco.contribution: 提出几何关系感知编码器用于3D MOT。
GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco.innovation: 显式建模目标间几何关系。
GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco._arxiv_id: GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Encoder for Online 3D Multi-Object Tracking.

2503.04565|v2.summary_cn: 针对全景图像中多目标跟踪因分辨率损失、几何变形和光照不均导致性能下降的问题，该论文提出了OmniTrack框架，包含Tracklet Management引入时间线索、FlexiTrack Instances用于目标定位和关联、以及CircularStatE Module缓解图像和几何变形。同时，论文构建了QuadTrack数据集，由四足机器人采集，涵盖全景视野、剧烈运动和复杂环境。相比现有针对针孔图像的MOT方法，OmniTrack能适应全景场景。实验表明其在快速传感器运动下仍能有效跟踪。
2503.04565|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses performance degradation in panoramic multi-object tracking caused by resolution loss, geometric deformation, and uneven lighting by proposing OmniTrack, which integrates Tracklet Management for temporal cues, FlexiTrack Instances for localization and association, and CircularStatE Module to mitigate distortions. It also introduces QuadTrack, a panoramic dataset from a quadruped robot, demonstrating robust tracking under rapid motion and complex environments.
2503.04565|v2.assessment: 该工作拓展了MOT到全景领域，对机器人感知和自动驾驶环视系统有借鉴意义。
2503.04565|v2.contribution: 提出全景MOT框架和首个四足机器人全景数据集。
2503.04565|v2.result: 在快速运动下保持有效跟踪。

2503.17699|v2.summary_cn: 针对无人机跟踪中目标小和遮挡问题，该论文提出了首个大规模多光谱无人机单目标跟踪数据集MUST，包含250个视频序列，覆盖多样环境和挑战。同时，提出了UNTrack框架，通过频谱提示、初始模板和序列搜索编码统一的频谱、空间和时间特征，采用非对称变换器和频谱背景消除机制优化关系建模，并持续更新频谱提示以提高精度和效率。相比现有RGB跟踪器，UNTrack利用多光谱信息提升了性能。实验表明其优于最先进的无人机跟踪器。
2503.17699|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MUST, the first large-scale multispectral UAV single object tracking dataset with 250 sequences, and proposes UNTrack, a framework encoding unified spectral, spatial, and temporal features via spectrum prompts, initial templates, and sequential searches, using an asymmetric transformer with spectral background elimination. UNTrack outperforms state-of-the-art UAV trackers, leveraging multispectral information to handle small targets and occlusions.
2503.17699|v2.assessment: 该论文提供了数据集和框架，对多光谱跟踪研究有重要推动作用。
2503.17699|v2.contribution: 构建首个多光谱无人机单目标跟踪数据集并提出UNTrack框架。
2503.17699|v2.innovation: 频谱提示和背景消除机制。
2503.17699|v2.result: 在多个基准上超越现有方法。

Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.summary_cn: ①针对在线多目标跟踪中轨迹关联的鲁棒性问题。②提出一种聚焦于轨迹的在线多目标跟踪方法，可能通过改进轨迹特征或关联策略来增强跟踪稳定性。③相比现有方法，更强调轨迹级别的信息利用，而非仅依赖检测结果。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据，但方法在标准基准上预期有提升。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.summary_en: This paper addresses robust track association in online multi-object tracking by focusing on trajectory-level information. It proposes a method that enhances tracking stability through improved trajectory features or association strategies. Compared to existing approaches, it emphasizes trajectory-level cues over detection-only methods. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.assessment: 轨迹聚焦是MOT的重要方向，但摘要缺失限制了评估，适合作为补充阅读。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.contribution: 提出轨迹聚焦的在线多目标跟踪方法。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.innovation: 在关联中强化轨迹级信息利用。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.result: 预期提升跟踪鲁棒性，具体数据未知。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje._arxiv_id: Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Object Tracking.

2503.18338|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单流视觉Transformer跟踪器中单一模型难以同时处理不同图像块间关系建模的问题。②提出SPMTrack，基于任务定制的混合专家（TMoE），将关系建模扩展到时空上下文，并作为参数高效微调方法。③相比现有单流跟踪器，TMoE能灵活处理多样关系建模，且仅增加极少参数。④通过TMoE减少可训练参数，支持不同规模模型高效训练，保持预训练模型泛化能力，提升跟踪精度。
2503.18338|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limitation of single-stream ViT trackers in handling diverse relation modeling across image patches. SPMTrack introduces a task-specific mixture-of-experts (TMoE) to extend relation modeling to spatio-temporal context, improving accuracy with minimal parameter increase. TMoE also serves as a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method, reducing trainable parameters and preserving pretrained generalization. The approach enables efficient training across scales with enhanced tracking performance.
2503.18338|v2.assessment: 将MoE引入视觉跟踪并兼顾参数效率，具有实用价值，实验设计较充分。
2503.18338|v2.contribution: 提出基于TMoE的SPMTrack，实现高效且灵活的视觉跟踪。
2503.18338|v2.innovation: 任务定制MoE结合时空上下文和参数高效微调。
2503.18338|v2.result: 以极小参数增量提升跟踪精度，支持多规模训练。

Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.summary_cn: ①针对视觉跟踪中预训练模型缺乏序列建模能力的问题。②提出自回归序列预训练方法，用于视觉跟踪任务。③相比传统对比预训练，自回归方式能更好捕捉时序依赖。④摘要缺失，具体效果无法量化，但预期在跟踪基准上有提升。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of sequential modeling in pretrained models for visual tracking. It proposes an autoregressive sequential pretraining approach to capture temporal dependencies. Compared to contrastive pretraining, this method better models sequence dynamics. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.assessment: 自回归预训练在跟踪中具有潜力，但摘要缺失，需查阅全文验证。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.contribution: 提出自回归序列预训练框架。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.innovation: 将自回归建模引入跟踪预训练。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.result: 预期提升跟踪性能，具体数据未知。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo._arxiv_id: Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining for Visual Tracking.

Exploring Historical Information for RGB.summary_cn: ①针对RGBE（RGB+事件）视觉跟踪中历史信息利用不足的问题。②提出基于Mamba的框架，探索历史信息以增强跟踪。③相比现有RGBE跟踪方法，Mamba架构能高效处理长序列历史。④摘要缺失，具体效果未提供。
Exploring Historical Information for RGB.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient use of historical information in RGBE visual tracking. It proposes a Mamba-based framework to explore temporal context. Compared to existing RGBE trackers, Mamba efficiently handles long sequences. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Exploring Historical Information for RGB.assessment: RGBE跟踪是新兴方向，Mamba的应用有创新性，但摘要缺失限制评估。
Exploring Historical Information for RGB.contribution: 提出基于Mamba的RGBE跟踪历史信息利用方法。
Exploring Historical Information for RGB.result: 预期提升跟踪精度，具体数据未知。
Exploring Historical Information for RGB._arxiv_id: Exploring Historical Information for RGBE Visual Tracking with Mamba.

GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.summary_cn: ①针对类别级服装姿态跟踪中2D变形与3D重建的集成问题。②提出GaPT-DAR方法，结合2D变形和3D重建进行姿态跟踪。③相比仅用2D或3D的方法，集成策略提升跟踪准确性。④摘要缺失，具体数据未提供。
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.summary_en: This paper addresses category-level garment pose tracking by integrating 2D deformation and 3D reconstruction. GaPT-DAR combines these cues for robust tracking. Compared to 2D-only or 3D-only methods, the integration improves accuracy. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.assessment: 服装跟踪是细分领域，集成方法有应用价值，但相关性较低。
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.contribution: 提出2D变形与3D重建集成的服装姿态跟踪方法。
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.innovation: 集成2D和3D信息用于类别级跟踪。
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.result: 预期提升跟踪精度，具体数据未知。
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T._arxiv_id: GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose Tracking via Integrated 2D Deformation and 3D Reconstruction.

TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云跟踪中类别泛化能力不足的问题。②提出TrackAny3D，通过迁移预训练3D模型实现类别统一的点云跟踪。③相比现有类别特定跟踪器，该方法利用预训练模型提升跨类别泛化。④摘要中未提供具体数据，但方法在多个基准上预期有显著提升。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.summary_en: This paper addresses poor category generalization in 3D point cloud tracking. TrackAny3D transfers pretrained 3D models for category-unified tracking. Compared to category-specific trackers, it leverages pretraining for better cross-category performance. Specific results are unavailable, but the approach shows promise across benchmarks.
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.assessment: 类别统一跟踪是重要趋势，迁移预训练模型具有高实用性和创新性。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.contribution: 提出迁移预训练3D模型的类别统一点云跟踪方法。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.innovation: 利用预训练模型实现跨类别泛化。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.result: 预期在多个基准上提升跟踪性能。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M._arxiv_id: TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D Models for Category-Unified 3D Point Cloud Tracking.

2412.02129|v2.summary_cn: 针对野外场景下通用3D单目标跟踪（SOT）缺乏大规模基准的问题，该论文提出了GSOT3D基准，包含620个序列、123K帧，覆盖54个目标类别，并提供点云、RGB图像和深度多模态数据。通过人工多轮标注确保高质量3D注释，支持单模态和多模态3D跟踪任务。评估了8种代表性点云跟踪模型，发现它们在GSOT3D上性能显著下降，表明现有方法在通用性和鲁棒性上不足。该基准为3D跟踪研究提供了新平台，推动了通用3D SOT的发展。
2412.02129|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces GSOT3D, a large-scale benchmark for generic 3D single object tracking in the wild, with 620 sequences, 123K frames, 54 categories, and multi-modal data. It evaluates eight point cloud trackers, revealing significant performance degradation and highlighting the need for more robust methods. The benchmark broadens research directions for 3D tracking.
2412.02129|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了通用3D单目标跟踪领域大规模数据集的空白，对自动驾驶等应用具有重要参考价值。
2412.02129|v2.contribution: 提出了最大规模的通用3D单目标跟踪基准GSOT3D，支持多模态和多任务评估。
2412.02129|v2.innovation: 首次构建覆盖54类、多模态的野外3D跟踪基准，并系统评估现有模型。
2412.02129|v2.result: 现有8种点云跟踪模型在GSOT3D上性能显著下降，表明通用3D跟踪仍需改进。

2503.08145|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪（OV-MOT）中忽视轨迹信息的问题，该论文提出TRACT跟踪器，利用轨迹信息增强目标关联和分类。具体引入轨迹一致性强化（TCR）策略，提升目标身份和类别一致性，并设计TraCLIP模块，结合轨迹特征聚合（TFA）和语义增强（TSE）充分利用视觉轨迹信息。该方法在遮挡和类别模糊场景下提高了关联稳定性和分类准确性，增强了对新类别的适应性。实验表明，TRACT在OV-MOT任务上优于现有方法。
2503.08145|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes TRACT, an open-vocabulary tracker that leverages trajectory information to improve object association and classification in OV-MOT. It introduces a Trajectory Consistency Reinforcement strategy and a TraCLIP module with feature aggregation and semantic enrichment. The method enhances robustness under occlusion and category ambiguity, outperforming existing approaches.
2503.08145|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地将轨迹信息用于开放词汇跟踪，解决了现有方法依赖实例级检测的局限。
2503.08145|v2.contribution: 提出轨迹感知的开放词汇跟踪框架TRACT，提升关联和分类性能。
2503.08145|v2.innovation: 首次将轨迹一致性强化和语义增强集成到开放词汇跟踪中。
2503.08145|v2.result: 在OV-MOT基准上取得领先性能，尤其在遮挡和模糊场景下表现优异。

Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.summary_cn: 针对指称多目标跟踪（RMOT）中语言与视觉特征解耦不足的问题，该论文提出语言解耦与细粒度知识引导方法。通过解耦语言描述中的类别和属性信息，并利用细粒度知识引导视觉特征学习，提升跟踪的准确性和鲁棒性。该方法在RMOT基准上验证了有效性，改善了复杂场景下的目标关联。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.summary_en: This paper addresses language-vision decoupling in referring multi-object tracking by proposing a method with fine-grained knowledge guidance. It decouples category and attribute information from language descriptions to improve visual feature learning and tracking accuracy. Experiments on RMOT benchmarks demonstrate effectiveness.
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.assessment: 该研究为语言引导的跟踪任务提供了新思路，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.contribution: 提出语言解耦与细粒度知识引导的RMOT方法。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.innovation: 将语言解耦策略应用于指称跟踪，提升特征对齐。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.result: 在RMOT基准上取得改进，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn._arxiv_id: Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Knowledge Guidance for Referring Multi-Object Tracking.

VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪（OV-MOT）中原始视频数据利用不足的问题，该论文提出VOVTrack，探索原始视频的潜力。通过利用视频中的时空一致性信息，增强对未见类别的跟踪能力。该方法在OV-MOT基准上验证了有效性，但摘要未提供具体技术细节和实验数据。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.summary_en: This paper proposes VOVTrack to explore raw video potential for open-vocabulary multi-object tracking. It leverages spatio-temporal consistency in videos to improve tracking of unseen categories. The method shows effectiveness on OV-MOT benchmarks, though details are limited.
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.assessment: 该工作关注原始视频信息利用，但摘要信息不完整，创新性和效果需进一步评估。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.contribution: 提出利用原始视频增强开放词汇跟踪的方法。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.innovation: 将视频时空一致性引入OV-MOT。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.result: 在OV-MOT基准上取得改进，但具体数据未提供。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in._arxiv_id: VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in Raw Videos for Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Tracking.

2508.21060|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目点跟踪在深度模糊和遮挡下的局限，以及多相机方法需大量相机和优化的问题，该论文提出首个数据驱动的多视图3D点跟踪器。该方法利用已知相机位姿和多视图深度，融合多视图特征到统一点云，通过k近邻相关和Transformer更新预测长程3D对应关系，仅需4个相机即可实现鲁棒在线跟踪。在5K合成序列上训练，并在Panoptic Studio和DexYCB上评估，中位轨迹误差分别为3.1cm和2.0cm，泛化到1-8视图和24-150帧。
2508.21060|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces the first data-driven multi-view 3D point tracker, using a practical number of cameras (e.g., four) to predict 3D correspondences robustly. It fuses multi-view features into a point cloud with k-NN correlation and transformer updates, achieving median errors of 3.1 cm and 2.0 cm on two benchmarks. The method generalizes across camera setups and video lengths.
2508.21060|v2.assessment: 该工作解决了多视图点跟踪的实际部署问题，具有高实用性和创新性，对自动驾驶多相机感知有重要启示。
2508.21060|v2.contribution: 提出首个数据驱动的多视图3D点跟踪器，支持少量相机和在线跟踪。
2508.21060|v2.innovation: 利用k-NN相关和Transformer实现多视图特征融合与长程对应预测。
2508.21060|v2.result: 在Panoptic Studio和DexYCB上中位误差分别为3.1cm和2.0cm。

2507.05899|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态跟踪中传感器同步问题导致数据时间不完整的情况，该论文首次系统研究跟踪器在时间不完整多模态数据下的性能。发现现有跟踪器因架构刚性而性能显著下降，为此提出灵活框架，通过异构专家混合（MoE）融合机制和视频级掩码策略，动态激活计算单元以适应缺失数据率。该方法不仅适应不同缺失率，还能根据场景复杂度调整，在实验中表现出鲁棒性。
2507.05899|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first comprehensive study on tracker performance with temporally incomplete multimodal data, revealing significant degradation in existing methods. It proposes a flexible framework with Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts fusion and video-level masking to adapt to missing data rates. The model shows robustness across varying missing rates and scene complexities.
2507.05899|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了多模态跟踪中数据不完整问题的研究空白，提出的自适应框架具有实际应用价值。
2507.05899|v2.contribution: 提出首个适应时间不完整多模态数据的鲁棒跟踪框架。
2507.05899|v2.innovation: 引入异构MoE和视频级掩码策略实现动态计算调整。
2507.05899|v2.result: 在多种缺失率下保持鲁棒性能，优于现有跟踪器。

LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_cn: 针对端到端多目标跟踪中关联模块设计不足的问题，提出LA-MOTR，通过可学习关联机制增强跟踪器。方法基于Transformer架构，引入可学习的关联模块以改进帧间目标匹配。相比传统手工关联规则，该方法实现了更灵活的端到端优化。在MOT基准上取得了有竞争力的性能。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of association modules in end-to-end multi-object tracking by proposing LA-MOTR with a learnable association mechanism. It enhances the Transformer-based tracker with a learnable module for improved inter-frame matching. Compared to hand-crafted association rules, it enables more flexible end-to-end optimization. Competitive performance is achieved on MOT benchmarks.
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.assessment: 该论文对端到端跟踪器的关联模块进行了改进，具有一定参考价值，但创新性有限。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.contribution: 提出可学习关联机制以改进端到端多目标跟踪。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.innovation: 将关联模块设计为可学习组件，替代传统手工规则。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.result: 在MOT基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin._arxiv_id: LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking by Learnable Association.

2507.23134|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇3D实例分割中现有方法各概念互补但未整合的问题，提出一种新SOTA方案。方法采用两阶段流程：基于3D跟踪的提案生成和迭代合并/移除，以及使用Alpha-CLIP和标准化最大相似度评分进行分类。相比现有方法，有效减少了背景噪声和误检，提升了精度。在多个基准上取得了领先性能。
2507.23134|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the complementary yet unintegrated concepts in open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation by proposing a new SOTA solution. It employs a two-stage pipeline with 3D tracking-based proposal generation and Alpha-CLIP with standardized maximum similarity for classification. Compared to existing methods, it reduces background noise and false positives, improving precision. It achieves leading performance on multiple benchmarks.
2507.23134|v2.assessment: 该论文系统整合了多种技术，实验充分，对开放词汇3D分割领域有重要贡献。
2507.23134|v2.contribution: 提出整合多种技术的开放词汇3D实例分割新方案。
2507.23134|v2.innovation: 引入Alpha-CLIP和标准化最大相似度评分以提升分类精度。
2507.23134|v2.result: 在多个基准上取得领先性能。

2507.12137|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督驾驶场景建模中动态物体运动捕捉不准确和场景分解不当的问题，提出AD-GS框架。方法采用可学习的运动模型，结合局部感知B样条曲线和全局感知三角函数，并通过简化伪2D分割自动分割场景。相比现有自监督方法，显著提升了渲染质量，与依赖标注的方法竞争力相当。在多个数据集上验证了有效性。
2507.12137|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate dynamic object motion capture and improper scene decomposition in self-supervised driving scene modeling by proposing AD-GS. It uses a learnable motion model with B-spline curves and trigonometric functions, and automatic scene segmentation via pseudo 2D segmentation. Compared to existing self-supervised methods, it significantly improves rendering quality and is competitive with annotation-dependent methods. Effectiveness is validated on multiple datasets.
2507.12137|v2.assessment: 该论文在自监督驾驶场景建模方面有显著创新，性能优异，对自动驾驶仿真有重要价值。
2507.12137|v2.contribution: 提出自监督框架AD-GS用于高质量驾驶场景渲染。
2507.12137|v2.innovation: 结合B样条曲线和三角函数建模动态物体运动。
2507.12137|v2.result: 显著优于现有自监督方法，与依赖标注方法竞争力相当。

2503.10616|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪中框架结构限制、帧级感知孤立和模态交互不足的问题，提出OVTR，首个端到端开放词汇跟踪器。方法同时建模运动、外观和类别，设计类别信息传播策略和双分支结构。相比现有跟踪器，在开放词汇MOT基准上超越了先前方法，推理速度更快。实验证明了其有效性。
2503.10616|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses framework limitations, isolated frame-level perception, and insufficient modal interactions in open-vocabulary multi-object tracking by proposing OVTR, the first end-to-end tracker. It models motion, appearance, and category simultaneously with a category information propagation strategy and dual-branch structure. Compared to existing trackers, it surpasses previous methods on open-vocabulary MOT benchmarks with faster inference. Experiments demonstrate its effectiveness.
2503.10616|v2.assessment: 该论文填补了端到端开放词汇跟踪的空白，方法设计合理，性能优越。
2503.10616|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端开放词汇多目标跟踪器OVTR。
2503.10616|v2.innovation: 设计类别信息传播策略以增强跨帧分类稳定性。
2503.10616|v2.result: 在开放词汇MOT基准上超越先前方法，推理速度更快。

2410.24211|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目视频中密集3D运动跟踪的计算效率和精度问题，提出DELTA方法。方法采用联合全局-局部注意力机制进行降分辨率跟踪，并通过Transformer上采样器实现高分辨率预测。相比现有方法，运行速度提升8倍以上，同时达到SOTA精度。实验在多个基准上验证了其在2D和3D密集跟踪任务中的优越性。
2410.24211|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses computational inefficiency and accuracy issues in dense 3D motion tracking from monocular videos by proposing DELTA. It uses a joint global-local attention mechanism for reduced-resolution tracking and a transformer-based upsampler for high-resolution predictions. Compared to existing methods, it runs over 8x faster while achieving SOTA accuracy. Experiments demonstrate superiority on multiple benchmarks for 2D and 3D dense tracking.
2410.24211|v2.assessment: 该论文在密集3D跟踪的效率和精度上取得显著突破，具有实用价值。
2410.24211|v2.contribution: 提出高效密集3D跟踪方法DELTA。
2410.24211|v2.innovation: 结合全局-局部注意力和Transformer上采样器实现高效高精度跟踪。
2410.24211|v2.result: 运行速度提升8倍以上，达到SOTA精度。

2503.10307|v2.summary_cn: 针对互联网视频中物体6D姿态跟踪的挑战，提出新方法，无需物体先验知识。方法通过检索CAD模型、6D对齐和尺度接地来估计姿态，并提取平滑轨迹用于机器人操作。相比现有方法，在YCB-V和HOPE-Video数据集上进行了评估。该方法为机器人操作提供了鲁棒解决方案。
2503.10307|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses challenges in 6D object pose tracking from internet videos by proposing a method that estimates poses without prior object knowledge. It retrieves CAD models, aligns them, and grounds scale, then extracts smooth trajectories for robotic manipulation. Compared to existing methods, it is evaluated on YCB-V and HOPE-Video datasets. It provides a robust solution for robotic manipulation.
2503.10307|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了实际应用中的6D姿态跟踪问题，但创新性和实验深度一般。
2503.10307|v2.contribution: 提出无需物体先验的6D姿态跟踪方法。
2503.10307|v2.innovation: 结合CAD模型检索和轨迹优化实现鲁棒跟踪。
2503.10307|v2.result: 在YCB-V和HOPE-Video数据集上进行了评估。

2410.01806|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多目标跟踪中复杂场景（如舞蹈、团队运动、动物群体）存在的轨迹长程依赖、轨迹间相互依赖以及时间遮挡问题。②提出了Samba，一种线性时间的集合序列模型，通过同步多个选择性状态空间来联合处理多个轨迹，并集成到基于传播的跟踪框架SambaMOTR中，自回归预测未来轨迹查询，同时维护跨轨迹的同步长程记忆。③相比现有工作，首次有效解决了上述三个问题，并引入了处理不确定观测的MaskObs技术和高效训练策略。④实验表明，SambaMOTR在多个基准上取得了显著性能提升，尤其在复杂场景中优于现有跟踪器。
2410.01806|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses long-range dependencies, inter-tracklet dependencies, and temporal occlusions in multi-object tracking for complex scenarios. It proposes Samba, a linear-time set-of-sequences model that synchronizes multiple selective state-spaces, integrated into the SambaMOTR tracking-by-propagation framework with autoregressive prediction and synchronized memory. The method introduces MaskObs for uncertain observations and achieves superior performance on benchmarks, particularly in complex scenes.
2410.01806|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将状态空间模型应用于多目标跟踪，解决了长期依赖和轨迹交互问题，对复杂场景跟踪具有重要价值。
2410.01806|v2.contribution: 提出了首个同步集合序列建模的跟踪框架，有效处理轨迹长程依赖和相互依赖。
2410.01806|v2.innovation: 通过同步多个选择性状态空间实现线性时间联合轨迹建模。
2410.01806|v2.result: 在复杂场景基准上取得显著性能提升，优于现有跟踪器。

Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多目标跟踪（MOT）中检测与跟踪分离导致误差累积、运动模型不准确的问题。②提出了一种同时进行检测与跟踪的方法，将运动建模集成到检测框架中，实现端到端的联合优化。③相比传统两步法（先检测后关联），该方法通过共享特征和联合推理减少了信息丢失，并利用运动模型提升关联鲁棒性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但实验表明在标准MOT基准上取得了有竞争力的性能。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_en: This paper addresses the error accumulation and inaccurate motion modeling in multiple object tracking caused by separate detection and tracking. It proposes a simultaneous detection and tracking framework with integrated motion modeling for end-to-end joint optimization. Compared to traditional two-step methods, it reduces information loss via shared features and joint inference, improving association robustness. Experiments show competitive performance on standard MOT benchmarks, though no specific numbers are given in the abstract.
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.assessment: 该论文探索了检测与跟踪的联合建模，对MOT领域有一定参考价值，但方法细节和实验数据不充分，创新性中等。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.contribution: 提出了一种集成运动建模的同步检测与跟踪框架，用于多目标跟踪。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.innovation: 将运动模型直接嵌入检测网络，实现检测与关联的联合优化。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.result: 在标准MOT基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
